jobs.title: Unreal Engine Cinematic Artist (Previz & Camera Work)
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAtrium is a YouTube channel focused on bringing history to life through immersive visual storytelling, from exploring Hitler’s final hours to recreating the conditions of Auschwitz.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Atrium is a YouTube channel focused on bringing history to life through immersive visual storytelling, from exploring Hitler’s final hours to recreating the conditions of Auschwitz.

We’re looking for a full-time 3D Layout Artist to help shape the visual direction of our content through cinematic scene composition, camera operation, and storytelling.

This is a highly creative role for someone who thinks visually and understands how camera work can transform a script into an engaging viewing experience. You’ll work closely with the Channel Director to translate scripts into compelling 3D layouts and animatics, defining camera movement, scene composition, pacing, and the overall visual tone of each video.

Your work will serve as the blueprint for the animation team, ensuring every scene is thoughtfully composed, visually clear, and intentional before moving into full production.

What You’ll Be Obsessed About

Making every scene work visually.

You understand that great storytelling isn't just about what happens on screen, but how the audience experiences it. You think about camera angles, movement, composition, pacing, character posing, and transitions, always looking for ways to make each moment clearer, more cinematic, and more engaging.

You’re always thinking:

“How can I make this scene more compelling through composition, camera work, and staging?”

And then you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

  • Interpret scripts and translate them into clear, compelling 3D layouts and animatics.
  • Operate virtual cameras to establish framing, camera movement, shot composition, and transitions.
  • Define the visual flow of each scene, including timing, pacing, spatial relationships, and continuity.
  • Handle animation blocking and character posing to establish clear actions, staging, and storytelling beats.
  • Collaborate closely with the Channel Director to develop and refine the visual storytelling approach.
  • Build scenes and layouts in Unreal Engine, preparing environments and assets for review and production.
  • Explore creative camera techniques and visual solutions to communicate complex historical events, environments, and concepts.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized layouts and animatics that give animators a strong foundation for production.
  • Prepare and organize scenes, assets, and project files within a hands-on production pipeline that requires careful manual setup and coordination.
  • Review outputs, incorporate feedback, and refine layouts to meet the creative vision.
  • Maintain consistency and continuity across scenes while keeping project files and assets accessible to the team.

About You

  • Several years of experience in 3D layout, animation, camera work, or a related role in YouTube, film, or television production.
  • Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine, ideally version 5.6.1.
  • Strong understanding of cinematic language, including composition, framing, camera movement, timing, and transitions.
  • Experience with animation blocking and character posing, with an understanding of how staging and body language support storytelling.
  • A good eye for visual storytelling and the ability to translate scripts into clear, engaging sequences.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage assets, scenes, and project files independently in a hands-on production environment.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and able to communicate clearly in a fast-moving production environment.
  • Comfortable working independently, solving visual challenges, and incorporating feedback without losing sight of the overall creative vision.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of Blender for 3D scene preparation or related tasks.
  • Experience managing or contributing to 3D animation pipelines.
  • Understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, and viewer engagement.
  • Interest in storytelling psychology and audience behavior.
  • Experience working on documentaries, historical content, or educational entertainment.
  • Willingness to contribute across different stages of production when needed.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You think in shots and sequences, naturally translating ideas into visual compositions.
  • You understand how camera movement, framing, and character posing can create tension, establish scale, and guide the viewer's attention.
  • You balance cinematic ambition with practical production needs.
  • You care about pacing, rhythm, continuity, and the purpose behind every shot.
  • You actively study great visual storytelling across films, documentaries, and digital content.
  • You bring creative ideas and visual solutions, not just execution.
  • You know when a scene needs a complex camera move and when a simple, well-composed shot tells the story better.
  • You take ownership of your work and keep assets, scenes, and files organized without needing constant supervision.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a growing YouTube channel, working on stories that bring history and complex subjects to life through immersive 3D environments and cinematic storytelling.

Your work will directly influence how each story is experienced, from the first camera setup to the final animation, helping establish the visual foundation for every video we produce.

Who We Are

Independent for over 75 years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.

We encourage our employees to give back to their varied professions, including leadership in professional organizations. Please visit our web site to learn more about Milliman’s commitments to our people, diversity and inclusion, social impact and sustainability:

Milliman’s New York Property and Casualty practice (NYPC) provides a wide variety of actuarial consulting services to insurance carriers, reinsurers, and self-insureds including loss reserving, pricing, and predictive modeling.

What You Will Do

In this practice, an Actuarial Analyst is responsible for performing various levels of analysis related to client work, such as reviewing data in preparation for analysis, checking data for errors and consistency, drafting reports, and maintaining documentation. This is a tremendous career opportunity for an early career actuary with pricing experience to take on direct responsibility for client work.

In addition to tactical responsibilities, Analysts are given opportunities to present their findings to their peers, project managers, and client relationship managers. Work is shared across the practice, giving everyone the opportunity to build their skills and showcase their abilities, and take on increasing responsibilities over time.

Our ideal hire for this role is someone who enjoys thinking critically to solve a client’s business problems; pairs their strong technical skills with creativity; is adept in independently managing their own workload; and is committed to the actuarial exam process through the Casualty Actuarial Society.

This person will also:

  • Understand, modify, and operate complex spreadsheets and database tools to analyze data and solve problems
  • Receive, reconcile, manipulate, and analyze data using programming languages such as R and SQL
  • Check data for consistency
  • Develop and use actuarial models
  • Present findings to peers, project managers, and client relationship managers
  • Draft written reports and exhibits, and prepare other internal/external correspondence
  • Check their own and peers’ work for accuracy
  • Undertake research projects
  • Perform or assist with other duties assigned at the direction of Actuaries and Principals

What We Are Looking For

Professional Qualifications

  • Completed bachelor’s degree (at time of application) in actuarial science, mathematics, data science, statistics, or other quantitative major
  • Two or more actuarial exams passed (at time of application)
  • Between one and four years of professional actuarial experience, which can include internship experience, to ideally include:

    • Familiarity with ISO loss costs, rating plans, increased limit factors (ILFs), size-of-risk curves, and other commercial lines pricing concepts; familiarity with regulatory rate filing processes is also strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical skill in Excel
  • Experience managing data and automating complex data manipulation tasks in R (preferred), SQL, SAS or other programming languages

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Available to start within 2-4 weeks of offer acceptance (this is an immediate hire)
  • Quick learner who takes initiative to dive deeper and solve problems
  • Able to adjust on the fly, to accept new assignments or shift focus, and balance multiple concurrent projects
  • “Big picture” thinking to help anticipate client needs
  • Superb attention to detail and technical accuracy
  • Self-sufficient, motivated to work independently
  • Enthusiasm for the work of our practice, and a strong work ethic to meet our clients’ needs
  • Collaborative by nature, willing to help wherever needed
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to express or explain complicated technical concepts to a variety of audiences

Additional Skills and Experience Welcome

  • Prior P&C reserving experience
  • Proven technical skill in programming with SAS, R, Python and/or SQL (R most preferred)

Individual(s) must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for any immigration support or sponsorship from Milliman now or in the future. This includes international students.

Location

Compensation

The overall salary range for this role is $60,300 - $136,160. For candidates residing in:

Bonuses are calculated and paid based upon a practice-level policy, and are not guaranteed.

Responsibilities

The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, automates, secures, and supports AWS cloud infrastructure and software delivery pipelines for a mission-critical application supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The position provides senior-level technical expertise in infrastructure as code, CI/CD, controlled deployments, system reliability, production troubleshooting, and federal security compliance, while collaborating with development, quality assurance, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable, compliant releases.

  • Active AWS Associate-level certification and understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

  • Ability to obtain a VA Public Trust clearance; U.S. Citizen, Green Card holder, residing in the United States for at least three years.

Security and Compliance

  • Support VA Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities, System Security Plans (SSPs), NIST/FISMA compliance, security control assessments, contingency planning, and continuous monitoring.

  • Experience with AWS EC2, ECS, ECR, S3, EBS, EFS, ALB, CloudFront, CloudTrail, EventBridge, IAM, and cloud networking; familiarity with Kubernetes.
  • Experience with web and application servers, load balancers, web application firewalls, and container deployments.
  • Familiarity with Jira Cloud, Confluence, Slack, Agile practices, release governance, and change management.

Professional Competencies

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Real Estate Development

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Demand Generation Manager – Cybersecurity & AI (Fractional | Remote)

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Part-Time / Fractional
Environment: Early-Stage Technology Venture

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage technology company developing AI-driven cyber risk intelligence and compliance solutions for organisations operating in increasingly complex security environments.

The business is developing a growing portfolio of cyber intelligence and quantum-security solutions and is now looking for a Demand Generation Manager who can help translate that product proposition into market awareness, engaged communities and a qualified pipeline.

This is a hands-on opportunity rather than a traditional corporate marketing position.

You will be joining a pre-revenue, early-stage venture where the emphasis at this stage is on building market traction, developing the demand engine and contributing to the company's longer-term growth.

The engagement is therefore likely to be particularly suited to someone who is comfortable participating in an early-stage venture alongside other professional commitments and is motivated by longer-term participation in the growth and value created by the business, rather than someone seeking a conventional full-time employment structure.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application

Please submit your CV together with a short note outlining:

  • Your experience building B2B demand-generation campaigns
  • Your hands-on HubSpot experience
  • Your experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager
  • An example of a campaign, community or channel you personally helped grow
  • Any experience you have marketing cybersecurity, technology or other complex B2B products

Please read the full opportunity carefully before applying.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help build and operate the company's early demand-generation engine across digital, community and B2B channels.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building and running demand-generation campaigns across LinkedIn, email, webinars and content
  • Developing market awareness and engagement across relevant cybersecurity communities
  • Supporting organic social activity across LinkedIn, X, Facebook and other relevant channels
  • Identifying opportunities to build engaged communities across platforms such as Instagram and TikTok
  • Managing social content calendars, scheduling, publishing and engagement reporting
  • Shaping messaging for CISOs, risk leaders, compliance teams, SMEs and innovation leaders
  • Creating nurture journeys for complex B2B buying committees
  • Supporting lead generation and conversion activity
  • Managing and improving marketing automation and lifecycle workflows
  • Supporting funnel tracking, attribution and performance reporting
  • Turning technical cybersecurity concepts into clear and engaging market-facing narratives
  • Testing channels, messaging and campaigns and using the resulting data to improve performance

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

This role requires genuine hands-on HubSpot capability rather than basic end-user familiarity.

You should be comfortable with:

  • Building and managing workflows
  • Email sequences
  • Forms and lifecycle automation
  • List segmentation
  • Lead and campaign reporting
  • Marketing automation processes

Experience taking meaningful ownership of HubSpot within a previous organisation will be particularly valuable.

Analytics & Performance

You should also have practical experience using:

  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Event and conversion tracking
  • Tag deployment
  • Channel attribution
  • Website and campaign performance reporting

The successful candidate should be comfortable using data to understand what is working, what isn't and where activity should be adjusted.

What We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in someone who combines hands-on digital execution with a genuine ability to build audiences and communities.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Experience within B2B demand generation, growth marketing or digital marketing
  • A demonstrable track record of generating pipeline rather than simply producing leads
  • Strong hands-on HubSpot experience, ideally including workflow and automation ownership
  • Strong practical knowledge of GA4 and Google Tag Manager
  • Experience managing organic social channels
  • Experience building and engaging digital communities
  • Strong written communication and messaging skills
  • Confidence learning technically complex subject matter
  • A practical, experimental and delivery-focused mindset
  • The ability to operate independently within a resource-conscious early-stage environment

We are more interested in demonstrable capability and results than job title or corporate seniority.

Particularly Valuable

Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Cybersecurity
  • AI or emerging technology
  • Risk and compliance
  • Financial services or other regulated industries
  • Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Webinars and founder-led marketing
  • Newsletter programmes using Beehiiv or comparable platforms
  • Audience growth, segmentation and deliverability
  • Marketing to SMEs
  • Building communities through Instagram, TikTok or other social platforms

Cybersecurity experience is useful but not essential if you can demonstrate the ability to learn complex subject matter quickly and translate it into compelling marketing.

Why This Opportunity?

The company is entering its next stage with:

  • An expanding cyber intelligence product portfolio
  • Active enterprise beta users
  • Increasing focus on the SME cybersecurity market
  • Emerging propositions across cyber intelligence and quantum security
  • Direct access to senior leadership
  • Considerable autonomy over how demand-generation activity is built and developed

For someone who enjoys building rather than inheriting established marketing machinery, this is an opportunity to influence the demand-generation approach from an early stage and see the direct impact of their work.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement within a pre-revenue technology venture.

It is designed for someone who understands the nature of participating in an early-stage business and is comfortable with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional package at this stage.

The role can therefore be undertaken alongside other compatible professional commitments.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

At Contegris, we're not just focused on building great products — we're equally committed to making sure they work reliably and deliver a seamless experience for the people who use them.

As a System Support Engineer, you'll be part of the team responsible for helping customers resolve technical issues, troubleshoot system-related problems, and ensure a smooth customer experience.

This is an entry-level technical support role suited for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, learning how systems work, communicating with customers, and finding practical solutions to technical problems. You'll work closely with customers to investigate issues, provide timely support, document incidents, and escalate complex problems when required.

If you're technically curious, comfortable communicating with customers, and looking to build your career in IT Support Network Support, this role might be for you.

What This Role Does

  • Handle Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries and technical issues received through phone, email, chat, and other support channels.
  • Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Analyze reported problems, identify possible causes, and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Drive First Contact Resolution: Resolve customer issues efficiently at the first point of contact whenever possible.
  • Monitor & Escalate: Identify system alerts or complex technical issues and escalate them to the relevant technical team when required.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Ask the right questions, actively listen to customer concerns, and gather the information required to diagnose issues.
  • Provide Clear Communication: Explain technical issues and solutions in a simple and professional manner to customers.
  • Document Incidents: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the CRM/HelpDesk system.
  • Follow Up: Stay connected with customers on pending issues and ensure they receive timely updates until resolution.
  • Collaborate with Technical Teams: Work with relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve issues that require further technical assistance.
  • Maintain Customer Experience: Ensure every customer interaction is handled professionally, patiently, and with a customer-first mindset.

Who This Is For

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably BS Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6 months - 1 year of experience in technical support or a high-paced call center environment.
  • Students currently enrolled in a BS CS/IT-related program at VU (Virtual University) are also encouraged to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed CCNA, CCNP, or relevant networking/IT courses from Corvit are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic understanding of Linux, Networking, and Network Security.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer-oriented approach with the ability to handle customer concerns professionally.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good attention to detail and ability to accurately document technical issues.
  • Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Good team player with a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable working in Rotational shifts.

What Won't Work

This role won't be a fit if you:

  • Don't enjoy troubleshooting or investigating technical problems.
  • Prefer to simply forward customer issues instead of trying to understand and resolve them.
  • Struggle to communicate clearly with customers.
  • Find it difficult to remain patient and professional when dealing with frustrated customers.
  • Are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced support environment with rotational shifts.
  • Don't want to learn about Linux, networking, SaaS products, and technical systems.
  • This is primarily a Product Support role where you'll learn our products and technologies and provide technical support to our customers. If your career goal is to move into pure Networking or Network Engineering, this role may not be the right fit.
  • Avoid documenting issues, troubleshooting steps, or customer interactions properly.
  • Struggle to work under pressure or manage multiple support requests.
  • Prefer working independently and are not comfortable collaborating with technical teams.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

Job Description

NetImpact Strategies seeks a Federal Growth Executive to expand our business across federal civilian agencies. NetImpact combines established federal delivery experience with commercial software innovation to help agencies modernize systems and improve mission outcomes.

This executive will be accountable for generating and closing new business, expanding existing customer relationships, and converting NetImpact’s contract vehicles and capabilities into revenue. The role requires a hands-on leader who can identify customer needs, shape opportunities, demonstrate solutions, and lead pursuits from initial engagement through contract award.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver growth: Own federal civilian sales goals, building a qualified pipeline and converting opportunities into contract awards and revenue.
  • Develop agency relationships: Establish and strengthen relationships with mission leaders, program offices, CIO organizations, acquisition officials, and industry partners.
  • Own the sales cycle: Lead prospecting, qualification, customer discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, pursuit coordination, negotiation, and close.
  • Position NetImpact’s solutions connecting NetImpact’s modernization and technology solutions to customer priorities, funding, and mission outcomes.
  • Lead customer engagements: Independently present NetImpact’s value proposition and conduct compelling product demonstrations, bringing in technical specialists as opportunities require.
  • Shape opportunities: Engage customers early to understand operational challenges, modernization objectives, acquisition plans, and decision criteria.
  • Turn contract access into awards: Develop actionable sales strategies that use NetImpact’s existing contracts, contract vehicles, and partner relationships to create paths to purchase.
  • Maintain sales discipline: Keep opportunity records, next steps, forecasts, and competitive intelligence current in the company’s CRM.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in federal business development, sales, or growth, with substantial experience serving civilian agencies.
  • Demonstrated success personally leading opportunities through the full sales cycle and closing federal contracts.
  • Experience selling enterprise software, technology services, or modernization solutions involving multiple stakeholders and complex acquisition processes.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into clear customer benefits and a compelling business case.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Established relationships within federal civilian agencies, including VA, GSA, State, DoJ, Commerce, or other target accounts.
  • Experience selling commercial software and AI-enabled modernization solutions to government customers.
  • Experience with application modernization, workflow automation, case management, or mission-system transformation.

Measures of Success

Success will be measured by contract awards and revenue growth.

This role is probably not for you if:

  • You expect a large support team to handle the day-to-day execution. While we have dedicated proposal, graphics, and research resources, you must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting things done yourself.

This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $145,000-185,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.

  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!

jobs.title: Freelance possible - Consultant en sécurité TPRM, gestion des risques fournisseu
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésLa mission porte sur le pilotage et la mise en œuvre d’un programme de gestion des risques liés aux tiers (TPRM) dans le cadre de NIS2.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

La mission porte sur le pilotage et la mise en œuvre d’un programme de gestion des risques liés aux tiers (TPRM) dans le cadre de NIS2. Vous intervenez sur la gouvernance, les analyses de risques fournisseurs et l’intégration du dispositif dans les processus de l’organisation.

1. Finalisation du cadrage et de la gouvernance

  • Poursuivre la définition du modèle de gouvernance TPRM et accompagner l’adoption des rôles et responsabilités associés.
  • Contribuer à la formalisation de la politique, de la procédure et du framework de gestion des risques liés aux tiers.
  • Évaluer le niveau de conformité aux exigences applicables de NIS2 et de CyFun® et contribuer à la priorisation des actions de mise en conformité.
  • Définir et structurer les outils nécessaires au dispositif : inventaire des fournisseurs, critères de criticité, questionnaires d’impact et de maturité, registre des risques, plans d’action et supports de reporting.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement et le reporting auprès du CISO et des instances de gouvernance.

2. Préparation et mise en œuvre du dispositif

  • Contribuer à l’inventaire des fournisseurs critiques ainsi qu’à l’évaluation de leur criticité et de leurs dépendances métier et IT.
  • Mener ou accompagner les analyses de risques fournisseurs, formaliser les risques et suivre les plans de traitement et de remédiation.
  • Définir une approche proportionnée pour l’évaluation et le monitoring des tiers, en fonction de leur niveau de criticité et de risque.
  • Contribuer à la définition et à l’intégration des exigences de sécurité dans les processus d’achats, de projets et de contractualisation.
  • Accompagner le déploiement du dispositif sur des périmètres pilotes, notamment au moyen d’analyses de risques, de comités fournisseurs, de collectes d’évidences et, le cas échéant, d’audits ciblés.
  • Tirer les enseignements des pilotes afin d’améliorer le modèle de gouvernance, les méthodes et l’outillage.

3. Passage à l’échelle et coordination transverse

  • Préparer l’extension progressive du dispositif aux autres fournisseurs critiques, puis aux fournisseurs sensibles et aux nouveaux marchés, selon le périmètre retenu pour le dispositif.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Achats, Juridique, Protection des données, Projets, Processus et CISO afin d’ancrer le TPRM dans les processus existants et les nouveaux marchés.
  • Animer les ateliers, les entretiens et les comités avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs.
  • Préparer des synthèses claires sur l’avancement, les décisions attendues, les risques, les plans d’action et les points ouverts.
  • Contribuer à la formation et à la sensibilisation des parties prenantes afin de pérenniser le dispositif.

📝 Votre profil

  • Maîtrise de NIS2 et du référentiel CyFun® ou de NIST CSF.
  • Expérience des pratiques de gestion des risques liés aux tiers sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie fournisseur.
  • Expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie ou des infrastructures critiques.
  • Expérience de la coordination avec les équipes Achats, Juridique, métiers et IT/Sécurité.
  • Expérience démontrable dans l’analyse, notamment dans l’analyse des risques de sécurité de l’information.
  • Expérience démontrable en conseil ou en gestion GRC en cybersécurité.
  • Expérience démontrable en pilotage de programmes ou de projets de sécurité.
  • Expérience démontrable en tant que consultant en sécurité.
  • Expérience dans le suivi des plans de traitement et de remédiation des risques.
  • Expérience en évaluation de maturité ou de conformité sur la base d’un référentiel de contrôles.
  • Français niveau C2.
  • Expérience dans l’animation d’ateliers et de comités ainsi que dans le reporting auprès d’instances de pilotage.
  • Expérience avec la méthodologie EBIOS.
  • Expérience démontrable des techniques ou cadres de gestion de la sécurité, tels que les séries ISO 27000, COBIT for Security, NIST, OWASP ou CIS Critical Security Controls for Effective Cyber Defense.
  • Expérience dans la définition ou l’utilisation d’outils GRC, notamment pour l’inventaire des fournisseurs et le suivi des risques.
  • Anglais niveau B2.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next-generation AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms. Key Responsibilities & Required Skills

Linux & Bare Metal Infrastructure

    • GPU resource allocation and scheduling

    • GPU networking requirements

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as:
    • CUDA
    • NCCL
    • GPUDirect Storage

Enterprise Storage & Data Platforms

    • LVM
    • XFS, EXT4

    • Fibre Channel SAN
    • Multipath I/O

    • Cluster architecture

    • NVMe-over-Fabrics (NVMe-oF)

Networking & Infrastructure

    • Bonding
    • VLANs
    • Routing
    • MTU optimization
    • DNS
    • DHCP
  • Experience with high-performance data center networking:
    • 100G/200G/400G Ethernet
    • RoCE
    • RDMA
    • Spine-Leaf architectures
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies

Operations & Reliability

  • Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across:
    • Linux operating systems
    • Hardware platforms
    • GPU infrastructure
    • Networking
    • Enterprise storage
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments
  • Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency
  • Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards
  • Understanding of AI infrastructure design and reference architectures

GENERALIDADES DEL REQUERIMIENTO

Buscamos a un Gerente Administrativo y operativo de la organización altamente capacitado para supervisar las operaciones diarias de una granja agroturística en USA, una empresa de Eventos en USA. una constructora y una granja en Colombia. Organizado y con habilidades de comunicación y la supervisión de tareas de gestión e infraestructura. De las líneas de negocio de la finca, (hospedaje, Atención de eventos sociales y educativos familiares e infantiles, mantenimiento de la granja). Sensibilidad por la comodidad, la decoración y estética.

NUESTRO CLIENTE: EMPRESA AMERICANA CON OPERACION E INVERSIONES EN ESTADOS UNIDOS Y COLOMBIA.

La empresa se dedica a la gestión y operación de una granja agroturística, brindando experiencias auténticas en el entorno rural. Además, se encarga de organizar eventos y promover la agricultura sostenible en la región.

Requisitos

DESCRIPCIÓN Y REQUERIMIENTOS ESPECIFICOS

Formación académica específica o general (competencias duras):

  • Profesional en Administración de Empresas, Negocios internacionales, Turismo o campos relacionados.
  • Conocimientos sólidos en marketing, especialmente en temas de mercadeo digital, comercio digital, redes sociales y posicionamiento web.
  • Experiencia en la gestión de auditorías de seguros (servicios turísticos) y contratación de personal.
  • Conocimiento de la estructura de la contabilidad y las finanzas, análisis y gestion de las mismas.
  • Dominio de las aplicaciones de Google y herramientas informáticas relacionadas con el negocio.
  • Gestión de los listados en Airbnb y otras plataformas de alquiler, incluyendo la creación y actualización de los listados, la fijación de precios y la respuesta a las consultas.
  • Especialista en generación de demanda se enfocará en campañas de marketing para atraer a turistas locales y extranjeros.

Años de experiencia y conocimientos específicos necesarios:

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en administración hotelera y/o agroturística.
  • Experiencia en supervisión de tareas administrativas en fincas/agroturismo y gestión de producción agrícola.
  • Capacidad para revisar y controlar las finanzas y garantizar la viabilidad de cada aspecto de la granja.
  • Experiencia en gestión de alquileres y control de gastos a corto y medio plazo .

Funciones principales:

  • Liderar la estrategia tecnológica y de automatización de procesos en la plataforma, con énfasis en marketing digital y comercio electrónico.
  • Supervisar las tareas administrativas de la finca/agroturismo, incluyendo la gestión del personal y la producción agrícola para maximizar la rentabilidad.
  • Coordinar eventos y planificar viajes de campo.
  • Organizar y gestionar el correo electrónico y otros procesos administrativos.
  • Pasión por la agricultura y habilidades administrativas.

Factores principales de personalidad (competencias blandas):

  • Excelentes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y en equipo.
  • Habilidades de comunicación efectiva.
  • Orientación al detalle y capacidad para mantener altos estándares de calidad.
  • Resolución de problemas y toma de decisiones efectivas.

Conocimientos deseables más importantes:

  • Marketing digital y comercio electrónico: El administrador debe tener conocimientos sólidos en estrategias de marketing digital y comercio electrónico para promover la granja, atraer clientes y maximizar la visibilidad en línea.
  • Gestión de finanzas y contabilidad: Comprender la estructura de la contabilidad y tener habilidades en la gestión financiera es esencial para supervisar las finanzas de la granja, evaluar la rentabilidad de los aspectos clave y tomar decisiones financieras informadas.
  • Administración hotelera agroturística: Conocer los aspectos específicos de la administración de un negocio agroturístico, incluyendo la gestión de eventos, alojamiento, alimentación y actividades relacionadas, es fundamental para garantizar una experiencia exitosa para los visitantes.
  • Agricultura y producción agropecuaria: Contar con conocimientos en agricultura, producción de alimentos y manejo de animales es crucial para comprender las necesidades de la granja agroturística y asegurar una gestión adecuada de los recursos naturales y la producción agrícola.
  • Tecnología y herramientas digitales: Estar al tanto de las últimas herramientas tecnológicas, aplicaciones móviles y software de gestión agrícola es importante para mejorar la eficiencia operativa, automatizar procesos y optimizar la experiencia del cliente.

Habilidades de liderazgo y gestión:

  • Debe tener habilidades sólidas de liderazgo para dirigir al equipo, tomar decisiones efectivas y delegar responsabilidades de manera eficiente.

Beneficios

Condiciones especiales del cargo:

  • Tipo de contrato: A convenir.
  • Modalidad: Remota con ocasionales viajes a USA por periodos de hasta 3 meses y a la finca en Colombia .
  • Idiomas requeridos: Bilingüe (inglés y español) para comprender y comunicarse con el personal, así como para revisar correos electrónicos y documentos.

  • Accept and apply any/all feedback received by the editorial team

  • Flexible schedule, afternoon (PST) work schedule preferred, weekend availability valued

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Consistent and timely payments.
  • Flexible schedule.

  • An understanding of Google Discover and what drives engagement on the platform is a plus
  • 2+ years of experience working with a credible digital publication
  • A quick learner with a strong sense of urgency and drive

  • The ability to write high quality articles with fast turnaround times

​

  • Your CV

jobs.excerpt: About Amperity—Why This, Why NowMost customer data is a lie by omission.
jobs.description:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

At Amperity, engineers work in small, collaborative feature teams. As an SDE IV, you'll contribute across teams that move quickly, embracing rapid, iterative development to solve meaningful customer problems and improve the platform. Engineers are involved in shaping what we build and how we build it, working with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams to create high-impact features and seamless customer experiences. We keep our processes lightweight, our communication clear, and our focus on delivering value.

As one of the first teammates building our footprint in Argentina, you’ll play a meaningful role in our growth and be part of shaping this new chapter from the beginning.

Interesting Problems

  • Ingest and understand large amounts of structured customer, product, and event data
  • Create probabilistic knowledge graphs by training ML models to unify this data across different systems
  • Take research algorithms and realize them in production for extremely high-scale usage
  • Build visual experiences and toolset to help users visualize their data, understand their customers and surface the most impactful insights
  • Integrate our system into the operating core of the businesses we serve
  • Automate the management of thousands of VMs running data processing jobs

About You

  • 12+ years industry experience working in SaaS and distributed systems environments
  • Experience working with large-scale data-oriented systems on a major cloud provider
  • You show deep technical judgment, expanding to the depths of your team's technology ownership. You impart this judgment on others and are sought for advice on all aspects of your team's product, process, and technology.
  • You can guide architectural decisions on your team and across teams with an eye to high-level tradeoffs, and know when and how to explore novel approaches. You are a backstop for oncall issues on your team.
  • Passionate about building scalable infrastructure systems for both internal and external customers
  • Excited about using functional languages (like Clojure!) in a production environment - Clojure or functional language experience isn't required
  • You educate those outside your team on your team's technology and products. You mentor those on your team and contribute to their growth. You take opportunities to share your unique talents and interests across the whole engineering team in the form of tools, education, excellence in interviewing, onboarding, or leading various special interest groups

Location

Argentina - Remote

This role is remote, with a small number of meaningful in-person gatherings designed to support alignment and collaboration.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package, along with benefits designed to support your well-being and long-term growth. Our total rewards program includes base compensation, benefits, and the opportunity to participate in our company’s equity plan.

Amperity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and reproductive health choices), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as someone with a disability, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Job Summary

We are expanding our Snowflake capability within the Data and AI practice, and we are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to lead the technical side of it.

You will be in front of customers from the start, qualifying opportunities, running technical discovery with customer architects and data leaders, designing target platforms, and owning the technical win. Most of the work in front of us is focused on platform build-out and migration, helping enterprises consolidate onto Snowflake from SAP, Oracle, Teradata, and other established estates. This is where we need the strongest expertise.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over what we build and sell. It is ideal for someone who wants to shape a capability rather than operate within one that is already established.

Role Description

Own the Technical Side of Snowflake Pursuits

  • Lead qualification, discovery, target architecture design, effort and risk sizing, and development of technical content for proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

  • Build and maintain technical relationships with customer architects and technical stakeholders.

  • Provide accurate assessments of migration effort, complexity, and risk, helping customers understand the true scope of their transformation initiatives.

Provide Architectural Oversight Through Delivery

  • Review architecture decisions throughout delivery.

  • Ensure the delivered solution aligns with what was originally scoped and proposed.

  • Identify and address risks or issues early in the project lifecycle.

  • Remain engaged in delivery to maintain accountability for the technical solution and outcomes.

Shape Snowflake Service Offerings

  • Define the technical content of Snowflake-focused service offerings.

  • Establish service scope, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.

  • Determine what evidence demonstrates successful delivery.

  • Create repeatable frameworks and standards that delivery teams can execute consistently.

Partner with Snowflake

  • Collaborate directly with Snowflake field teams and specialist architects on joint customer engagements.

  • Build productive relationships with vendor teams while representing the organization’s technical perspective.

  • Effectively navigate technical challenges, feedback, and differing viewpoints from Snowflake architects and specialists

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Willingness to Learn: Can apply new learning to daily work, encourage and facilitate learning in others, and actively make changes to work based on feedback.

  • Self-Development: Can demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and adaptability to new ideas and methods.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can use advanced analytical techniques to solve complex problems, draw insights, and communicate the solutions effectively.

  • Prioritization: Can take ownership of complex task management, collaborate with others to align priorities, and drive team efficiency.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.

  • Organization: Can oversee complex projects with multiple moving parts, ensure team alignment with organizational systems, and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Can communicate effectively, build relationships, resolve conflicts, influence others, and support others in developing their interpersonal skills in major situations.

Skill Level Requirements

Platform and Architecture

  • Account and environment design

  • Warehouse and compute architecture

  • Open table format strategy

  • Connectivity and data residency design

  • Cost architecture decisions that impact long-term scalability and affordability

The ability to design platforms that remain operationally and financially sustainable at scale is critical.

Migration and Consolidation

  • Migrating enterprises from SAP, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, appliance platforms, and increasingly other cloud data warehouses

  • Assessments and migration planning

  • Wave planning and execution

  • Schema and workload conversion

  • Reconciliation and parity validation

  • Cutover planning and execution

Experience extracting data from tightly licensed ERP environments is highly valuable, including understanding:

  • Inherited semantic layers

  • Data extraction challenges

  • Commercial licensing considerations

Data Engineering and Pipelines

  • Data ingestion

  • Data transformation

  • Pipeline orchestration

  • Testing frameworks

  • Data quality instrumentation

  • Building reliable, production-ready engineering processes rather than proof-of-concept implementations

Semantic and Context Layer

Experience designing and implementing:

  • Consistent business definitions that can be used across the organization

  • Shared semantic layers consumable by people, BI tools, and AI agents

  • Enterprise data models that ensure consistency across downstream consumers

This is an area of increasing investment within Snowflake and an area where many customers require significant guidance.

Governance at the Perimeter

  • Access policies

  • Data masking

※後半に日本語の説明があります

C# software engineering position in a highly-growing startup, developing a document IDE for non-engineers.

About BoostDraft

BoostDraft is a software engineering company that develops IDE for documents. It was founded by MIT and Stanford grad students, developing an assisted document editor for documents. It is a new document editor that employs error checking, reference checking and auto-completion using both rule-based approach and NLP, like what coding editors/IDE (e.g. VSCode, Pycharm) do.

Please find more information here:

Background & Traction

We are currently focusing on Lawyers who draft relatively standardized but long documents, such as contracts. With only four years after our product launch, we already have more than 10,000 active paid users. We have several long-term, large-scale contracts with famed enterprises and law firms. As a result, we achieved significant success, including profitability and exponential growth, all without relying on external funding for nearly four years.

BoostDraft was accepted by prestigious accelerator program, MassChallenge (Top 30 US accelerator), StartX (Stanford Accelerator, 7% acceptance rate), MIT Sandbox (Accelerator of Massachusetts Institute of Technology)

Join our Engineering-First Team

At BoostDraft, we prioritize quality over quantity. As an engineering-first company. Around 50-60% of our team members are software engineers with extensive experiences from companies such as Microsoft, IBM, HTC, Yahoo!, and R&D in NTT.

Technical Challenges We Solve

  • Performance improvement using both partial analysis and full analysis
  • Synchronization between user input and on-memory text
  • Cache efficiency to increase highlight performance t during/after user input
  • Security preserving Natural Language Processing, such as Federated Learning

What’s your challenge

As a C# Software Engineer at BoostDraft, you will be tackling challenging technical problems, including:

  • Design and implement classes and methods for IDE for documents
  • Refactor existing code for better extensibility
  • Interview with our users to understand their daily work and pain points
  • Propose both innovative ideas and feasible ideas to achieve unprecedented features

【Languages】 C#,（partially）Rust, Python

【FW】.NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0

【DB】 SQLite, Amazon RDS

【Log Analysis】 AWS CloudWatch, Elasticsearch + Kibana, BigQuery

【CI/CD】 GitHub, GitHub Actions（Self-hosted runner (Windows)）, Azure DevOps

Ensuring a Fair and Secure Recruitment Process:

In recent years, there has been a growing number of applications submitted with fake or AI-generated profiles, including fabricated work history or impersonated identities. At BoostDraft, we are committed to providing a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates and have implemented the following measures:

  • During online interviews, the use of both camera and microphone is mandatory. If we detect suspicious behavior, we may ask you to disable video filters or perform a simple on-screen action. If you are unable or unwilling to comply, the interview may be terminated on the spot.
  • By applying for a position or participating in an interview, you are deemed to have agreed to these measures and to cooperate if such requests are reasonably made.

These measures are applied equally to all candidates to ensure a trustworthy and fair hiring environment. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

If you have any concerns or questions regarding these measures, please feel free to contact our recruiting team.

事業内容

弊社はVS CodeやIntelli J等のIDEのコンセプトを法務文書領域に適用した、支援機能付きドキュメントエディタの開発を行っております。

ソフトウェア開発者がIDEのさまざまな支援機能によって本質的なコーディングに集中できている事実に着想を得て、法律文書に特化した同様の支援機能をMicrosoft Wordのアドインとして実装することで、ユーザが法務文書作成時の本質的な作業に注力できるようにするものです。顧客の大半は弁護士事務所および企業法務部で、大規模・中規模弁護士事務所はほぼすべて、多数の大企業に導入していただいております。そして、創業からすぐに高い収益を上げたことから、約四年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

権威のあるアクセラレータープログラムである、MassChallenge (米国トップ30アクセラレータ)、StartX (スタンフォードアクセラレータ、採択率7%)、MIT Sandbox (マサチューセッツ工科大学アクセラレータ)に受け入れられてきた実績があります。

会社紹介資料:

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • プロダクト開発を中心とした組織作り
    • CEOのSeanをはじめとし、社員の約5割がエンジニア職で構成されており、各メンバーはMicrosoft, IBM, HTC, LINEヤフー, NTT研究所などの有力企業で経験を積んでいます。
  • 研究開発への投資
    • IDEの概念を応用し、バージョン管理・比較、パッケージ管理、プラグイン等、他のソフトウェアとの連携・拡張を実現する予定です。
  • 事業の成長性
    • 創業一年目から継続して黒字経営を行っているなど、日系スタートアップの中では稀な成長の軌跡を達成しています。すでに米国や韓国をはじめとした国外でも事業を展開しています。

私たちが解決する技術的課題:

  • 部分的解析と全体解析の両方を活用したパフォーマンスの向上

近年、AI技術を活用した偽装プロフィール（架空の経歴や人物）による応募が国内外で増加しています。BoostDraftでは、すべての候補者に公平で安全な採用プロセスを提供するため、以下の対策を講じています。

jobs.excerpt: Remote, Philippines Salary: 45k - 72k Experience: 3-7 Yrs Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters Shift: • U.
jobs.description:
Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • U.S. Eastern Time: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Philippine Time:

    • 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM (during U.S. Daylight Saving Time)

    • 9:00 PM – 7:00 AM (during U.S. Standard Time)

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius seeks a Key Customers Solutions Architect to support key and strategic Nebius GPU Cloud services customers. In this role, you will be a trusted technical advisor, helping clients design, deploy, and scale AI solutions while managing large-scale GPU workloads involving hundreds to thousands of GPUs. You will also collaborate with sales and product teams to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States or Canada.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact, troubleshooting and resolving complex AI/ML.
  • Guide customers in optimizing GPU performance for ML training and inference workloads, ensuring seamless integration and scalability.
  • Partner with the sales team to identify new opportunities, promote the latest products, and deliver technical presentations.
  • Act as a bridge to product teams, providing customer feedback, relaying feature requests, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders, negotiate solutions, and effectively drive alignment to address customer challenges.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience: 5 - 10 + years in roles like Cloud Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Customer Engineer, with hands-on experience in cloud services and AI/ML workloads.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Ansible.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and Python programming.
  • Solid understanding of GPU computing, including ML training, inference workloads, and GPU stacks (e.g., CUDA, OpenCL).

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

AI Digital Product Sr Manager – Agentic Platform (REMOTE)

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Drive the evolution of a reusable enterprise Agentic Ecosystem that includes agent orchestration, memory, tool integration, model routing, identity, observability, deployment services, and governance capabilities.

Define evaluation frameworks for quality, safety, reliability, latency, hallucination risk, cost, and business outcomes.

Who we are:

At Workplace Options (WPO), we deliver human-centric solutions that empower people to thrive - personally and professionally. With a global team of more than 4,800 professionals, we provide real-time emotional support, therapy, coaching, mindfulness, and family services to millions worldwide. Since 1982, we’ve partnered with employers, health plans, and insurers to design flexible, forward-thinking programs that evolve alongside today’s changing workforce.

Today, we support 160 million people across 150,000 organizations, including over half of Fortune 500 companies. Now part of the TELUS Health family, we are expanding our global impact by combining decades of wellbeing expertise. Together, we’re building healthier, more resilient organizations—one person at a time.

Current opportunity: Proposal Specialist

Location: United States

Onsite/Hybrid/Remote: Remote
Required Languages: English
Required Experience: 5+ years
Hours: 10am- 6pm EST
Salary: 60,000 -70,000 USD


What you will do:

As a Proposal Specialist, you will manage the proposal process from RFP receipt to submission. This includes assessing compliance requirements, identifying risks, scheduling and facilitating meetings, creating templates, identifying boilerplate content, and collecting core qualification materials (e.g., resumes, biographies, project qualifications, references, certifications, company information). You will also be responsible for assigning responsibilities, monitoring working drafts, editing and formatting drafts, and submitting final materials via email, web portal, or hard copy shipment. Collaboration with various departments to gather necessary information, ensure proposals are accurate and compelling, and meet submission deadlines is essential.

Responsibilities:

Proposal Development:

  • Develop and write high-quality proposals in response to RFX and other solicitation documents.
  • Gather necessary information from internal stakeholders and ensure proposals align with client needs and company capabilities.
  • Create proposal outlines and compliance matrices to meet all requirements.
  • Identify gaps or areas for improvement and address them with SMEs and the SAM Lead.
  • Manage, coordinate, and track daily proposal activities.
  • Communicate and follow up on all data calls, review data received, and request validation/correction as needed.
  • Follow color review procedures and ensure content complies with RFX and WPO standards.
  • Enhance bids with clear, accessible written content.
  • Write bespoke answers to customer questions.
  • Include customer-focused sales messages (win themes).
  • Develop and edit simple graphics or tabular presentations.
  • Identify risks and opportunities.
  • Participate in and/or lead meetings to develop win themes and proposal development strategies.

Content Development and Refinement:
  • Perform project close-out by providing new content to the Content Manager for review and insertion into the Content Library.

Role Tasks:
  • Provide quality assurance and best practice reviews for all proposal documents.
  • Train new proposal contributors on WPO’s proposal process and best practices.
  • Share lessons learned with proposal team and external teams on a quarterly basis.
  • Prepare and present reports to senior management.
  • Perform peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve junior proposal developers' output.
  • Perform FOIA requests and complete SWOT analysis based on responses.
  • Serve as a reviewer for formal reviews (pink, red, white) or as a compliance reviewer on major pursuits.
  • Lead debrief meetings and gather client feedback to support continuous improvement.
  • Lead the preparation of presentation and interview materials.
  • Contribute to internal training on core processes, tools, practices, or special topics.
  • Lead the writing of proposals, including executive summaries, past performance, management approaches, and resumes/staffing for major pursuits.
  • Mentor junior and intermediate proposal specialists/developers.
  • Manage multiple proposals, focusing on project management and quality assurance.

Collaboration:
  • Participate in and/or lead meetings to develop win themes and proposal development strategies.
  • Collaborate with SAM leads, SMEs, corporate resources (Legal, Finance, HR, Marketing), and other collaborators to develop and refine proposals.
  • Coordinate with SMEs, sales, marketing, and other departments to obtain necessary input for proposals.
  • Facilitate proposal review meetings and incorporate feedback from reviewers.
  • Review and critique SME responses.
  • Support the delivery of services/products in line with Proposal Strategy themes, working with cross-functional teams.

Writing and Editing:
  • Write and edit proposal sections to ensure clarity, conciseness, and persuasiveness.
  • Ensure all written materials are free from errors and inconsistencies.
  • Ensure the writing structure and words persuasively convey the offer to the customer.
  • Perform statistical analysis and storytelling around data.

Research:
  • Conduct research to understand client needs, industry trends, and competitor offerings.
  • Integrate findings into proposals to enhance relevance and competitiveness.
  • Track and analyze proposal metrics, such as win rates, to measure the effectiveness of different content approaches and adjust strategies accordingly.

Qualifications/Skills:
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or 5+ years of experience a related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in proposal writing or a related role.
  • Experience managing the complexity of multiple proposals, focusing on project management and quality assurance.
  • Successful collaboration with cross-functional subject matter experts and corporate personnel.
  • Advanced skills using Microsoft Office, Adobe, and InDesign.
  • Excellent understanding of document design elements and marketing techniques.
  • Create win themes and embed stories throughout proposal responses.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and compelling content.
  • Consistent personal ethics: integrity, dependability, initiative, and quality.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Full benefits package, Paid time off, 401k match, Training/tuition reimbursement, Gym reimbursement, Wellness rewards, Access to EAP benefits and all WPO services, Mentorship Program, Employee exchange programme, Comprehensive training provided for this position.

We understand that having a diverse organization is only the beginning and it will require nurturing and care to thrive. We will continue to take action to ensure we achieve equitable and measurable outcomes.

We strive to cultivate a space where diverse voices are not only heard but actively sought out and valued for the unique insights they bring. By embracing and promoting authenticity, we aim to build a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters collaboration, innovation, belonging and personal growth.
