jobs.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is scaling quickly, and we are expanding our Partner Ecosystem team to put additional focus on the overall success of our consulting and technology partners. Anaplan is seeking a Director, Partner Success - AMER to join our Channels & Alliances team, reporting to the VP, Global Partner Growth at Anaplan. Anaplan Partner Success team is on a mission to enable Partners on Anaplan Apps, platform & decision excellence framework to accelerate business success and outcomes.

This is a player-coach role. As a leader and coach of the regional Partner Success team, you will play a pivotal role in building, enabling and scaling the partner ecosystem and the reagional Partner Success Team. As a Partner Success Manager you will also be responsible for partner enablement for a specific territory. This is a role that will collaborate across PS, CS, products, Apps CoEs, marketing, alliances and sales to ensure partners are equipped with the tools, resources, and strategies to successfully market, sell, and implement our Apps-led strategy. This role is key to accelerating our growth and scaling our business through our partner network. The Partner Success team is seen as a strategic driver for increasing Partner adoption and success.

Your Impactand Role

  • Partner Enablement Execution: Lead the execution of a comprehensive partner enablement strategy that aligns with Anaplan’s growth objectives and partner needs. This strategy includes the entire SIs, ISVs, and Cloud partner ecosystem.
  • Partner-led Delivery Excellence Execution: Lead and improve the partner delivery excellence program to ensure high-quality partner-led implementations and best practices, helping Anaplan customers get the most value from Anaplan Apps and Platform.
  • Manage and lead a team of Partner Success specialists: Lead, mentor, and empower a professional team focusing on their career growth and develop a strong workforce that contributes to the winning culture and core values of Anaplan.
  • Joint Operating Model: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Apps CoEs, PS, CS, Lauch and other internal teams to define and execute a joint operating model for the success of the success programs that lead to accelerated GTM outcomes. Design innovative delivery mechanisms in collaboration with PS to ensure effective knowledge transfer and skill development.
  • Outcome Based Enablement: Develop and track key performance indicators to measure the impact of enablement programs, assess partner readiness, and identify opportunities for continuous optimization.
  • You’ll interact with senior leadership internally and externally and play an important role in overall partner advocacy.

Your qualifications, your influence

  • A proven track record of building & scaling enablement programs in a high growth, mid stage Enterprise SaaS company.
  • Experience in managing implementation projects, mitigating projects risks and co-ordinating with internal stakeholders to help partners deliver customer value.
  • 20+ years of experience in high growth SaaS companies, leading teams focused on enabling partners across go-to-market and application/solution development
  • Deep understanding of SaaS and Enterprise Sales business model with an understanding of partner & customer lifecycle measures and SaaS revenue streams.
  • Data-driven with a dedication to process improvement
  • Strong reputation working with inter-disciplinary teams as being innovative, accountable, reliable, and able to thrive in a constantly changing environment
  • Passion for process and experience scaling processes
  • You are a visionary in service with a passion for creating partner value and the ability to lead transformational change
  • 5+ years of management experience. 7+ years industry experience in partner management, solution engineering, delivery consulting, product management type roles
  • Prior experience in a sales-driven organization working with large GSI’s, technology partners and delivering to Fortune 500 clients; Prior experience scaling a consulting and tech partner program, with clear increase in revenue and retention is a plus
  • History of motivating partners at scale, while identifying and developing the right partners for strategic relationships
  • Expert in driving solution discussions with partners on data, AI and ML with expertise in predictive, generative and agentic AI technologies.
Base Salary Range:
$181,000—$244,000 USD

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

jobs.title: Product Manager, Currency Expansion & Payments - Latam
jobs.excerpt: About UsOpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems.
jobs.description:
About Us

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions.

The team’s execution has been exceptional and we are scaling at a remarkable pace. Our early team brings experience from J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium and others, and we are backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NFX and other top-tier investors.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Operations for Latin America to own how new currencies and corridors actually get to market across the region. Every currency we launch unlocks new corridors for our institutional clients and drives trading volume and revenue directly. Your mandate is to make that expansion happen on the ground: sourcing and onboarding liquidity providers, standing up settlement rails with banking partners, clearing jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements, and holding every launch to the reliability bar our clients expect.

You will run the regional launch pipeline with real independence. You will own pricing inputs, sequencing and the go-live decision. You report to the Product Leader of Global Payments & Currencies, who sets strategic prioritisation for which currencies matter most based on payout corridor relevance. You own the how and the when.

If you have shipped cross-border payment products, worked with banking or card network infrastructure, or built API-driven financial products across jurisdictions, this role will feel familiar. The difference is that you will be doing it at the frontier of stablecoin-settled FX infrastructure, where the rails are new and the playbook is yours to write.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own corridor launch, end to end. You own every currency in your regional pipeline from Alpha through General Availability. You track liquidity partner onboarding, settlement rail readiness, regulatory clearance, operational setup and pricing. You run readiness reviews, maintain the launch checklist, and make the go/no-go call.
  • Operationalise our licences. Holding a licence and being able to use it are two different things. You work with Product Management, Legal and Regulatory, Compliance, Finance and Engineering to turn each licence, registration and partner permission into permitted product scope, documented operating procedures and live client flows. You keep what we are authorised to do and what we actually run in market in step, and you make sure new capability reaches clients as soon as the licence allows rather than months later.
  • Work directly with LPs and banking partners. You are the product voice in liquidity provider onboarding and banking partner discussions. You understand what it takes to stand up a new currency pair technically, what banking partners need in order to enable settlement, and how to translate partner constraints into product decisions.
  • Navigate multi-market regulatory complexity. Every currency carries jurisdiction-specific requirements. You work with Legal and Regulatory to establish what is needed, translate it into product and engineering decisions, and ensure no currency launches without clearance.
  • Prioritise engineering effort. You work with engineers to deliver against the roadmap. You write specs, set sprint priorities, and partner with your EM so capacity lands on the highest-impact currencies.
  • Drive post-launch adoption. A currency is not done at launch. You track whether clients are actually trading new corridors, partner with GTM to drive activation, find the friction, and feed what you learn back into prioritisation.
  • Build the regional launch playbook. You turn each launch into a repeatable, documented process covering every dependency, gate criterion and handoff, so the tenth currency is faster than the first.

What We Are Looking For

Must-haves

  • 8+ years in product management, product operations or programme management. You have owned a complex, multi-dependency delivery process in a B2B or infrastructure product.
  • Cross-border payments or financial infrastructure context. You have worked on payments, FX, card networks or digital asset products.
  • Multi-market experience. You have shipped products across multiple countries or regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Comfort operating between product, legal and compliance. You can read a regulatory requirement, work out what it means for a product flow, and drive it to a decision without waiting to be told.
  • Operational rigour. You maintain systems that track complex, multi-dependency work. You build the checklist, follow up on the open item, and catch the gap before it becomes a blocker.
  • Based in Brazil, in São Paulo or remote, and fluent in Portuguese and English.

What helps you stand out

  • LatAm corridor knowledge. Experience with Brazilian and wider LatAm payment rails, regulatory environments or banking partner ecosystems. Spanish is a plus alongside Portuguese.
  • Licensing and regulatory delivery. You have helped operationalise a licence, registration or scheme membership, not just tracked one.
  • Card network or payment scheme background. Time at a card network, payment scheme or large-scale processor with multi-market product launches.
  • Stablecoin or digital asset rails. Familiarity with stablecoin settlement, on and off-ramp infrastructure, or crypto payment products.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Equity in a rapidly growing company
  • The chance to work in a fast-paced startup at the forefront of fintech innovation
  • Real impact on global financial infrastructure
  • A collaborative culture with genuine emphasis on personal and professional growth

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status

jobs.description:
Remote, Latam, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +2 years of experience

Who We Are

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. With a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere with a single integration.

Agnostic by design, Yuno offers connectivity to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, optimizing acceptance rates, reducing costs, and strengthening security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction on the network. Global brands run their payments on Yuno, including Arcos Dorados (McDonald's), NetEase Games, GoFundMe, inDrive, and Rappi. Banks, acquirers, PSPs, and wallets use Yuno to modernize their infrastructure without replacing core systems and to prepare for the next generation of commerce, including agentic payments.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help us unlock new opportunities for our Financial Services vertical by bringing Yuno's payment infrastructure to banks, acquirers, PSP’s, wallets and other financial institutions. This is a front-line commercial role with real strategic weight — you're not just filling a pipeline, you're opening doors into markets that are central to Yuno's growth in the world.

You will identify, engage, and qualify prospects across a diverse and fast-moving landscape, which means you'll need to move quickly, understand local business contexts, and tailor your approach to each market. The ambition here isn't to hit a quota and stop — it's to build relationships that turn into long-term partnerships, and to keep raising the bar on what great prospecting looks like at Yuno.

This role demands someone who treats every conversation as a chance to learn. You'll stay sharp on industry trends, competitor moves, and market shifts across the region — not because you're asked to, but because that curiosity is what keeps your outreach relevant and your pipeline strong. At Yuno, we're always looking for better ways to reach the right people with the right message, and we expect you to bring that same drive to how you work every day.

If you're hungry to grow in sales, energized by the pace of a high-growth fintech, and ready to represent a product that's genuinely changing how companies handle global payments — this role is for you.

Your Contribution Will Be

  • Identify and research potential clients globally, through outbound prospecting, networking, industry events, and digital channels

  • Initiate and maintain meaningful conversations with prospects, uncovering their needs and positioning Yuno's solutions with relevance

  • Present Yuno's Financial Services value proposition clearly and compellingly, addressing questions and objections with confidence

  • Qualify leads and hand off high-potential opportunities to the Business Development team with full context

  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date, ensuring the team always has a clear view of pipeline activity

  • Monitor industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activity across the region to sharpen your prospecting strategy

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Sales leadership to refine outreach messaging and targeting

  • Bring new ideas on how to improve prospecting approaches — if you see a better way, say so

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluent Spanish and English are mandatory — part of the interview process will be conducted in English

  • 2+ years of experience in a prospecting, SDR, or outbound sales role

  • +1 years of experience in banking, financial services or fintech could be a plus.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and a genuine passion for sales

  • Familiarity with CRM software and sales engagement tools

  • Results-driven mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

  • Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

What We Offer at Yuno

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!

  • Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

  • Work Equipment

  • Stock Options

  • Health Plan wherever you are.

  • Flexible Days Off

jobs.excerpt: Company Introduction:Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered.
jobs.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Own the Agent Network Across Your Regions

You own the agent partner relationship across two of Airspace’s four U.S. regions. That includes onboarding new agent partners, running ongoing performance conversations, maintaining the scorecard, and partnering with the Director, Network Operations, and Procurement to decide next steps when a partner isn’t meeting standard. The Regional Network Managers in your two
regions own their region’s overall health and weigh in on judgment calls that affect regional strategy, things like whether agent capacity in a market is adequate, or whether a new agent partnership changes how a region is covered. The day-to-day agent relationship is yours to run.

Onboarding runs through you and Procurement directly. You handle the operational side, credentialing, documentation, system setup, and setting initial performance expectations, while Procurement manages the contract. The scorecard itself is built and maintained by the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations: you apply it on a regular review cadence across both of your regions, use it to decide which partners need a closer look, and send field-level context back so it stays accurate over time. Contract rates are not part of this role.

In practice, this means you’re the one who notices a partner’s numbers slipping before it becomes a service problem, has the conversation about what needs to change, and follows up to see whether it does. When it doesn’t, you partner with the Director, Network Operations, and Procurement to decide next steps, and let the relevant RNM know once it’s resolved.

What You’ll Do

Agent Performance

  • Build and maintain relationships with agent partners across your two regions, staying close enough to the day to day that you know how each partner is actually performing
  • Own agent scorecard management for every courier and agent partner across your two regions — quality, reliability, and coverage — applying and maintaining a scorecard built on the data and methodology the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations provides
  • Track Partner Portal adoption for every agent partner in your two regions as a standing indicator of partnership health, not just a line item on the scorecard — low or no usage is often the earliest sign of a partner who isn’t fully invested, and worth a direct conversation before it shows up as a performance problem elsewhere
  • Monitor performance on an ongoing basis, identifying partners whose performance is falling out of alignment with Airspace’s expectations before it becomes a bigger problem
  • Own and lead performance review conversations with agent partners, using scorecard data and case history to make the case clearly and set expectations for improvement
  • Partner with the Director, Network Operations, and Procurement to decide next steps when an agent partner is not meeting standard after a fair review, keeping the relevant Regional NM informed given their accountability for the region’s overall health

Onboarding and Case Management

  • Own agent onboarding in partnership with Procurement — you handle the operational onboarding, Procurement handles the contract
  • Manage the agent case queue in Salesforce for your two regions, triaging and routing escalations and maintaining accurate documentation

Partner Across the Network Organization

  • Work closely with the two Regional Network Managers in your area — keeping them informed on agent performance and deactivation outcomes in their geography, and partnering with them on judgment calls that affect regional strategy
  • Work closely with the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations as your primary data partner on the agent scorecard — receiving analysis and methodology, and providing ground-truth field context back
  • Partner with Procurement, and with the Director, Network Operations, on the commercial, contractual, and next-step decisions for a performance issue or deactivation — this is a situational partnership tied to service quality, not a standing rate-setting responsibility. Onboarding, by contrast, is a standing partnership with Procurement, not a one-off
  • Coordinate with the Director, Network Operations, and with the other Agent Lead, on agent trends or systemic issues that show up across more than one region
  • Partner with the Director, US Network Solutions when strategic account work or new capability development touches agent partners in your regions — providing operational context on existing agent capacity and standards, and handling onboarding once a new agent partnership is stood up
  • Partner with the Driver Trainers to ensure training modules are being appropriately actioned by agent partners in your regions, flagging completion gaps or engagement issues
  • Support Network Quality & Compliance with agent-related audit documentation and compliance reviews as needed

Requirements

  • At least 2+ years of experience in vendor/partner management, network operations, or account management — experience in logistics, transportation, or a gig/contractor network environment is strongly preferred
  • Experience leading direct, sometimes difficult performance conversations, including decisions to end a partnership when standards aren’t met
  • Experience applying and managing a partner or vendor scorecard process; comfortable working from analytics someone else builds rather than building it yourself
  • Comfortable holding two concurrent regional relationships with enough depth to go beyond surface-level oversight — this role trades breadth for depth compared to a fully centralized model
  • Strong documentation habits; comfortable owning a case queue in Salesforce or a comparable CRM
  • Clear, direct communicator; comfortable owning a performance conversation end to end, and partnering with the Director and Procurement on deactivation decisions, while keeping Regional NMs appropriately informed
  • Strong relationship management skills — you can build trust with two Regional NMs who may have different working styles and regional context, as well as with the Network Strategy & Operations Lead
  • Comfortable operating with a level of autonomy above a coordinator-level role, given the narrower, higher-touch scope of two regions rather than four
  • Willingness to travel periodically to build relationships with agent partners and Regional Network Managers — estimated at less than 20% of time
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Mountain Time zone or Pacific Time zone preferred

Success Metrics

2026

Agent scorecards are current and consistently applied across both of your regions, built on a strong working relationship with the Network Strategy & Operations Lead. Both Regional NMs have clear visibility into agent performance in their geography and know you own the performance conversations and drive deactivation decisions in partnership with the Director and Procurement. Partner Portal adoption is being tracked consistently as part of the scorecard. Performance conversations are happening proactively, not just when an agent partner is already failing. The case queue is current with no aging escalations. Critically, neither Regional NM has personally run an agent performance conversation or made an agent deactivation call.

2027

The scorecard — sharpened over time by the ongoing partnership between this role and the Network Strategy & Operations Lead — has become the standard reference point your two Regional NMs use in agent-related decisions. There is measurable improvement in agent scorecard compliance and Partner Portal adoption across both regions. The two-Agent-Lead model has demonstrated that agent performance conversations and deactivation decisions can run consistently and well without ever landing on a Regional NM’s desk, and without collapsing back into a single centralized seat.

Your First 90 Days

Build relationships with both Regional Network Managers in your area and with the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations. Get fluent in the current agent portfolio, scorecard state, and active cases across both of your regions. Establish a consistent scorecard review cadence and identify where performance conversations are already overdue. Understand how and when to loop in Procurement, and build enough of a relationship there that it’s easy to do when the need arises.

Your First 180 Days

The scorecard process is running consistently across both of your regions, with each Regional NM engaged in regular check-ins rather than hands-on performance work. The case queue is clean and current. Both Regional NMs see you as the person who owns agent performance conversations and drives deactivation decisions, in partnership with the Director and Procurement, in their geography, the partnership with the Network Strategy & Operations Lead is running smoothly in both directions, and Procurement knows who you are when a performance issue needs their input.

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range: $22-$26/hr
  • High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
  • Open PTO
  • 401K with company match

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

A friendly reminder: Airspace will only contact candidates from an @airspace.com email, a no-reply notification from , or a verified LinkedIn profile. We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at before responding.

jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Role Overview

The Director of Product Marketing exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning while building and leading the team that scales that work. In this high-impact role, you will own the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models, direct the team that equips our global sales organization to win, and set the standard for how JumpCloud translates complex platform capabilities into compelling market narratives. You will lead a group of product marketers, developing their craft and their careers while directing cross-functional initiatives across sales, product, and go-to-market teams. Ultimately, you will solve critical business problems by elevating our thought leadership, scaling our market reach, and growing a high-performing product marketing function.

Employee Value Proposition (EVP)

  • Purpose: You will shape how the world perceives and adopts JumpCloud's open directory platform, and you will build the team that carries that mission forward, directly influencing our market share and driving modern identity infrastructure solutions.

  • Growth: You will own major strategic pricing and packaging initiatives, build and scale a product marketing team, expand your influence across executive-level steering committees, and establish yourself and your people as premier industry voices.

  • Motivators: Lead at a high-velocity, tech-forward company where you set direction, hire and develop talent, and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to build processes and sales acceleration assets that directly impact revenue.

Major Performance Objectives

    Measurable outcomes for the first 6-12 months:

  • 6-Month Team Integration and Asset Delivery: Within the first 6 months, integrate fully into the marketing and product organizations, establish operating rhythms for your team, and deliver at least 3 high-value assets while embedding JumpCloud's thought leadership and positioning across key marketing channels.

  • Team Building and Performance: Within 9 months, assess team structure and capability, close priority skill or headcount gaps, and put in place clear goals, coaching cadences, and performance expectations that raise the output and consistency of the product marketing function.

  • Pricing and Packaging Strategy: Within 9 months, direct the analysis, optimization, and rollout of an updated pricing and packaging strategy that simplifies customer onboarding and maximizes average contract value (ACV).

  • Sales Enablement and Competitive Differentiation: By month 12, lead your team to equip the global sales organization with comprehensive competitive differentiators and positioning assets, resulting in increased win rates against key competitors.

  • Platform Evangelism and Thought Leadership: Establish yourself and at least one team member as external speakers for JumpCloud within 12 months, delivering a combined minimum of 4 public demos or presentations across multiple platform feature sets.

  • AI-Driven Process Optimization: Within 12 months, build and scale at least 2 AI-leveraged processes or tools to support the team's execution, while collaborating with the AI steering committee to deploy sales-driven assets that accelerate deal velocity.

Critical Subtasks:

    Supporting activities to achieve objectives:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear goals, running regular one-on-ones, and managing performance to a high standard.

  • Collaborate with product management, sales, and executive leadership to audit and refine current pricing and packaging models.

  • Direct competitive intelligence research across the team to identify clear market differentiators and map the competitive landscape.

  • Oversee the creation of high-impact enablement assets such as pitch decks, battlecards, and demo scripts for the global sales team, ensuring quality and consistency across the function.

  • Partner with the AI steering committee to identify, develop, and deploy AI-driven assets and workflows that accelerate sales deal cycles.

  • Maintain deep command of the JumpCloud platform and enable your team to deliver comprehensive, multi-feature technical demos to customers, partners, and industry analysts.

  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships across sales, product, and go-to-market (GTM) motions to ensure unified messaging.

  • Represent JumpCloud, and position your team members, as speakers and thought leaders at industry events, webinars, and executive briefings.

Required Skills and Experience:

    Must-have functional skills:

  • People management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing product marketers or comparable marketing talent

  • Product Marketing and Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy execution

  • Strategic pricing and packaging design for SaaS or platform technologies

  • Advanced sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and positioning asset creation

    • Preferred domain knowledge:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, or Cloud Security

  • SaaS business models and developer/IT buyer personas

    • Tools or systems knowledge:

  • Modern AI productivity tools and workflow automation platforms

  • Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM and marketing automation systems

    • Behavioral or power skills:

  • Proven team leadership, with the ability to set direction, delegate, and grow people

  • Exceptional public speaking, storytelling, and evangelism capabilities

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building across sales, product, and GTM teams

  • High degree of strategic thinking, process-building capability, and sound judgment under autonomy

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual compensation range for this role, depending on individual candidate level and experience, is $150,000 - $225,000, including base salary and any related bonuses or commissions.

In the US, JumpCloud® provides a comprehensive benefits package, with several medical plans to choose from including a high deductible HSA plan with employer contribution, two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending account (FSA), employee assistance program (EAP), short- and long-term disability, life insurance and a 401k savings plan with match. We have a flexible paid time off policy.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
All roles posted in United States locations do require that you be located within one of the 50 U.S. States. Our Headquarters is in the Denver/Boulder, CO area but as a remote company, you are able to work remotely anywhere in the U.S. If you would like to spend time in our offices in the Denver/Boulder area, you are welcome to do that as well.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

jobs.excerpt: Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities.
jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Location: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

Role Scope:

We are hiring a Product Manager, Strategic Technology Applications to own the product strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional delivery for the technology application portfolio that powers Habitat Health's growing PACE organization. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting within the Strategic Technology Applications team, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

As Habitat Health expands into new markets and scales its center operations, the Strategic Technology Applications team functions as the internal “product organization” for the systems that power clinical, operational, growth, and administrative workflows. This role will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — discovery, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption, and iteration — for a portfolio of applications spanning call/communications, CRM, core operations, growth, and risk adjustment systems.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded healthcare technology leader who is energized by translating clinical and operational needs into a compelling roadmap, partners naturally with internal developers and vendor teams to ship solutions, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve adoption and impact.

Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of strategic technology applications, including but not limited to call/communications platforms (TalkDesk), CRM platform (Salesforce), EHR platform (Epic)
  • Translate operational, clinical, and growth stakeholder needs into a prioritized backlog and roadmap, balancing quick wins against longer-term platform investments
  • Define and track success metrics — adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational impact — to measure product performance and guide iteration
  • Maintain a clear view of the application portfolio's health, dependencies, and integration points (e.g., Salesforce and ancillary clinical/communications tools) to ensure data integrity and a cohesive experience across platforms

Discovery, Delivery & Execution

  • Run discovery with clinical, operational, and growth stakeholders to surface pain points, validate requirements, and shape well-scoped product requirements and user stories
  • Partner with internal analysts (e.g., CRM Admin, EHR Support Analyst, etc.) and external vendors to scope, prioritize, and deliver configuration changes, integrations, and new features
  • Own backlog grooming, sprint/release planning, and prioritization decisions using tools like Jira
  • Lead or co-lead technology application implementations for new PACE center launches, including configuration, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, and go-live support
  • Build repeatable implementation and product-launch playbooks that support Habitat Health's continued growth

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Own day-to-day vendor relationships for managed applications, including performance management, escalations, contract oversight support, and roadmap alignment
  • Evaluate and recommend new technology solutions in partnership with the Director of Strategic Technology Applications; support build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection
  • Serve as a trusted product partner for clinical, operational, and growth teams, translating their needs into the roadmap and communicating trade-offs clearly
  • Represent the Strategic Technology Applications product portfolio in cross-functional forums, governance bodies, and project teams

Adoption, Training & Change Management

  • Partner with training and enablement resources to design rollout, onboarding, and training plans for managed applications across clinical, operational, and administrative end users
  • Track adoption metrics and gather user feedback; feed insights back into the roadmap and configuration priorities
  • Own change management planning for major releases, feature rollouts, and workflow redesigns
  • Maintain clear product documentation, including roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and user-facing support materials

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with hands-on ownership of the roadmap and lifecycle for enterprise or B2B SaaS applications; healthcare or health IT experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience managing or launching SaaS/cloud-based applications (experience with call center platforms, CRM, or clinical ancillary systems a plus)
  • Strong command of product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, backlog management, and agile delivery (Jira or similar)
  • Proven ability to translate business and clinical requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and workflow improvements
  • Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (developers, vendors) and non-technical clinical/operational stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear product documentation, roadmaps, and executive-facing updates
  • Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations or rapid program expansion preferred
  • Familiarity with PACE, Medicare/Medicaid, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TalkDesk, Salesforce, Abridge, Epic or other contact center / CRM / ambient AI documentation /EHR systems
  • Experience with health plan systems (claims, eligibility, encounter submissions) or risk adjustment platforms
  • Background in product delivery or change management methodology

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170,000–$194,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, and $149,000–$185,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Habitat Health is at-will. This means that either the employee or the employer may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job posting or any other company document is intended to create a contract of employment, express or implied, or to alter the at-will nature of employment.

Any written or oral statements to the contrary are not authorized unless made in writing and signed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Because this is a remote position, employment will be governed by the laws applicable to the employee's work location, and applicable legal requirements will be followed.

Vaccination Policy, including COVID-19

To help maintain a safe environment for our participants and team members, Habitat Health maintains vaccination and infection control policies applicable to certain roles and work locations. Are you a true Salesforce Trailblazer - the kind of admin who lights up at a workflow problem and can't help but tinker until it's just right? Are you just as comfortable putting Claude and other AI tools to work, turning tedious documentation and reporting into a five-minute job? If that sounds like you, we'd love to have you join the Revenue Operations team at FireMon. We're a small, passionate, and pretty fun crew sitting right at the heart of FireMon's go-to-market strategy - and we can't wait to meet you.

As our Salesforce Admin, you'll own day-to-day user management, work closely with the entire GTM org (Sales/Marketing/Finance/CS), and recommend best practices, all while keeping our CRM integrations running smoothly. You're a natural communicator who can turn business needs into clean, scalable systems - and you know how to pair your Salesforce chops with AI tools like Claude to get more done, faster.

We're looking for candidates based in the Central or Eastern time zone so you can overlap with our Revenue Operations and Sales/Marketing stakeholders around the globe.

Responsibilities

  • Provide prompt and complete resolution to technical challenges and business support issues related to the CRM instance
  • Manage user profiles, permissions, licenses, and page layouts
  • Maintain existing and new fields, custom objects, workflows, validation rules, managed packages, and integrations
  • Identify opportunities for efficiency, inventing creative yet simple solutions to improve internal and external customer experience
  • Document system processes, train users and contribute to CRM onboarding
  • Partner with global stakeholders to identify and build improvements
  • Work closely with Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Growth Marketing to create “single source of truth” reports/dashboards for sales and marketing organizations
  • Support and maintain integrations across our GTM tech stack, including LeanData (lead routing), ZoomInfo (data enrichment), Gong (conversation intelligence), and Snowflake (data warehouse)

  • 3+ years Salesforce.com administration experience
  • Certified Salesforce.com Administrator

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Design (AI Workflows)
jobs.excerpt: About UsHighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth.
jobs.description:
About UsHighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our PeopleWith over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our ImpactAs of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Design (M4) to lead a high-performing team of product designers focused on AI-powered workflows that span our Product and Revenue product lines — the tools our customers rely on to communicate with their customers. This spans conversations, messaging, automation and intelligence surfaces that sit at the center of how agencies and SMBs run their businesses on HighLevel. You have spent 9+ years designing and leading complex products, including 3+ years managing designers, and are ready to guide a distributed team through ambitious, AI-driven product work.

This role will report to the Senior Director, Product Design and manage approximately 8–12 product designers across the United States and India. You will lead design execution across AI workflow surfaces that cut across our Product and Revenue pillars, helping teams turn customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear, useful product experiences for the conversations and communications that power our customers' businesses.

This is a craft-driven management role for someone who stays close to the work. You will not be the primary production designer, but you should have the taste, product judgment and design fluency to improve direction, sharpen decisions and coach designers — with particular fluency in designing for AI-assisted and AI-generated experiences.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, strong systems thinking and the ability to grow designers through clear expectations, critique, direct feedback and practical coaching. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale — especially where AI is shaping how customers communicate with their own customers.

Experience leading B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, marketing technology, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis, documentation or workflow acceleration is expected, as is experience designing AI-native product experiences (e.g., conversational AI, automation, agentic workflows, or generative communication tools).

What You'll Do

  • Manage, coach and develop 8–12 product designers across US- and India-based teams.
  • Lead design execution for AI-powered workflows spanning Product and Revenue lines — the communication, messaging and automation experiences customers use to reach and engage their own customers.
  • Connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and product strategy across these cross-cutting AI workflow surfaces.
  • Set expectations for quality, accountability, collaboration, communication and delivery.
  • Keep designers focused on the highest-priority work, help them manage ambiguity and clarify what is expected, blocked or ready for decision.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, design leadership and the Senior Director, Product Design to shape roadmaps, clarify tradeoffs and improve outcomes across Product and Revenue AI initiatives.
  • Lead critiques, coaching conversations, quality reviews and launch-readiness discussions that improve usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency, design-system alignment and the quality of AI-assisted experiences.
  • Maintain workstream visibility through useful rituals, crisp updates and timely risk escalation.
  • Hire excellent talent, onboard designers and create clear development plans.
  • Use AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping, synthesis, documentation and production collaboration without lowering the quality bar.

What We Are Looking For

Who We Are

About TSS Advisors

Founded in 1986, TSS has grown to become the largest professional advisory firm headquartered in New Hampshire. With over 90 employees dedicated to the broad range of clients and mix of services seldom seen in a local firm, we have experience and expertise to assist our clients in meeting their goals, whether individuals or business entities, regardless of their size or industry.

At TSS, we recognize that professionals today need to be business consultants, advisors, planners and strategists. We need to be knowledgeable not only in accounting and tax law, but also in business analysis and valuation, estate planning, employee benefit administration and much more.

Over the last few years, we have acknowledged and embraced the fact that the accounting profession and industry is evolving. With this, we are taking our commitment to excellence to a new level by partnering with Ascend. This will accelerate our strategic growth model by providing access to new resources and additional partnership opportunities.

About Ascend

At Ascend, we understand the struggles that accounting & finance professionals face in traditional public accounting firms - from rigid hierarchies, overwhelming workloads, and the elusive work-life balance. It’s time for a transformative change. We believe your ambition should not be constrained by outdated practices or opaque career paths. Here, you're not just a number; you’re a valued member of a community that supports & celebrates your professional & personal fulfillment. Our mission is to transform the public accounting experience into one where work-life harmony is a reality, and where your career advancement is supported by a nurturing network and comprehensive resources.

Ascend empowers entrepreneurial CPAs to reach their goals with an innovative growth model that brings our partner firms into the new age. Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a modern platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while having access to resources of a large firm. These resources include growth capital, robust talent acquisition, best-of-breed technology, a catalytic leadership system, shared back-office services, and modernized equity incentives.

Founded in January 2023, Ascend has already attained revenues sufficient to qualify as a Top 30 U.S. accounting firm. Explore Ascend, where your career soars without sacrificing your quality of life.

The Role

We’re looking for a talented and motivated Client Accountant to lead day-to-day delivery in our client accounting practice. TSS serves clients in the automotive retail, construction, manufacturing, distribution, and other for-profit industries, and many of them rely on us as their accounting department — closing their books, producing their financial statements, and giving their owners a clear read on the business.

This is a hands-on supervisory role. You will own a portfolio of client relationships, review the work of the accountants supporting them, and act as the escalation point when something does not tie out. Our ideal candidate is someone who is equally comfortable in the general ledger and in front of a business owner, and who wants to shape how a growing practice runs rather than just work inside it.

Responsibilities

  • Own the monthly and quarterly close for a portfolio of clients, including bank and credit card reconciliations, accruals, fixed assets, and journal entries
  • Prepare and review compiled financial statements and management reporting packages
  • Review payroll processing, sales and use tax filings, and 1099 reporting prepared by the team
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for client owners, controllers, and office staff
  • Lead onboarding for new client accounting engagements, including chart of accounts design, software conversion, and documentation of recurring procedures
  • Coordinate with the tax team to deliver clean year-end books and supporting workpapers
  • Identify and implement process and technology improvements that reduce manual work across the client base

Requirements

  • 5+ years of client accounting, bookkeeping, or outsourced accounting experience, including work in a public accounting or multi-client environment
  • Prior experience supervising, reviewing, or training accounting staff is a plus
  • Working knowledge of GAAP as applied to closely held businesses
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Excel
  • Strong attention to detail and the judgment to know when something needs escalation
  • Integrity within a professional environment

Preferences

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field
  • QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification
  • Experience with CCH Axcess and cloud accounting workflow tools
  • Experience with payroll platforms and multi-state sales tax compliance
  • Active CPA or CMA

Location

At TSS, we’ve designed a flexible work structure that enables both teamwork and independence, enhancing our employees’ work experience while promoting personal well-being.

What We Offer

We hire good people and give them a good place to work. We truly believe that when you succeed, the firm succeeds, and we make sure you have whatever tools you need to make that success possible.

Join our team and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, health, and ongoing professional growth:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Health, Vision, Dental, and voluntary insurance options
  • 401(K) and match
  • Performance Bonus
  • Annual Community Day

  • Annual firmwide alignment

jobs.excerpt: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations.
jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

Fleetio is writing a new chapter. We are moving from a well-loved product in a category we helped define to a brand that fleet operators, technicians, and executives recognize at first sight and trust on instinct. We put our name on a NASCAR race. We have a car on track with 23XI Racing. We are rebuilding the company narrative around where fleet operations are actually going — not where it has been.

What we need now is the person who makes it all feel like one thing.

As Senior Director of Brand, you own how Fleetio looks, sounds, and shows up — everywhere. Our visual identity. Our editorial voice. Our social presence and video work. Our earned media. The creative expression of the company story across every surface a customer, a candidate, or an analyst will ever touch. You will lead a talented in-house team and a set of agency partners, and report directly to the CMO on a marketing leadership team being rebuilt for the next stage of growth.

This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. The narrative foundation is being set now. You get to define the expression of it.

Fleetio has a product customers love and a story the market has not yet fully heard. Closing that gap is the single highest-leverage thing marketing can do for this company right now. This seat is where that work lives.

What You’ll Own

  • Brand system and creative. Visual identity, creative direction, and design standards across web, campaign, product surfaces, events, and sponsorship — the system that makes Fleetio recognizable in a category where most brands look interchangeable.
  • Content and thought leadership. Editorial strategy and the content engine — thought leadership, long-form, owned research, and the always-on content that builds authority with fleet leaders and feeds organic and AI-driven search.
  • Social and multimedia. Organic social and video as a real channel, not an afterthought — the presence that keeps Fleetio in the conversation between sales cycles.
  • Communications and PR. Earned media strategy in partnership with our PR agency, executive visibility programs, awards, and the messaging discipline that holds across every external moment.
  • Brand activation. Turning our 23XI Racing partnership and our field presence into a year-round content and storytelling engine — not a logo on a car.
  • Team and partners. Hiring, developing, and leading the brand and content team; owning agency relationships, creative operations, and the intake and prioritization system that lets a small team punch far above its weight.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year:

  • The new Fleetio narrative is live and consistent everywhere — from the homepage to the trade show booth to the sales deck — and it looks and sounds unmistakably like us.
  • Awareness and share of voice move measurably in our favor in the fleet management category.
  • The content engine runs at a cadence demand generation, and sales can actually build on, anchored by at least one owned research franchise, the industry cites.
  • The NASCAR partnership produces story, not just impressions — with a content calendar behind every race weekend.
  • The brand and content team is stronger, clearer on standards, and doing the best work of their careers.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in brand leadership, including 4+ years leading and developing teams.
  • You have taken a B2B brand — ideally SaaS, ideally at meaningful scale — through a narrative or identity evolution, and shipped it into market. Not just designed it. Shipped it.
  • You have real taste, editorial and visual, and the judgment to know when good enough ships and when it does not.
  • You are comfortable being measured. Awareness, share of voice, engagement, content-influenced pipeline — you can hold a number and defend it in front of a CEO.
  • You are a genuine partner to product marketing, demand generation, events, and customer marketing. Brand does not work in a room by itself.
  • You have managed agencies well — gotten more out of them than the retainer suggested.
  • You like real-world industries. Our buyers are fleet managers, technicians, and operations leaders. They are not marketers, and they can smell marketing from a mile away.

Nice to Have

  • Sponsorship, partnership, or experiential activation experience — sports, motorsport, or large-scale events.
  • Experience building or running an in-house creative studio.
  • Challenger-brand or category-creation experience against a larger, better-funded incumbent.
  • Fluency in how content strategy is changing under AI-driven search and answer engines.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012

Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

jobs.description:
ABOUT SPHINX

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better.

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sphinx is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team building the next generation of mission planning and command and control software for space communications programs. This team is tasked with creating modern, resilient services and capabilities to support the U.S. Government.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and front-end experiences for Sphinx’s space vehicle mission planning platform, while also working across backend services, APIs, databases, and system integrations. You’ll own well-defined features from development through deployment, collaborate closely with other engineers and cross-functional partners, and help deliver reliable software that meets user and mission needs.

What you will be focusing on:

  • Building intuitive, responsive, and maintainable user experiences using technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, and/or Vue
  • Translating design mockups, user feedback, and defined system requirements into functional and intuitive user interfaces
  • Developing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code while following established engineering practices and standards
  • Owning small-to-medium features from development through testing and deployment, identifying edge cases and raising risks or dependencies along the way
  • Building and improving APIs and backend services that support front-end applications and system capabilities
  • Developing and maintaining backend functionality using technologies such as Python, SQL, RESTful APIs, and containerized architectures
  • Collaborating with QA and other engineering disciplines to understand acceptance criteria, troubleshoot defects, validate functionality, and meet functional and technical requirements
  • Writing and maintaining automated unit, integration, and functional tests to validate software functionality
  • Participating in code reviews, incorporating feedback, and providing constructive feedback to teammates
  • Making sound engineering tradeoffs within your area of ownership and seeking additional context or guidance when appropriate
  • Communicating assumptions, dependencies, and technical considerations early to minimize rework and support successful delivery
  • Contributing to improvements in product usability, quality, security, performance, and maintainability

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • 2–5 years of professional web or software development experience using modern development approaches
  • Strong front-end development fundamentals, including an understanding of modern UI development principles, component-based architecture, responsive design, performance, and usability
  • Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, and/or Vue
  • Experience translating designs, user needs, and defined requirements into production-quality user experiences
  • Full-stack development experience with exposure to backend systems, including Python, API development and integration, application architecture, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL, including querying and integrating data into web applications
  • Experience developing, consuming, and integrating APIs between front-end applications and backend services
  • Familiarity with modern containerized and microservices architectures using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience collaborating with QA throughout the software development lifecycle, including working with acceptance criteria, troubleshooting defects, and validating functionality
  • Experience writing automated tests and developing software against defined user, functional, and technical requirements
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices, including code reviews, version control, automated testing, security, performance, and maintainability
  • Ability to independently own well-defined features, prioritize work, identify edge cases, and communicate risks or dependencies
  • Ability to make sound engineering decisions within familiar problem areas and recognize when additional guidance or clarification is needed
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with engineers, end users, and cross-functional teams
  • Experience developing, testing, or deploying software within air-gapped or highly secure government network environments
  • Ability to hold and maintain a U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance

Bonus points if you have the following:

  • Experience designing and developing intuitive user interfaces featuring real-time, 2D/3D geospatial visualizations
  • Experience building software for mission-critical, defense, aerospace, or other highly secure environments
  • Actively hold a U.S. Government Secret clearance

LOCATION

While this role is remote, the potential for travel may occur such as client visits, company gatherings, and other project related travel as needed may be required.

COMPENSATION

This role is between $130,000 and $157,000 base salary.

BENEFITS

Compensation includes competitive salary, meaningful equity ownership, profit sharing, employer 401(k) contribution, and 100% employer covered medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents.

ELIGIBILITY

Must be a US Citizen and be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance and be eligible to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance .

EEO STATEMENT

At Sphinx Defense, we are devoted to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Sphinx Defense is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
