jobs.description:
About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Sr. Data Engineer with strong data platform experience to help evolve our modern data stack and contribute to the foundation of our emerging AI and ML platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture and machine learning enablement and will bring high-quality, scalable, and ethical AI into real-world use. You will partner closely with data scientists, analysts, and product managers to ensure our platform supports reliable data pipelines, scalable analytics, in addition to defining new architecture, best practices, and patterns for fellow engineers to inherit. The ideal candidate is both a systems thinker and a hands-on builder who thrives in evolving environments and is passionate about creating reliable data infrastructure that enables peers and partner teams to move faster with data. You will have the opportunity to learn and contribute to a machine learning enablement and will bring high-quality, scalable, and ethical AI into real-world use.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable systems for ingestion, transformation, and storage of data, with a focus on testing and observability.
  • Implement frameworks, tooling, and automation to safely increase development velocity.
  • Develop foundational end-to-end AI/ML workflows from (1) source ingestion and preparation, (2) training and tuning, (3) experimentation and productionisation, and (4) downstream systems integration (EHR modules, micro-services, dashboards).
  • Support iterative model development and production operations and observability (accuracy, drift, bias, fairness, reproducibility).
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge-sharing and mentoring of peer engineers.
  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making.

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python with strong familiarity towards modern data engineering frameworks, infrastructure, and tooling
  • Proficiency with data ops best practices, monitoring, pipeline automation, and CI/CD
  • Experience with GCP or AWS data engineering tools, big data frameworks
  • Experience with data modeling and medallion architecture
  • A collaborative mindset, dependable execution, drive to reflect and improve, and humility to ask questions and learn.
  • Comfort using AI tools in day-to-day workflows, with a willingness to continuously rethink and improve how work gets done
  • Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new tools and approaches; prior experience with AI tools is a plus
  • Nice to have:
    • Experience with foundational end-to-end AI/ML workflows from (1) source ingestion and preparation, (2) training and tuning, (3) experimentation and productionization, and (4) downstream systems integration (EHR modules, micro-services, dashboards).
    • Some knowledge of modern compute and ML frameworks/libraries (i.e., Spark, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
    • Some experience with building production APIs and services, inclusive of MCP servers that expose internal data/services to LLMs.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or ML engineering.
  • Experience working with major cloud data platforms and tools:
  • Preferred experience:
    • Healthcare, behavioral health, EHR systems, and/or regulated industries.
    • Specific expertise with: AWS/GCP, dbt, AirflowAirbyte, Redshift/BigQuery.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

  • We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
  • People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.
  • No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.
  • Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.
  • Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.
  • Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.
  • There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.
  • Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.
  • Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation, Equity & Incentives:

Base Salary Range Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location/ zone. Final pay within the posted range will be decided based on a combination of job-related factors, including education, training, experience, and market demands.

  • Geo 1 (All other states & D.C.): $142,600 - $153,100
  • Geo 2 (CO, HI, MD, RI): $156,900 - $168,400
  • Geo 3 (AK, CA, CT, MA, NJ, NY, WA): $164,000 - $176,000

Variable Compensation & Equity

  • Performance Bonus: This role is not currently eligible for bonus incentives.
  • Equity Awards: This role is eligible to participate in Octave’s equity program via Stock Options, subject to the terms of the applicable Equity Incentive Plan.
  • Remote Work Stipend: New full-time employees receive a $300 equipment reimbursement to support a home office setup.
  • Internet & Phone Reimbursement: Full-time employees are eligible for a monthly reimbursement of up to $75 for internet and cell phone related expenses.

Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Octave will not discharge or in any other manner coerce, intimidate, threaten, discriminate or retaliate against employees or applicants because they have: (i) inquired about, discussed, compared, or disclosed their own wages, benefits, or other compensation, or the wages, benefits, or other compensation of another employee or applicant; (ii) asked Octave to provide a reason for the employee's wages or lack of opportunity for advancement; or (iii) aided or encouraged others in exercising their rights to discuss wages, compensation, or benefits, or to seek pay equity.

However, except as otherwise provided by law, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) in compliance with the company's legal duty to furnish information under applicable law .

Comprehensive Benefits:

At Octave, we believe in supporting the "human being first". Here’s a snapshot of the benefits available to eligible employees:

  • Health & Wellness: Choose what works best for you with one High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) and two PPO medical plan options, plus comprehensive Dental and Vision coverage.
  • Medical Support: Enjoy access to a company-sponsored membership with One Medical for convenient, modern care.
  • Retirement: Plan for your future with a 401(k) that offers both traditional and Roth options.
  • Paid Time Off: Time to recharge matters. Take advantage of a generous time off policy, up to 15 paid company holidays, and accrued sick time.
  • Financial Protection: We’ve got you covered with company-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance, plus optional extras like Pet, Legal, and Worksite plans (Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, and Accident).
  • Parental Leave (Bonding Time): Growing your family? Full-time employees can take paid bonding leave after 6 months, whether it’s a new baby, adoption, or foster placement. Time off increases with tenure.
  • Growth: Keep learning and leveling up with professional development reimbursement for role-related growth opportunities.

How We Use Technology in Hiring:

As part of our hiring process, we may use technology tools, including AI-supported systems, to assist with reviewing applications or documenting interviews. These tools are designed to support our team, not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are always made by our team.

jobs.description:
Dispatch is redefining how the world experiences home and field service. Founded in 2013 and trusted by leading brands and service providers, we power seamless, reliable service experiences through a modern platform built for scale. Our platform gives businesses the visibility, communication, and control they need to manage every step of the service journey, from job acceptance through completion. With the acquisition of Youreka in 2023, Dispatch expanded its capabilities to include a leading Salesforce-native Smart Forms application that equips mobile workers with guided workflows, improves field execution and customer service, and scales to support complex enterprise operations.

As part of Manos Software, a Valsoft operating group, Dispatch combines the focus and agility of a specialized software company with the long-term support of a global vertical SaaS organization. We’re investing in our product, our customers, and our team with a focus on sustainable, profitable growth.

We're now investing in a dedicated marketing function to match the strength of our product and customer base, and we're hiring our first Director of Demand Generation to build it.

THE ROLE:

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Demand Generation will own demand generation for Dispatch and Youreka, reshaping what marketing means for the company and our products. This role also owns our Business Development Representative team's strategy and targets, working primarily through our existing BDR team lead. This is a hands-on, builder role: you'll set strategy and run campaigns yourself in the early days, then pursue growth within the marketing team as the function proves out.

AS THE DIRECTOR OF DEMAND GENERATION, YOU WILL:

  • Demand generation & growth - assess Dispatch's situation from first principles to determine where marketing should focus (paid acquisition, lifecycle/email, organic, and other channels); own the marketing automation and CRM stack; generate and manage a healthy, measurable pipeline in close partnership with sales. Building this out is the top priority for this role.
  • Product-market fit & positioning — identify, through testing and analysis, which segments, use cases, and messages actually convert; use that to sharpen demand-gen targeting and messaging, and share findings with our Product Marketing team to inform their formal positioning work.
  • Content — build a content engine (website copy, case studies, thought leadership) that supports demand generation and conversion.
  • Team leadership - own strategy and targets for our BDR team, working closely with the existing Lead BDR and aligning team output with the broader demand generation strategy. You will also manage an existing marketing team resource and help define future role additions over time.
  • Diagnose marketing channel mix for Dispatch’s products - prioritizing investment accordingly.
  • Establish the processes, reporting, and KPIs the function will run on.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 5–10 years of marketing experience including specific focus on demand generation and program definition.
  • A startup-tested operator - comfortable being hands-on and building programs with limited resources, not just directing an existing team.
  • A proven track record of owning a marketing function or team from an early stage.
  • Proven, hands-on experience managing a demand-generation/marketing function is required. Experience managing a team on a sales-style comp plan - such as a BDR, SDR, or inside-sales function - is a plus.
  • An analytical, first-principles thinker who can diagnose which channels and tactics actually drive results for a given business, rather than defaulting to a standard playbook - we're counting on you to help define our ideal marketing mix, not just execute one.
  • A strong written communicator who can turn technical or operational product value into compelling brand and content narratives.
  • B2B SaaS experience preferred; experience in field service, home services, or enterprise software is a plus.

WITHIN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL:

  • Build a functioning marketing engine - team, tools, and process, revamped from a lean starting point and working closely with our Senior Marketing Manager.
  • Define a clear, data-backed point of view on where Dispatch should focus its marketing investment, measurable pipeline/revenue contribution from marketing, and BDR-driven programs.
  • Develop sharper product positioning and messaging along with marketing support delivered for major product launches and market expansions.
  • Be viewed internally and externally as a strategic leader for Dispatch’s growth functions.

SALARY:

The base salary range for this role is between $160,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits.

LOCATION:

Dispatch fully accommodates remote work, as long as you have a permanent residence in the US and reside in one of our registered states. Want to spend a month in Italy? Great, do it! Live in Idaho? Sweet, we have another team member there! As long as you are crushing your goals and helping us drive the business forward, you do you. We also have an office in Boston that is open and available for you to use.

WE HAVE:

  • An amazing team focused on innovating and improving every day
  • Room for growth and an emphasis on talent development, including a professional development reimbursement program
  • A fun, casual team environment with co-workers who will make you feel like an important part of our team, engage you in developing new solutions to challenging problems, and help you leverage your strengths
  • A generous medical, dental, and vision package with 90% covered by us
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-sponsored life insurance coverage, short-term disability, and long-term disability
  • Additional perks including a wellness and adventure fund, as well as monthly personal Uber credits
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 company holidays, and a flexible work schedule

STILL WITH US?

We’re ready to meet you if you wake up every day excited to build strategic customer partnerships, lead complex commercial conversations, and find new ways to grow the impact Dispatch has within our customers.

Not a fit? Keep an eye on our Careers Page for other positions!

As our Project Manager of Incident Response, you will be primarily dedicated to external, client-facing projects within our Incident Response team. You will be the driving force behind successful, thorough, and robust project deliverables that result in progressive change and secure enhancements to our client’s technical environments. As the primary face of the team on client calls, you will field questions, establish trust, and set precedent as the go-to person for all incident-related matters. You will be tasked with understanding the current state of an incident, establishing ownership of the overall direction of containment and recovery, and ensuring all parties are aligned with the verticals defined. Constantly in sync with the primary lead engineer leading containment and recovery strategies and delivering agreed-upon strategic initiatives to all parties, you will work as part of a dynamic, flexing team – ready to respond at a moment’s notice mapping into your team's on-call rotation. This position will report directly to our Director of Incident Response PMO.

Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):

Project Management

  • Coordinates multiple, external technical projects from inception to completion:
    • Follows established core processes, project templates, and methodologies
    • Takes a lead in Professional Services stand-ups & meetings
    • Collaborates on project planning, project design, preparation of deliverables, timelining, and contingency planning
    • Understands SOW requirements and converts them into realistic, executable project plans
    • Manages the project resources to effectively execute on-time deliverables
    • Tracks and manages the project budget from the outset through successful completion

    • Assists in the initial triage and establishment of access for project kick-off
    • Drives team’s development of project proposals and scope documentation
    • Leverages conflict management techniques to address disagreements
    • Assigns and aligns necessary resources, understanding resource requirements and capacity (perm or contracted) on projects, maximizing available resources and leveraging each engineer’s skill set effectively
    • Follows up with engineers on a weekly, daily, or (when necessary) hourly basis to understand the progress of their assigned work and to identify potential roadblocks
  • Monitors and summarizes progress of project(s) to stakeholders:
    • Company Leadership
    • Finance
    • Client Contacts and IR Partners
  • Sets and conducts status meetings with client contacts, keeping them informed of progress and setting proper expectations
    • Leads the creation of PowerPoint presentations and project reports as required for large projects
    • Participates in incident response on-call rotation for incoming IR projects
  • Identifies and understands when it is necessary to escalate issues to higher-level resources
  • Addresses billing disputes, overruns, and customer service issues with meaningful resolutions, looping in additional Entara resources as necessary
  • Conducts post-mortems to outline lessons learned and improve internal processes

Problem Solving

  • Becomes an active part of project teams solving technical or business roadblocks until a resolution is reached and the outcome is personally verified
  • Perseveres in making sound judgment calls when lacking one or more desired resources or data points
  • Challenges technical or business requirements ensuring that we deliver the right solution, at the right price, at the right time
  • Leverages and employs an understanding of intermediate to advanced systems configuration, management, and maintenance in areas including the following (this is a sample but not exhaustive listing of work areas and project tasks assigned to our IR-focused engineers):
  • Microsoft-related technologies: Windows Server, Exchange, SQL Server, SharePoint, Active Directory, GPO, LAPS, SCCM, MDT, Intune, 0365, Azure etc.
  • Virtualization technologies: VMware and Microsoft Hyper V
    • Restore and reimage virtual servers from images and various backup solutions
    • Restore and rebuild ESX and Hyper-V hosts, domain controller, etc.
  • Mount ISOs to virtual systems
  • Upload virtual templates to any hypervisor
  • Out of Band access to Physical systems
  • Leverage console access such as ILO and iDrac to establish remote connection to offline physical systems
  • Backup and disaster recovery solutions for both desktops and servers
  • Access solutions: VPN, Remote Desktop, Citrix, etc.
  • Diagnostic tools; review event logs, Syslogs, monitoring data, and memory dumps to troubleshoot issues.
  • Security-enhancing solutions for systems and applications (including MFA and endpoint protection).

Metrics Measuring Success

  • Maintains billable utilization targets
  • Ensures all mandatory reports are generated and updated daily
  • Meets or exceeds deadlines for all assigned projects
  • Keeps projects profitable while not skimping on quality
  • Leverages cost variance and schedule variance formulas to measure project success
  • Contributes to the team’s attainment of high customer satisfaction scores on project delivery
  • Records complete change details, time worked entries, and work notes in ServiceNow in real-time
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvement

Following Process

  • Follows Abacus’s project process to execute project deliverables: configure, test, implement, refine, document, monitor, and transition to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Follows Abacus’s Change Management Process to perform approved changes in client environments
  • Communicates internally and (as directed) externally to provide timely information regarding project status, promised follow-ups, and requested feedback on a detailed and professional basis.

Skills and Experience:

  • You’re a knowledge seeker. Regardless of method, you have obtained and exposed yourself to knowledge centers that have qualified you to master technical project delivery and the systems engineering required to successfully recover, deploy, and enhance infrastructures. You ideally have a four-year degree in a relevant field and are working towards or have already obtained your PMP certification.
  • You’ve managed projects as the assigned “PM” instead of only having delivered them as an engineer. You enjoy the dynamic of wearing multiple hats and taking the lead on client-facing communication, expectations, and timelines.
  • You’ve owned client-facing projects and have established a consultative rapport resulting in high client satisfaction levels upon project closure.
  • You have at least 5 years of experience delivering IT waterfall projects working with systems and virtualization with exposure to enterprise infrastructures.
  • You keep us true to our word. You have a tried-and-true organizational system to keep yourself (and others) on task while ensuring exceptional quality.
  • You possess a winning combination of superb writing skills and highly refined verbal communication skills. You convey energy, confidence, and genuine interest over a call just as easily as you convey competence, professionalism, and trustworthiness in person. You translate to a C-Suite audience as seamlessly as you “talk tech” with engineers. Your emails are professionally worded, grammatically pristine, with the right pinch of personality. In any medium, you pride yourself in clear, effective, and persuasive communication.
  • You have an approach to working hours that is more adaptable than the traditional "9-to-5". As this team responds to business-critical remediation projects, we are looking for an individual who is career-driven and won’t shrink back when work requirements extend into evenings, weekends, and holidays. While travel is minimal, you’re also open to getting on a plane when needed to be present at client sites when a project requires it. On the flip side, your hard work is rewarded with a generous comp plan that grows with the efforts you contribute, a flexible PTO policy, and an equally inspiring team that climbs mountains together.
  • You are ready to be an effective remote worker and have a dedicated, private space for a home office with a private internet connection with at least 50MBPS bandwidth. Public WiFi and shared common spaces do not meet these standards.

Desired Personality Traits:

  • A Mythical Character. You aren’t alarmed when someone expects you to be a hero; in fact, you pride yourself on frequently delivering big just when all hope seems lost. Your persistence is notable, and you are a determined soul who insists on turning “We can’t” into “We can” If you meet a roadblock, you’ll try to scale it, dodge it, or blast through it before ever admitting defeat.
  • The Devil is in the Details. You have an angelic ability to sort through chaos and make order. Your eye and attention for details helps you uncover hidden gems, while your thorough documentation and status updates capture and convey every facet of each stone.
  • Corporate Usain Bolt. You’re capable of moving rapidly from task to task without getting rattled. Your desk is clear, your email inbox is empty, your kitchen counters aren’t cluttered, and you never spend 15 minutes tearing around the house in a desperate hunt for your car keys or train pass. You are a lean, mean, well-oiled machine.
  • A Combo Meal. Your style is winningly ambidextrous. While you are known to be a loyal teammate and never falter on your commitment to seeing others thrive, you are not a push-over. You will fight back and advocate for the best marriage of client desires and superb delivery-pushing us along the path towards perfection. If Samwise Gamgee and Monica Geller had a child, it would be you.
  • Emotionally Mature. Through your years of experience, you’ve learned that occasional hiccups are inevitable and now know enough to just keep moving towards the end goal. You’re calm under pressure, encourage respectful dialog, and understand that communication is the balm that can soothe the sting of conflict.

The Senior Product Designer is responsible for creating solutions for a core product line, and collaborating across teams (Product, Technology, Research) to execute. This role will serve as a key influencer and liaison between Product Management and Technology teams to ensure quality and consistency of our solutions from concept through delivery. The Senior Product Designer will lead solutioning on a combination of new product features and enhancements to existing capabilities, leveraging a solid base in user-centered design principles and user empathy to improve our products and increase satisfaction.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the design process for features and enhancements from ideation to implementation
  • Work with relevant Design and Product stakeholders to understand overall long-term vision and objectives and help execute on pieces of that vision
  • Lead relevant user research efforts and synthesize insights to inform design decisions and develop user-centered solutions
  • Create high-fidelity prototypes, wireframes, workflows, and visual designs that communicate requirements and objectives that align with our design system
  • Work closely with agile development teams to ensure designs are implemented accurately and effectively
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles and educate stakeholders and teammates on the value of design thinking in product development
  • Be a key contributor and influencer to our design system and overall design process
  • Be a key voice within your team(s) to represent the voice of our customers by articulating their objectives and pain points
  • Participate in team ceremonies to advocate for the objectives of the Product Design team
  • Periodically lead design studios or other relevant ideation exercises within your team(s)
  • Drive innovation and push boundaries in product design by exploring new technologies and design trends and how they can thoughtfully be applied to our objectives

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in design or related field a plus
  • 6+ years of experience in product design or related roles
  • Demonstrated expertise in solving complex design problems and delivering impactful design solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly on complex product areas
  • Experience in financial services is a plus

Skills

  • Strong understanding of design systems, information architecture, and interaction design principles
  • Excellent communication skills to influence stakeholders and drive design initiatives
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution with the ability to understand business goals and user needs and align design solutions with both.
  • Ability to synthesize discussions and quickly prototype ideas
  • Good persuasive storytelling and reasoning skills to humanize complex concepts to build understanding and alignment
  • Expert level skills in Figma, Adobe Suite and other modern design tools
  • Basic understanding of fundamental business concepts related to how our SaaS business functions and how our clients operate
  • Strong collaboration and facilitation skills, including ability to create and run group workshops
  • Strong problem solving and creative thinking skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Demonstrated empathy for our users, understanding their needs, motivations, and pain points to design solutions that are intuitive and effective.
  • Ability to advocate for and execute research projects as necessary

The salary range for this position is $119,000 - $156,000; commensurate salary to be determined based on skills, professional background and expertise. This position is also eligible, pursuant to applicable eMoney policies, for the annual bonus program, retirement contributions, health insurance, sick leave, parental leave and paid time off.

At eMoney Advisor, our mission is to help people talk about money. Founded in 2000, it’s the only wealth management system that offers transparency, security, mobile access, and superior organization. Our award-winning, web-based services and resources are designed to amplify advisors' value to their clients. Today, we serve more than 109,000 financial professionals and support over 6 million end clients.

At eMoney, we create and nurture a culture that values diversity and inclusion, which enables our employees to thrive and do their best work. Different ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds inspire a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results.

eMoney is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.description:
About Manifest

Manifest is on a mission to secure the global software and AI supply chain. Our platform automates the discovery and analysis of risks across internally built and third-party software and AI systems, giving security, product, and engineering teams complete visibility into the components and dependencies that make up their technology stack. From product security and AI risk to supplier risk and compliance, we help teams trust the software and AI they build and buy.

Founded by alumni from the Department of Defense, CISA, and Palantir, Manifest is backed by leading investors including Ensemble VC, First Round Capital, Homebrew, BoxGroup, XYZ Venture Capital, AE Ventures, Leap435, and Overmatch VC. The company partners with the US Air Force, DHS, Global 2000 companies, and critical infrastructure organizations across defense, automotive, and financial services to bring transparency, resilience, and trust to modern digital systems.

About the Role

As a Customer Success Engineer at Manifest Cyber, you will own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of large enterprise and government customers, ensuring they realize measurable value from the Manifest platform from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

Reporting to the Head of Business Operations, you'll act as a trusted advisor on software supply chain security and AI risk, working closely with security, engineering, GRC, and procurement stakeholders at some of the most highly regulated organizations in the world. This role requires someone comfortable operating in technical conversations, navigating complex enterprise and federal customer environments, and translating customer needs into product and account strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own onboarding, adoption, and renewal for a portfolio of large enterprise and government accounts, serving as the primary point of contact after the sale.
  • Develop deep relationships with customer stakeholders across security, engineering, compliance/GRC, and procurement, and map their goals to Manifest's platform capabilities.
  • Drive product adoption by helping customers configure code and dependency scanning tools in CI/CD pipelines, vulnerability management workflows, and third-party risk workflows that fit their environment.
  • Monitor account health, proactively identify risk of churn or underutilization, and build action plans to address it.
  • Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities and provide input on account strategy for your book of business.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, relaying feedback to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.
  • Build and maintain customer-facing materials, including onboarding plans, business reviews, and success plans.
  • Troubleshoot technical questions independently where possible, working with databases, APIs, and JSON-based data (including SBOM/AIBOM/CryptographyBOM formats like SPDX and CycloneDX), and looping in Engineering or Support when deeper investigation is needed.
  • Use basic scripting to investigate data issues, validate integrations, or build lightweight reporting for customers.
  • Apply frontier AI tools to work more efficiently, such as drafting customer communications, summarizing account activity, analyzing data, and researching customer environments.
  • Travel periodically to meet with customers on-site, with particular focus on the greater Washington, D.C. area.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, or similar customer-facing role, ideally supporting large enterprise customers with complex, multi-stakeholder relationships.
  • Experience supporting U.S. government customers, particularly within the federal civilian sector, including familiarity with how government agencies evaluate, procure, and operationalize software.
  • Strong track record in cybersecurity and/or SaaS customer success, including driving adoption, managing renewals, and reducing churn.
  • Technical skills:
    • Comfort working with technical systems and data, including relational databases, REST APIs, and JSON schemas, with the ability to read and troubleshoot at a working technical level.
    • Ability to write basic scripts (e.g., Python, shell, or similar) to investigate issues, automate small tasks, or support reporting.
    • Familiarity with software supply chain security concepts, including Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and AI Bills of Materials (AIBOMs), and standards such as SPDX and CycloneDX.
    • Comfort using frontier AI models (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of daily workflow to troubleshoot integrations, fix poorly formatted BOMs, and improve efficiency and quality of work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for both highly technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel periodically, especially to the greater Washington, D.C. area, to meet with customers in person.
  • US Citizenship is required for this role.

Nice To Haves

  • Active security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, GRC, or third-party risk management workflows.

Compensation

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location.

$158,200 – $169,500 OTE (base salary + performance bonus)

Benefits

  • Help organizations get new-found visibility into their software, and be more secure!
  • Fully remote work (with potential for hybrid co-working)
  • Unlimited PTO (which we take seriously)
  • 100% medical/dental/vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents!
  • 401(k) and retirement options
  • Help get in at the ground floor of a well-funded, early-stage startup!
  • A collaborative, mission-driven team built from diverse backgrounds across national security, defense, enterprise technology, and beyond.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Finance & Modeling
jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How we support you:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment, 20 days 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!
In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.description:
AI Visibility Strategist

Full-time · Remote-first (Canada) · Reports to the Head of Advisory

About podium iq

AI models now decide who gets recommended, considered and chosen. We measure how enterprise brands show up inside those answers, score them against the competitors that actually appear, and turn the finding into a content plan. Then we ship the content. Most of this category stops at the dashboard - we don’t, which is why our clients are financial institutions, global consumer technology brands, national regulating bodies, and major consulting firms.


What the work looks like

It starts with a conversation rather than a query. A client arrives with something they want to understand, usually phrased more vaguely than they realize, and your first job is to turn it into a question worth measuring. Get that wrong and the run is a beautifully rendered answer to nothing, which is the most expensive mistake available to us.

Then the results come back and you interrogate them. The platform surfaces the pattern and ranks the recommendation. You bring the market context, the competitive read and the client knowledge that turns a strong recommendation into the right one for that business, this quarter.

The third part is making sure the fix can be found. Answer engine optimization is yours: structure, schema, internal linking, architecture, and the retrieval signals that decide whether a page gets cited or sits there unread. You will brief the content, review it, and hold the quality line before anything reaches a client.

You do all of this beside our founder and our head of advisory to begin with, on live enterprise accounts, learning the method on real work rather than in a deck. Then you take accounts of your own, and we would like that to happen quickly.

Interested? Keep reading.

What we’re looking for

  • Six or more years in SEO, content strategy or digital strategy, spent owning the thinking rather than executing someone else's.

  • Real AEO and SEO range, technical and editorial. Schema and structured data, site and content architecture, crawl and indexation, on-page, internal linking, and comfort inside analytics and visibility platforms.

  • Analytical rigour with writing to match. You can take something large and noisy and come back with one page that is right.

  • A point of view you offer before anyone asks for it, and the research to back it up.

  • A nose for the missing question. The platform is strong and the models change weekly, so what we value most is your sense of what the analysis has not been asked.

  • We build with AI across our stack and you will too. Underneath it we want your own hypothesis and the curiosity to find out whether it held.

  • The habit of raising a hand. We are distributed, and the people who enjoy it here flag capacity early and pull threads nobody handed them.

What you’ll build toward: Within your first 6 months you will have command of a methodology you cannot learn anywhere else, genuine depth in a category that is only about two years old, and the presence to carry a room full of enterprise stakeholders, built by watching, then supporting, then leading.

The practical details

Remote-first and open to candidates within Canada. You will work with strategists, copywriters, creative and product across several time zones, asynchronously by default. We are still building the culture rather than inheriting one, and that is meant as an invitation.

If this sounds like you, then here's how to apply

Send us your resume and two other things:

  1. A piece of analysis you are proud of, with a short note on what you concluded that the data did not obviously hand you and what changed because of it.

  2. A question about AI search you have not been able to answer yet.

Short listed candidates will be invited to run an asynchronous analysis inside podium iq, which is the closest thing to a real day with podium iq and the part where we learn the most about how you think.

Full-Time Professional

Remote, US

As a result of continued growth, Avineon, Inc. is actively seeking a motivated, high-energy individual to manage our geospatial sales effort. As a Senior Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for selling ESRI related GIS services to state/local and private utilities, as well as developing and managing client and partner relationships as part of a sales team.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for identifying and closing business opportunities, developing long-term customer relationships, leading proposal development efforts, and other related sales activities delivering against an annual revenue target.
  • The successful candidate will have a thorough understanding of geospatial services and solutions and sales processes and will be responsible for prospecting, identifying, and securing business opportunities to support revenue growth.
  • Responsible for creating sales strategies and executing account plans in support of goals and objectives.
  • Developing Marketing strategies and exhibiting/presenting at conferences and regional events.

Required Education, Experience, and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in business, marketing, or a technology field (successful work-related experience in a geospatial services company may substitute).
  • Technical understanding of ESRI based GIS services as well as ArcGIS extension products like ArcFM.
  • 5+ years of proven outside direct sales experience with a focus on geospatial services or software products.
  • Has a good understanding of systems, processes, and business challenges at utilities (electric, gas, water, wastewater) and/or telecom
  • Self-motivated leader who exhibits a sense of urgency in all sales and service-related activities and can motivate a sales team.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, follow-up, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Ability to establish and build relationships quickly with all levels of management.

jobs.title: Senior Director, North American Compliance
jobs.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Senior Director, North America Compliance will serve as the lead Compliance business partner for the U.S. Commercial organization, with particular focus on Market Access. Reporting to the Head of Compliance, Americas, this role will provide strategic, practical, and risk-based compliance guidance that enables business objectives while supporting an effective North America Compliance Program.

The Senior Director will partner closely with senior leaders and teams across Market Access, Sales, Marketing, Patient Services, Trade and Distribution, Legal, and other functions. The role will advise on complex U.S. healthcare compliance matters across payer and customer engagement, pricing and contracting activities, patient support and access programs, field execution, promotional activities, and other evolving commercial models.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, business-minded healthcare compliance leader who understands the U.S. pharmaceutical commercial and market access environment, can anticipate risk, and is comfortable making sound decisions in areas where the path may not be straightforward. This individual will be expected to build trusted relationships, influence at senior levels, and translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic guardrails that support responsible innovation and sustainable growth.

Essential Functions of the Job:

U.S. Commercial & Market Access Compliance Leadership:

  • Serve as the lead Compliance business partner for the U.S. Commercial organization, with primary responsibility for supporting Market Access and related access, reimbursement, and customer-facing activities.
  • Provide strategic, timely, and practical compliance advice to senior Commercial and Market Access leaders on business strategies, product launches, customer engagement models, and new or evolving initiatives.
  • Advise on compliance considerations involving payers, pharmacy benefit managers, group purchasing organizations, health systems, specialty pharmacies, distributors, wholesalers, integrated delivery networks, government accounts, and other market access stakeholders.
  • Provide compliance guidance on pricing and contracting activities, discounts and rebates, formulary and access discussions, value-based or innovative arrangements, patient support and affordability programs, reimbursement activities, and other market access initiatives in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Support U.S. Sales and Marketing teams on key commercial compliance matters, including promotional practices, healthcare professional and customer interactions, speaker programs, advisory boards, sponsorships, field activities, and other external engagements.
  • Develop a deep understanding of business objectives and operating models in order to identify risk early, propose pragmatic solutions, and embed appropriate controls into business processes.

Strategic Risk Management & Compliance Program Execution:

  • Partner with the Head of Compliance, Americas to execute North America compliance strategy and priorities and to continuously enhance a modern, risk-based compliance program.
  • Identify and assess emerging compliance risks arising from changes in the U.S. healthcare, enforcement, reimbursement, and commercial landscape and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Lead or support compliance risk assessments, monitoring, auditing, investigations, and remediation activities relating to U.S. Commercial and Market Access activities.
  • Use monitoring results, business data, industry developments, and other risk indicators to identify trends and recommend enhancements to controls, training, policies, and business processes.
  • Support compliance governance and senior leadership reporting, including clear communication of significant risks, trends, decisions, and mitigation plans.

Policies, Training & Business Guidance:

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, field guidance, training, and other compliance resources relevant to U.S. Commercial and Market Access activities.
  • Design and deliver engaging, risk-based compliance training for Commercial and Market Access teams, including leadership and field-based personnel.
  • Translate complex laws, regulations, enforcement developments, and industry standards into clear, actionable guidance for business partners.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, thoughtful risk-taking, and speak-up across the U.S. organization.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Leadership:

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Commercial, Market Access, Legal, Corporate Affairs, HR, and other functions.
  • Work closely with the Global Compliance Program Office and other regional and global Compliance colleagues to promote consistency, share best practices, and support enterprise initiatives.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional projects, launch readiness activities, governance forums, and strategic initiatives to ensure compliance considerations are incorporated early in planning and execution.
  • • Serve as a visible Compliance leader who demonstrates sound judgment, constructive challenge, executive presence, and a solutions-oriented approach to complex business issues.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

  • Provides direct leadership, management, coaching, and development to assigned Compliance team members.
  • Sets priorities and expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports the professional development and performance of direct reports.
  • Provides functional leadership and mentorship across the North America Compliance team and helps foster a collaborative, high-performing, and business-focused Compliance organization.
  • May lead or oversee the work of contractors, consultants, or other resources supporting Compliance initiatives.

Education Required:

  • BA/BS Degree is required.
  • Advanced degree (JD, PharmD, MBA, MPH, or similar) preferred.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree with 12 + years of relevant experience in healthcare compliance, legal, regulatory, audit, or related functions within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, including significant experience supporting U.S. commercial activities.
  • Demonstrated experience advising Market Access organizations and strong understanding of the U.S. payer, reimbursement, patient access, trade/distribution, and contracting environment.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical compliance requirements and industry standards, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, federal and state transparency requirements, FDA promotional requirements, PhRMA Code, and OIG/DOJ compliance expectations.
  • Experience providing compliance guidance on market access topics such as payer and customer engagements, discounts and rebates, contracting, formulary discussions, patient support programs, reimbursement support, specialty pharmacy, and other access-related activities.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting or supporting risk assessments, monitoring, auditing, training, policy development, and remediation.
  • Experience supporting product launches and working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and evolving commercial environment strongly preferred.

Computer Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint and Teams.
  • Experience with compliance, expense, CRM, analytics, or reporting platforms such as Concur, Salesforce, Power BI, or similar tools preferred.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional judgment and ability to assess complex or ambiguous issues, balance risk and business objectives, and provide clear recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand commercial strategy, market access models, customer dynamics, and operational processes.
  • Ability to translate complex compliance concepts into practical, business-focused guidance and workable solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on positional authority.
  • Strong executive presence and excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach with the ability to challenge constructively and navigate competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise discretion, and manage multiple high-priority matters in a dynamic environment.
  • Commitment to integrity, continuous learning, and fostering a strong speak-up and compliance culture.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Is viewed by U.S. Commercial and Market Access leaders as a trusted, strategic advisor who enables responsible business execution.
  • Anticipates emerging risks and provides clear, pragmatic guardrails before issues arise.
  • Strengthens compliance oversight of Market Access and other U.S. Commercial activities through effective guidance, training, monitoring, and risk mitigation.
  • Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and helps teams make thoughtful, well-informed decisions in complex areas.
  • Contributes to a practical, business-focused, and integrity-driven compliance culture aligned with BeOne values.

Travel:

  • Ability to travel domestically approximately 25%

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented

  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

Suralink® is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, leading the global charge in AI-driven accounting technology. As the leading AI platform for accounting firms, Suralink serves more than 50% of the top 100 enterprise accounting firms in the United States and has over 800,000 users globally.

If you're passionate about building relationships and driving growth at a fast-growing SaaS company, we'd love to talk with you


Who we are looking for:

Suralink pioneered client-engagement software for accounting and advisory firms, helping 1,200+ practices worldwide close the client-readiness gap and safeguard trust. With the launch of our next-generation platform and AI-powered audit capabilities, we're hiring a Solutions Consultant to uplevel how we solve problems for leading firms through our GTM motion.

Reporting to the CRO and partnering closely with sales leadership, product, and product marketing, you'll be the practitioner voice in the sales cycle - a former CPA or auditor who has walked in our customers' shoes and now helps them envision a better way of working. You'll design and lead high-impact demos and pilots, build the foundational demo and workshop playbooks, and drive strong win rates on new products and strategic expansions.

We need a workflow-obsessed, commercially minded Solutions Consultant who blends deep audit/accounting experience with proven demo chops and a strong bias toward ownership and action

Key Responsibilities:


Drive Wins on New Products & Strategic Deals

- Partner with AEs to design and deliver compelling demos and pilots for enterprise and strategic firms, with a focus on new products and AI-enabled audit workflows.

- Serve as a subject matter expert in workshops and demos, where your practitioner experience helps uncover pain points and position our solutions.


Own Demo Strategy and Environments

- Redesign and standardize demo flows across Suralink's product suite, tailored by persona (Partners, Managers, Directors, IT/innovation) and segment.

- Maintain high-fidelity demo environments that mirror real financial statement tie-outs, audit testing, tax procedures, and AI-assisted workflows.

- Train AEs and CSMs to confidently run core demos end-to-end.


Architect and Run High-Conversion Pilots

- Design structured pilots/POCs with clear entry criteria, timelines, and success metrics tied to real firm workflows.

- Translate the specific success criteria and nuance of firm methodology and business process into guidance on how to use the product

- Drive 60%+ win rates on pilots where you are engaged, ensuring they function as decision engines - not open-ended experiments.


Partner with Product and Product Marketing

- Capture and synthesize market feedback, recurring use cases, and friction points from demos and pilots into clear insights that inform our roadmap.

- Translate real audit, tax, and advisory workflows into messaging, enablement, and content.

- Serve as a key thought partner in value engineering initiatives that tie our product directly to the impact on our customers.


Experience and Professional Qualifications:


- CPA or equivalent audit/accounting background with approximately 3–7 years in public accounting, including hands-on experience with:

- Audit procedures, methodology, documentation, and review

- Financial statement tie-outs and supporting workpapers

- Testing, sampling, and evidence management

- 2–5 years as a Solutions Consultant in B2B SaaS, ideally within accounting, audit, finance, or close-management technology, in a high-growth environment selling into firms or corporate finance/audit teams.

- Demonstrated success supporting enterprise or strategic deals, including multi-stakeholder sales cycles (Partners, Audit/IA leaders, IT, Security, Operations).

- Experience participating in or leading an Emerging Technology / Innovation / Digital Transformation committee or similar body responsible for evaluating and piloting new tools.

- Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to shape demos, pilots, and customer rollouts.


Additional Preferred Qualifications:


- Experience at companies such as (or similar to): DataSnipper, Trullion, Caseware, AuditBoard, FloQast, or BlackLine.

- Prior focus on enterprise or strategic accounts with upsell/cross-sell responsibility across multiple modules or product lines.

- Familiarity with AI-powered tools for audit analytics, testing, or documentation support.

- Experience designing and rolling out sales enablement programs for AEs and CSMs (demo certifications, discovery frameworks, objection handling, etc.).

- Comfort speaking at customer webinars, training sessions, or industry events as a subject-matter expert in audit, tax, or accounting technology.


At Suralink, our values guide everything we do:

  • Customer Obsessed: We seek to understand those we serve deeply and are committed to serving them better than anyone else.

  • Passionately Motivated: We care about what we do, which drives us to work hard, show grit, and go above and beyond to achieve great outcomes.

  • Constantly Improving: We are eager to learn and grow. Challenges are opportunities to innovate and enhance our solutions.

  • Team Focused: We know that our success is built together. We support one another and celebrate team achievements.

  • Highly Reliable: We demonstrate good judgment, honor our commitments, and are accountable for our results.

Why Suralink?

There’s a lot to love about working at Suralink! Here are a few of the benefits you can expect:

  • Remote-friendly policy

  • Medical/vision/dental insurance

  • Flexible PTO policy and ten paid holidays

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development allowance

  • Community involvement

jobs.excerpt: About our ClientOur client is a Dubai-based, fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) beauty company dedicated to empowering women in the GCC and Middle East with premium, confidence-boosting hair solutions.
jobs.description:
About our Client

Our client is a Dubai-based, fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) beauty company dedicated to empowering women in the GCC and Middle East with premium, confidence-boosting hair solutions. They specialize in high-quality, natural hair products through their flagship brand—the region's pioneering Arabic online store for 100% Remy human hair extensions, wigs, clip-ins, tape-ins, aftercare, and professional salon training.

Born from a UK-Middle East collaboration between two ambitious friends, started with direct salon partnerships, overcame pandemic challenges by launching a robust e-commerce platform, and now serves customers across Saudi Arabia, the broader MENA region, and worldwide with exceptional quality, color-matching expertise, 24/7 consultations, and free fast shipping.

Job Summary

As Paid Media Specialist, you'll lead strategy and execution, establish a world-class creative testing system alongside our in-house editors and designers, and create repeatable playbooks that fuel future brand launches. This is a rare chance to shape multiple brands in a fast-moving, high-potential beauty space with strong internal creative support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead full strategy, setup, and daily execution across Meta and Snapchat, including campaign architecture, audience targeting, bidding, and creative deployment tailored to GCC consumers.
  • Develop and execute weekly/monthly scaling plans, balancing horizontal (new audiences/markets) and vertical (budget increases on winners) approaches.
  • Proactively manage ad fatigue through rotation, refresh, and performance monitoring to maintain stable, long-term results.
  • Optimize blended channel metrics (CAC, MER) while ensuring healthy contribution margins at scale.
  • Design and implement a structured creative testing framework covering angles, hooks, formats (video, static, carousel), UGC vs. produced, and rapid iterations.
  • Analyze performance data to deliver precise, actionable creative briefs and instructions to our in-house video editor (e.g., hook structure, pacing, proof elements, CTA placement).
  • Maintain a live content pipeline, testing calendar, iteration backlog, and documentation of key learnings to inform weekly optimizations.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate idea generation, concept variations, and quick mockups for faster testing cycles.
  • Build and own a comprehensive 60-day launch roadmap, including phased budget ramps, KPI milestones (e.g., early CPA targets, winner identification thresholds), and scaling triggers.
  • Ensure full tracking readiness (pixel/events, attribution setup) and account hygiene before go-live.
  • Lead rapid early testing to identify high-performing creatives and audiences, then transition to aggressive profitable scaling.
  • Document the entire process into a repeatable launch playbook for future brand expansions.

Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in media buying on both Meta Ads Manager and Snapchat Ads (mandatory; GCC/MENA experience strongly preferred).
  • Proven track record scaling DTC beauty, cosmetics, hair, or fashion brands with high AOV.
  • Deep unit economics mindset: fluency in CAC, MER, LTV:CAC ratios, contribution margin, and payback period for informed scaling decisions.
  • Strong creative leadership: ability to translate data into specific creative direction, run structured testing, and document/iterate learnings systematically.
  • Organized operator with excellent planning, prioritization, KPI tracking, and weekly reporting skills.
  • Proficiency using AI for creative ideation/concepts (e.g., Midjourney, ChatGPT for hooks/angles).
  • Results-oriented, calm under pressure (seasonal volatility), collaborative with creative teams, data-driven decision-maker.

Educational & Professional Requirements

  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with at least 3 years focused on Meta + Snapchat in DTC/e-commerce.
  • Demonstrated success scaling DTC beauty/cosmetics/hair brands.
  • Strong preference for GCC/Middle East market experience due to cultural nuances, language (Arabic/English), and seasonal peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday/Black Friday).
  • No formal certifications required, but proven results in high-stakes scaling environments essential.

Apply now and join a team where creativity meets performance.

Additional Information

  • Fully remote (GCC time zone alignment required for meetings and live optimizations).
  • Part-time (with potential to become full-time)
  • Opportunity to shape multiple brands in a fast-moving beauty space with strong in-house creative support.
  • Only Egypt-based candidates can apply.
