This is a hands-on role for someone who has built audiences from the ground up and knows real growth comes from starting conversations. The ideal candidate comes from a consumer-facing brand, where they had to earn attention rather than buy it. You've built video-led, creator-driven social programs people actually want to engage with, and you know each platform has its own language and pace. You'll also help level up how we work — we want someone with strong opinions about tooling who can assess what we have, close the gaps, and build a stack that lets us engage more holistically.

Channel Strategy & Content

  • Translate strategy into a working content calendar and a consistent drumbeat of platform-native content, balancing always-on programming with launch moments

  • Lead on video-first and interactive formats built for how people actually watch
  • Spot and act on real-time trends, moving from idea to published content without waiting on a brief

Audience Growth & Community

  • Own follower, reach, and engagement growth targets, with a clear thesis on how each channel grows
  • Open up genuine two-way conversation with our core audience — building the response protocols and tone that make engagement feel human, and stepping in personally on high-stakes moments

  • Turn audience behavior and sentiment into insight for content, product, and brand teams

Creator & Influencer Programs

  • Build the operational backbone — creator database, rate benchmarks, briefing templates, brand safety and platform compliance — so it scales without adding headcount

Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure. It integrates with Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, and Ansible in a single governed workflow so you deliver secure, compliant infrastructure at scale. Developer self-service, Golden Paths with guardrails, an OPA policy engine, and drift detection accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control. Spacelift Intelligence adds AI-powered provisioning and diagnostics across traditional and AI-driven workflows.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills

  • Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management, medical billing, or another highly regulated industry

Relevant certifications are preferred but not required, including:

Security+ | CySA+ | SSCP | GSEC | AZ-500 | SC-200 | Cisco | AWS Certified Security – Specialty

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, the Institute of Metacognitive Programming (IMCP), is seeking a highly skilled, fully immersive Social Media Manager to lead and elevate the voice of its brand across multiple digital platforms.
jobs.description:
Our client, the Institute of Metacognitive Programming (IMCP), is seeking a highly skilled, fully immersive Social Media Manager to lead and elevate the voice of its brand across multiple digital platforms. This is a full-time remote position for someone who lives and breathes social media, deeply understands brand voice, and can create content that engages, educates, and inspires.

About the company
The Institute of Metacognitive Programming delivers training and certification in Metacognitive Programming, a coaching and leadership methodology designed to shift internal thought-emotional patterns and enable sustainable personal and professional transformation. IMCPs vision is to scale this methodology globally, helping professionals, coaches, and leaders achieve meaningful change through approaches grounded in psychology, neuroscience, and philosophy.

As IMCP expands its digital presence—online courses, certifications, group coaching, subscriptions, and other educational offerings—exceptional, resonant social media content is critical for audience engagement, growth, and thought leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow IMCPs social media accounts, including Instagram, Telegram, Threads, VK, TikTok, and other emerging platforms.
  • Deeply understand and internalize the brand voice, rhythm, and visual style, posting content that is consistent with IMCPs values and tone.
  • Create and schedule posts accurately and on time, ensuring precise alignment with the brands messaging.
  • Adapt content for various platforms, maintaining engagement and relevance while respecting each platforms mechanics and audience behavior.
  • Monitor social media performance metrics, analyze audience behavior, and provide actionable insights to improve engagement, retention, and organic growth.
  • Track trends in Reels, sounds, formats, and platform mechanics, applying them strategically and thoughtfully—without following hype for its own sake.
  • Manage audience interactions, including comments and direct messages, with professionalism and authenticity, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product, context, and underlying meanings.
  • Listen to the audience, identify what resonates, detect spikes in reach or engagement, and propose informed solutions to maximize impact.
  • Focus on measurable results: driving organic growth, retention, engagement, loyalty, and lead generation according to strategy and goals.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Social Media Manager (minimum 2 years) with a portfolio of accounts and campaigns managed.
  • Fluent Russian - necessary to maintain the brand voice, respond to audience comments and messages, and manage content across Russian-language social media platforms.
  • Excellent written communication, grammatical precision, and a refined visual sense.
  • Deep understanding of social media algorithms, organic growth mechanics, and content psychology.
  • Ability to adapt and emulate an author or brand voice while preserving meaning and nuance.
  • Analytical mindset: not just reporting metrics, but interpreting audience behavior and deriving actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of content psychology: knowing not just what to post, but why it will resonate.
  • Self-motivated, independent, and proactive in problem-solving and content strategy.

Our Benefits

  • Work for a globally recognized and fast-growing coaching and training organization.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Fully remote work with flexible scheduling.
  • High ownership and influence over IMCPs social media strategy and execution.
  • Collaborative, learning-oriented team environment.
  • Opportunity to shape the voice of a thought-leadership brand at a global scale.

jobs.title: Callcenter Bereichsleitung (100% Remote)
jobs.excerpt: ⚠️ WICHTIG: Aus Effizienzgründen werden nur Onlinebewerbungen über unsere Karriereseite und KEINE Bewerbungen per Post, E-Mail oder Telefon angenommen.
jobs.description:
⚠️ WICHTIG: Aus Effizienzgründen werden nur Onlinebewerbungen über unsere Karriereseite und KEINE Bewerbungen per Post, E-Mail oder Telefon angenommen.

🚨 MUST-HAVE: Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung von Callcenter-Teams sowie eigene, fundierte Outbound-Erfahrung sind für diese Position zwingend erforderlich.

Standort: 100% Remote | Umfang: 30-40h / Woche

Über den Job:
Tunymedia ist auf Wachstumskurs. Wir generieren für unsere Kunden (Handwerksbetriebe) täglich Leads über Social Media, die von unserem Inhouse-Callcenter telefonisch vorqualifiziert werden. Da unser bestehendes Team bereits hervorragende Arbeit leistet und wir unsere Kapazitäten erweitern, suchen wir dich für die Steuerung und den Aufbau einer zweiten, parallelen Einheit, die zu 100% remote von zu Hause arbeitet.

Wir suchen Dich als erfahrene, externe Führungskraft, die nachweisliche Führungserfahrung aus dem Callcenter-Umfeld und handfeste Outbound-Erfahrung mitbringt. Du bist die treibende Kraft, die klare Strukturen vorgibt, messbare Ergebnisse einfordert, die Qualität sichert und selbst aktiv in der Lead-Terminierung mitwirkt. Umso besser unser Team ist, umso bessere Ergebnisse bekommt der Kunde.

🛑 Wichtig vorab (Bitte genau lesen)

Wir suchen keinen Moderator, der Probleme aussitzt oder Verantwortung wegdelegiert – wir suchen jemanden, der eingreift, bevor's brennt.

Wir suchen eine umsetzungsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit, die durch klare Kommunikation, etablierte Prozesse und eigene Leistung am Hörer führt. Du verstehst die Lebensrealität unseres Teams und bietest höchste Verlässlichkeit.

Im Gegenzug forderst Du absolute Verbindlichkeit und Zielerreichung während der Arbeitszeit ein. Du verfügst über eine stark ausgeprägte, analytische und KPI-getriebene Arbeitsweise und hast die Durchsetzungskraft, bei abweichenden Quoten direkt einzugreifen, eine lückenlose CRM-Hygiene sicherzustellen und unsere Qualitätsstandards konsequent durchzusetzen.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet …
• Strukturierter Onboarding-Prozess: Ein effizienter Einarbeitungsplan mit persönlichem Training, damit Du unsere Meta-Leads, Skripte und internen Systeme schnell und umfassend beherrschst.
• Klare Arbeitsabläufe: Durch klare & ordentliche Anleitungen und Schulungen weiß jedes Teammitglied immer, was gerade zu tun ist. Damit vermeiden wir stressige Chaos-Situationen und Unordnung.
• Direkter Draht: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Produktionsleitung zusammen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Konzern-Theater.
• 100% Remote & familiäres Umfeld: Du arbeitest komplett aus dem Home-Office. Wir schätzen Loyalität, Sicherheit und Wertschätzung und haben ein tiefes Verständnis für die Lebensrealität von Familien.
• Mitspracherecht: Nur gemeinsam können wir den Betrieb voranbringen, deswegen wird jeder Mitarbeiter in die Weiterentwicklung miteinbezogen!
• Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeit: Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten im Unternehmen vorhanden, sowie selbstverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem offenen & ehrlichen Team.
• Umfangreiches Gesundheitsprogramm: Bikeleasing, höhenverstellbare Schreibtische (auch fürs Homeoffice), ergonomische Stühle, Gesundheitsworkshops uvm.

Über uns:
Die Tunymedia GmbH zählt mit über 350 Kunden zu den bekanntesten Digitalisierungsagenturen für die Handwerks- und Möbelbranche im gesamten D-A-CH Raum. Aktuell beschäftigen wir über 25 MitarbeiterInnen und helfen unseren Kunden durch Digitalisierung Top Fachkräfte zu gewinnen und mit mehr Neukundenaufträgen Ihren Gewinn zu steigern.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen viele Klein- und Mittelbetriebe, sowie auch bekannte große Unternehmen, wie Schaffrath, Flamme Möbel, Weko, Dan Küchen, HELLA Sonnenschutz und McDonalds.

Deine Aufgaben:Team-Führung & Entwicklung (Konsequente operative Führung)

  • Systematische Einarbeitung und Onboarding von neuen Mitarbeiterinnen nach unseren Unternehmensstandards.

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und operatives Coaching unseres zweiten, parallel entstehenden Remote-Teams durch regelmäßige Call-Reviews und konstruktives Feedback.

  • Durchführung von Bewerbungsgesprächen zum gezielten Ausbau unseres Remote-Teams.

Operative Lead-Qualifizierung (Die Praxis)

  • Du steuerst nicht nur aus der Distanz: Du unterstützt das Team aktiv im Tagesgeschäft, qualifizierst Leads am Telefon und demonstrierst professionelle Einwandbehandlung in der Praxis.

Controlling & Prozessoptimierung (Die Struktur)

  • Tägliches Monitoring der Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs), Schlagzahlen und Termin-Ergebnisse.

  • Rigorose Sicherstellung einer fehlerfreien und lückenlosen Dokumentation im CRM-System.

  • Regelmäßiges Reporting an die Abteilungsleitung sowie sofortige strategische Maßnahmen bei Performance-Schwankungen.

Arbeitsort: 100% Remote

Gehalt: Attraktives Prämienmodell bei Zielerreichung + planbares Fixgehalt.

Requirements

Wen wir suchen (Dein Profil):

  • Entscheidungsstarke Teamleitung: Du bist niemand, der Probleme aussitzt. Du gibst glasklare Anweisungen, verteilst Aufgaben unmissverständlich und kontrollierst deren Umsetzung konsequent.

  • Erfahrung im Outbound / Lead-Qualifizierung: Du weißt, wie man am Telefon das Eis bricht, Einwände behandelt und Menschen qualifiziert. Ein reiner Inbound-Kundenservice-Hintergrund reicht hier nicht, du brauchst Drive.

  • Operatives Vorbild (Hands-on-Mentalität): Du telefonierst regelmäßig selbst, um Best Practices zu demonstrieren. Respekt im Team erarbeitest Du Dir durch fachliche Expertise und eigene Verbindlichkeit am Hörer.

  • Train the Trainer: Du kannst nachweisen, wie du Quereinsteigern Leitfäden beibringst, Call-Reviews durchführt und messbar die Abschlussquote im Team steigerst.

  • Analytischer Fokus & CRM-Exzellenz: Du arbeitest routiniert in Systemen wie Pipedrive/Hubspot, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und achtest rigoros auf eine lückenlose System-Dokumentation (die "Wahrheit im System").

  • Professionelle Autorität: Du kommunizierst direkt und auf Augenhöhe, bietest dem Team Verlässlichkeit durch exzellente Organisation und lieferst der Produktionsleitung gleichzeitig transparente, faktenbasierte Reportings.

The business sells exclusively through its own online channels and fulfills orders via a 3PL partner. Production is managed through three manufacturing partners in China. The founder oversees factory relationships, pricing negotiations, and product development, while the Supply Chain Manager owns the execution and operational side of the supply chain process.

Beyond your experience, the company is looking for someone who combines strong ownership with a systems-thinking mindset. The ideal candidate is highly organized, obsessed with inventory flow and operational simplicity, and constantly looks for ways to automate and improve processes using AI tools and modern operations software. The company values proactive problem-solvers who can work independently, communicate clearly, and thrive in a fully remote environment.

The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, self-managed, proactive, and passionate about building efficient and scalable operational systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Supply Planning & Inventory Management:

  • Issue and manage all purchase orders based on founder-approved deals and internal sales projections
  • Maintain inventory health across approximately 500 SKUs, with a strong focus on core bestselling products
  • Build and maintain reorder models and inventory forecasting systems
  • Monitor stock levels and proactively prevent stockouts or excess inventory situations
  • Track all open purchase orders from placement to warehouse receipt

Shipping & Freight Management:

  • Source freight quotations and coordinate shipments from China to the US

jobs.excerpt: HarmonyTech Inc.  is seeking a “Microsoft Certified Solutions Senior SharePoint Developer” to support a federal government modernization program.
jobs.description:
HarmonyTech Inc. is seeking a “Microsoft Certified Solutions Senior SharePoint Developer” to support a federal government modernization program. The successful candidate will design, develop, support and modernize mission critical Enterprise SharePoint environment.

Position is remote. U.S. Citizenship is required.

Position Summary
The Microsoft Certified Senior SharePoint Developer is the technical lead for everything users see and touch in the Enterprise SharePoint environment. The role designs and builds SharePoint Framework components, applications, templates and prototype pages; decides when a low-code Power Platform solution is the better answer than custom code; sets and enforces the coding, accessibility and documentation standards the team works to; and reviews the work of other developers before it reaches the Government. Section 508 conformance and change-package discipline are part of the definition of done, not a downstream review.

Key responsibilities:-

Solution design and development
  • Design, develop, and update web components and applications that support the agency, using the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) with TypeScript and React, PnPjs and the Microsoft Graph API (SOW Section 5).
  • Design and develop prototype web pages and templates for SBA sites and special interest sites, and present them at sprint reviews as working software.
  • Provide mobile web application development and support for SharePoint applications, delivering responsive, mobile-verified experiences.
  • Build Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse solutions where a low-code approach meets the requirement at lower cost and lower maintenance burden, and document the reasoning for each build-versus-configure decision.
  • Develop supporting integrations against SharePoint REST, Microsoft Graph and line-of-business data sources.
Technical leadership and quality
  • Serve as technical authority for the SharePoint and Power Platform work stream; own solution architecture and technical decisions within COR-approved scope.
  • Conduct code review on every change; enforce agency-compliant coding standards, effective meta-tags, titles and coding formats (SOW Section 5).
Accessibility
  • Write all new code to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.0 Levels A and AA and to the Revised Section 508 Standards, and ensure any change to existing code conforms in accordance with the required testing methods (SOW Section 5).
Change control and release
  • Package solutions with source control, versioning and repeatable deployment across Development, Test and Production; support deployment inside the approved maintenance window and back-out when invoked.
  • Maintain application lifecycle management pipelines for SPFx and Power Platform solutions in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Operations and support
  • Resolve development/operations-related ServiceNow tickets to the response and resolution targets for their priority, and record disposition on the ticket at the time work is performed.
  • Continually analyze web components and parts, navigation and load time, and modify components that are not performing properly or do not meet agency web standards.
  • Assist in the evaluation of new tools and upgrades to maintain or improve the environment.
Program support
  • Agile delivery in two-week sprints, including sprint review presentation to a Government customer.
  • Working in a formally change-controlled environment with board approval, maintenance windows and back-out planning.
  • ServiceNow for incident, request and change records.
  • Clear technical writing and the ability to explain a design decision to a non-technical Government stakeholder.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Seven or more years of professional software development, including five or more years developing on the SharePoint platform and three or more years building with the SharePoint Framework.
  • Demonstrated delivery of production SPFx web parts or extensions in a governed enterprise or Federal environment.
  • Experience leading a small development team or work stream, including code review and technical mentoring.
  • SharePoint Framework (SPFx), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), React, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, Node.js and Gulp build tooling.
  • SharePoint REST API, Microsoft Graph API, PnPjs, PnP PowerShell; SharePoint Online site design, site scripts, content types and columns.
  • Power Platform development: Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Platform ALM.
  • Source control and CI/CD with Git and Azure DevOps or GitHub; automated testing and static analysis.
  • Responsive and mobile-first design for SharePoint Online.
  • Section 508 and WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA implementation, including remediation of existing components.
  • Migration and modernization of classic SharePoint pages, workflows and legacy customizations to supported modern patterns.
Required Certifications
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102) or equivalent.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior experience in a Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC or GCC High) tenant.
  • Federal civilian agency experience, particularly supporting an OCIO or enterprise collaboration program.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint with Power BI reporting and with financial, budget or acquisition systems
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering or a closely related field.

About HarmonyTech

We have been delivering information technology services and solutions across the federal government and commercial clients for over a decade. Our employees are the most important assets of our company because they deliver value and care for our clients. We are a company of passionate technologists, constantly evolving in our understanding and application of technology to best fulfill our clients' mission needs. We operate under a flat and efficient organizational structure to ensure our hand-picked consultants have the flexibility to take risks and be innovative. We typically work in small, agile teams as we design and develop solutions to address our clients' business challenges. Our success is measured with every satisfied customer and employee.

Why you want to join us

  • Awesome learning and professional development opportunities
  • A culture built on teamwork and excellence

HarmonyTech offers a highly competitive salary and benefits package, including:

  • Short/Long Term Disability Coverage
  • Life and AD&D Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Tuition Reimbursement

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer
jobs.excerpt: Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche.
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

﻿This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

jobs.excerpt: Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche.
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

﻿This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

jobs.excerpt: Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Inventory & Logistics Specialist to oversee end-to-end supply chain and inventory operations.
jobs.description:
Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Inventory & Logistics Specialist to oversee end-to-end supply chain and inventory operations. This full-time remote role combines freight management, Amazon FBA coordination, inventory forecasting, and reverse logistics to ensure smooth operations across all sales channels. If you are experienced in e-commerce logistics, Amazon fulfillment, and supply chain optimization, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, wed love to hear from you.

About the company:

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Freight & Supply Chain Management

  • Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
  • Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
  • Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
  • Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
  • Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations

  • Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.
  • Oversee the receiving of units at both Amazon fulfillment centers and partner 3PL warehouses.
  • Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
  • Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
  • LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

  • Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
  • Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
  • Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Play a critical role in ensuring smooth operations for a high-ticket pet brand on Amazon.
  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.
  • Make a tangible impact on a brand that values quality, customer experience, and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
jobs.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

We Are Looking for a Customer Success Manager Who Thinks Strategically, Communicates Exceptionally, and Puts Customers First

We are seeking a sharp, driven, and deeply customer-focused professional with experience in CPG trade management to join our Customer Success team. This is not a support role. It is a strategic partnership role. You will own the outcomes of the accounts you manage, proactively guiding customers toward measurable business value and deeper adoption of the Vividly platform.

If you are a self-starter who leads with curiosity, communicates with clarity and confidence, and knows how to turn data into insights and insights into action, you will thrive here. We need someone who has lived on the front lines of Small to Midsize Business (SMB) Trade, someone who understands the complexity of trade spend and can translate that expertise into transformational customer partnerships.

Key Responsibilities and Impact

  • Lead with strategy, not just service. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers by acting as a proactive strategic advisor, not a reactive problem-solver. Guide customers toward their goals before they know they need guidance.
  • Apply critical thinking to every account. Analyze customer usage patterns, platform data, and business context to identify adoption gaps, risks, and growth opportunities. Translate what you see into clear recommendations and action plans that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Communicate with precision and purpose. Own every customer interaction, written, verbal, and in-meeting, with the clarity and confidence of someone who respects the customer's time and leads conversations with intention. This means clear agendas, concise follow-ups, and proactive outreach that adds value before customers ask for it.
  • Champion the customer's success internally. Serve as the voice of your customers across product, sales, and marketing. Surface feedback, patterns, and risks with the evidence to back them up. Advocate for improvements that create better outcomes across the entire customer base.
  • Drive platform adoption and user expansion. Don't just onboard; embed. Identify underutilized features, low-adoption users, and untapped teams within your accounts. Design enablement strategies that scale beyond one-on-one training and create organizational dependency on the Vividly platform.
  • Multi-thread your accounts. Build relationships across each organization, not just with your primary contact. Identify champions, executive sponsors, power users, and operational stakeholders. Proactively protect against single points of failure.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with structure. Partner with specialists, product, and sales teams to build repeatable, well-documented customer success playbooks. Every customer should have a clear success plan, defined milestones, and documented outcomes.
  • Represent Vividly as a TPM thought leader. Help shape the industry conversation. We want CSMs who can contribute to best practices, case studies, and community conversations that position Vividly as the definitive platform for SMB CPG trade management.
  • Set boundaries that protect your strategic value. Redirect technical support and break-fix issues to the appropriate Support channels. Your role is to own strategy, adoption, and outcomes, not to be a one-person help desk.

You Will Be Successful With

  • 5+ years of experience in Trade Promotion Management - you understand the complexity of trade spend and can speak the customer's language from day one
  • CPG industry experience is strongly recommended - deductions, accruals, and general trade finance experience strongly preferred; POS data and TPM software experience are a significant plus
  • Strong critical thinking skills - you can analyze ambiguous situations, connect disparate signals, and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations without being told what to look for
  • An authentically customer-first mindset - you measure your success by your customers' outcomes, not your task completion rate; you anticipate needs, not just respond to them
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills - you write follow-up emails that customers actually read, you run meetings that end with clarity, and you can tailor your message to an operations manager and a C-suite executive in the same week
  • Proactive account leadership - you don't wait for customers to come to you; you show up with insights, recommendations, and a point of view
  • Technical aptitude with SaaS platforms - you are comfortable navigating and explaining complex software and can help customers get the most out of the tools they have
  • Comfort with ambiguity and change - you thrive in a fast-moving startup environment and know how to build process where there isn't one yet
  • A GSD (Get Stuff Done) attitude - paired with the judgment to know which things are worth doing, which should be delegated, and which should be handed off entirely

Why This Role Matters

Customer Success at Vividly is not account management. It is the difference between a customer who renews and one who becomes a reference. Between a platform that gets used and one that becomes indispensable. Between a company that grows because of its customers and one that grows despite losing them.

If you want to own that difference, and have the skills, experience, and mindset to drive it, we want to hear from you.

This role is a critical part of Vividly's growth. We hire for outcomes, not activity. Show us how you think, how you communicate, and how you put customers first, and we'll show you what it looks like to build something that matters.

Why Choose Vividly?

A modern, remote-first workplace

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

Vividly days off & flexible PTO

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (and we really mean it) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

Competitive Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
  • 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
  • Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
  • Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code

  • Kind Ambition -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
  • Keep It Real - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
  • Customer Love - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
  • Own It - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
  • Urgency Wins - We move quickly and focus on impact
  • Pull Together - We collaborate to win as a team

Please note: Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

  • Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.
  • Our Talent Acquisition team only corresponds from email addresses with the domain ‘@govividly.com’. If a generic email ID ending with Gmail/Yahoo or other domain is used while receiving a job offer or interview call, there is a likelihood of a scammer.
  • While some of our jobs can be found on third party job sites, all of our current job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Vividly’s Careers page, or our official LinkedIn Company Page

jobs.excerpt: Job Description• Position Title: Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor – Distance Learning • Department: Academic Faculty • Reports To: Campus Director / Academic Director • Institution: Vancouver College of Counsellor Training (VCCT) Position SummaryThe Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor facilitates interactive clinical skills training sessions for students enrolled in VCCT's distance-learning counselling programs.
jobs.description:
Job Description

  • Position Title: Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor – Distance Learning
  • Department: Academic Faculty
  • Reports To: Campus Director / Academic Director
  • Institution: Vancouver College of Counsellor Training (VCCT)

Position Summary

The Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor facilitates interactive clinical skills training sessions for students enrolled in VCCT's distance-learning counselling programs. The role focuses on helping students develop applied counselling competencies through role-play exercises, group supervision, ethics discussions, and simulated counselling scenarios.

The instructor supports students in translating theoretical knowledge into practical counselling skills including reflective listening, empathy, emotional attunement, ethical decision-making, and therapeutic communication. The role also includes facilitating group therapy simulations and preparing students for practicum placements, ensuring students are professionally prepared for real-world counselling environments.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Skills Training

  • Facilitate live online clinical skills practice sessions for distance-learning students.
  • Conduct role-play simulations of counselling scenarios.
  • Teach and demonstrate counselling micro-skills including reflective listening, empathy, rapport building, and therapeutic communication.

Provide constructive feedback to support student skill development.

  • Group Therapy Simulation & Supervision
  • Facilitate group counselling role-play sessions to help students practice group facilitation techniques.
  • Act as Group Supervisor, observing student-led group sessions and providing reflective feedback.
  • Support student understanding of group dynamics, participation management, and therapeutic group processes.

Ethics & Professional Practice

  • Facilitate case discussions and ethical scenario analysis relevant to counselling practice.
  • Guide students in applying ethical frameworks, confidentiality standards, and professional boundaries.

Practicum Preparation

  • Support students in preparing for practicum placements.
  • Respond to student questions related to practicum expectations and readiness.
  • Guide students on professional behaviour, client interaction, documentation practices, and ethical conduct in counselling environments.

Interactive Learning & Student Engagement

  • Use virtual learning platforms to facilitate breakout room discussions and supervised practice sessions.
  • Create experiential learning activities that strengthen counselling competencies.
  • Foster a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment that supports meaningful learning.

Qualifications

Education

  • Master's degree in Counselling, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
  • Diploma in Counselling with significant professional experience may be considered.

Professional Credentials

Active professional designation such as Registered Clinical Counsellor (RCC) with the BC Association of Clinical Counsellors or equivalent (e.g., CCC with the Canadian Counselling and Psychotherapy Association).

Must hold a recognized Clinical Supervisor designation or supervisor training enabling supervision of counselling students.

Must be in good standing with their professional association.

Experience

  • Experience providing counselling or psychotherapy services.
  • Experience facilitating group counselling or group therapy sessions.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising students or trainees.
  • Experience facilitating skills-based training for adult learners.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and breakout-room facilitation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills
  • Ability to guide experiential learning and counselling practice
  • Competence in group counselling facilitation
  • Ability to provide constructive supervision and feedback
  • Strong ethical awareness and professional judgment
  • Ability to create psychologically safe learning environments

Working Conditions

  • Remote instructional delivery through VCCT's virtual learning platform.
  • Sessions conducted in an interactive online format.
  • Scheduling based on program cohort requirements.

Growth Opportunity

VCCT is a growing institution committed to developing strong faculty members. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional teaching quality, student engagement, and alignment with VCCT's academic standards may be considered for expanded responsibilities and increased teaching hours, with the potential to transition into a full-time instructional role as program needs grow.

  • Own cloud security posture management (CSPM) across GCP and AWS — continuous assessment, misconfiguration detection, and remediation tracking.
  • Design and enforce IAM policies, service account hygiene, least-privilege access controls, and workload identity across multi-cloud environments.
  • Implement VPC security controls — private service access, firewall rules, network policies, ingress/egress restrictions, and Private Google Access.
  • Internalise and secure service endpoints — move external-facing services to internal load balancers, private endpoints, and VPN/interconnect. Continuously audit and reduce the public attack surface.
  • Manage secrets hygiene — enforce Secret Manager (GCP) and AWS Secrets Manager, eliminate hardcoded credentials, and rotate secrets programmatically.
  • Lead cloud security incident response — triage, contain, investigate, and remediate across cloud and Kubernetes environments.
  • Own compliance reporting for SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 — evidence collection, gap analysis, and control implementation.
  • Conduct regular threat modelling, security reviews, and architecture risk assessments.

Kubernetes Security — Primary

  • Harden GKE clusters — CIS benchmarks, pod security standards (restricted/baseline), and admission control policies.
  • Implement and manage network policies to enforce east-west traffic segmentation between namespaces and services.
  • Deploy and operate runtime security tooling (e.g. Falco) for threat detection inside cluster workloads.
  • Manage Kubernetes RBAC with least-privilege principles. Audit and remediate overpermissioned service accounts.
  • Secure the container supply chain — image scanning in CI (Trivy/Snyk), enforce signed images, and maintain a trusted registry policy.
  • Implement Istio security controls — mTLS enforcement, authorisation policies, and east-west traffic observability.
  • Continuously audit running workloads for security drift — privileged containers, host path mounts, and secrets in environment variables.

CI/CD & GitLab Security — Primary

  • Secure the GitLab CI/CD pipeline end-to-end — protect runner environments, restrict pipeline permissions, enforce branch protection and MR approvals.
  • Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and secret detection natively into GitLab CI. Own the triage and remediation workflow.
  • Implement IaC security scanning (tfsec, Checkov) as a mandatory pipeline gate for all Terraform changes.
  • Manage GitLab token hygiene — enforce expiry policies, rotate project tokens, and audit personal access token usage.
  • Define and enforce pipeline security policies organization-wide using GitLab security policy-as-code.

Endpoint & Network Security — Primary

  • Audit and reduce the external attack surface — inventory all public endpoints and drive internalization of services that do not need to be public.
  • Implement and maintain WAF and Cloud Armor rules to protect externally exposed services.
  • Enforce TLS certificate management — automate issuance, rotation, and enforce TLS 1.2+ across all endpoints.
  • Manage bastion host security — enforce short-lived certificates (OS Login / IAP), eliminate persistent SSH keys, and log all administrative sessions.
  • Own DNS security controls — DNSSEC, private DNS zones for internal services, split-horizon DNS where required.

Security Engineering & Automation

  • Build security automation pipelines — policy enforcement, compliance checks, and vulnerability remediation as code.
  • Instrument security observability in Datadog — threat detection dashboards and alert tuning for cloud and Kubernetes signals.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks for security incidents, vulnerability response, and access reviews.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleConnect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Connect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Delivery Manager to join our growing team and drive the delivery of Connect products and services through the full development lifecycle.

The Product Owner sets product vision and roadmap direction. From that point the product is yours through delivery: shaping requirements into a solution that can actually be built, making the trade-off calls that decide what ships and what defers, driving the build, running QA and UAT, and getting the product released and ready to deploy. Client deployments are run by the project management organization, and you support them as the product authority. At times this team carries the deployment directly. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to apply product judgment on scope, design, and release readiness, and to carry the professional standing that earns you the respect of engineering, operations, and clients.

Real contact center expertise is essential. You will make product and delivery decisions daily on omni-channel routing, telephony, agent desktop, recording, reporting, and integration behavior. You need to know how a contact center runs well enough to recognize when a design will not hold up against real routing, peak volume, or a failover, and to make that case to engineering. Candidates must have delivered products or capabilities on a contact center platform.

You will join a team of Product Delivery Managers reporting to the Head of Product Delivery. Delivery work is shared across the team, so you will coordinate with your peers on dependencies, shared components, release trains, and release order, and help shape the standards the team works to. The role has no direct reports and depends on working effectively across architecture, engineering, QA, project management, implementation, and operations. This is a remote position based in the United States. The team works US business hours, primarily Eastern Time and extending to Pacific Time, and that must be your normal business day. This role cannot be worked as an offset shift from another region.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Intake & Delivery Planning

  • Take product direction and priorities from the Head of Product Delivery and shape them into a delivery plan, including where the approach has to change to hold up in a live contact center.
  • Review requirements for clarity, completeness, testability, and feasibility. Take gaps, conflicts, and ambiguities back to the Head of Product Delivery and resolve them before work starts.
  • Break requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development and QA can work from.
  • Size and phase the work with engineering, set milestones and release targets, and identify dependencies, assumptions, and risks up front.
  • Coordinate with peer Product Delivery Managers on cross-product dependencies, shared components, and release order.
  • Separate client-specific configuration from core product capability, and flag anything that would change product direction for the Head of Product Delivery.
  • Escalate scope, capacity, or timeline conflicts to the Head of Product Delivery with options and a recommendation.

Design & Build

  • Own execution for your assigned products and features: scope, schedule, quality, and dependencies.
  • Work with solution architects and engineering leads to turn approved requirements into functional and technical designs, and test those designs against real routing, agent workflow, telephony, recording, and reporting behavior.
  • Act as product owner for the scrum team: maintain the backlog, clarify requirements, clear roadblocks, and accept completed work against the acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate delivery status and raise risks, issues, and blockers early with a recommended course of action.
  • Make the scope calls inside a release: decide what ships and what defers based on defect risk, client impact, and production readiness.

QA, UAT & Release

  • Set test scope, strategy, and entry and exit criteria with QA, and confirm coverage against the documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Run defect triage and prioritization, push fixes and retests, and track defect trends against the release date.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing with internal and client stakeholders and obtain UAT sign-off.
  • Own the product release plan with engineering and operations, including environment readiness, rollback, and go / no go criteria for putting the product into service.
  • Give the Head of Product Delivery a go or no go recommendation supported by test results, open defects, and known risk.
  • Support the project management organization on client deployments as the product authority, and lead the deployment directly when this team carries it.

Release & Deployment Support

  • Produce the release package the deployment teams work from: release notes, configuration and technical documentation, runbooks, and internal readiness sessions.
  • Hand the product to operations, support, and the project management organization with escalation paths, known issues, and supportability documentation.
  • Act as the product escalation point once deployments are in the field: answer design and configuration questions, and own resolution of product defects found during rollout.
  • Stay engaged through hypercare on the product side, working with operations and support until production issues and post-release fixes are closed.
  • Turn production performance, defect trends, and delivery lessons into roadmap direction and bring it back to the Head of Product Delivery, and manage delivery of enhancements, maintenance releases, and version upgrades.
  • 7+ years of hands-on contact center technology experience across voice, email, chat, SMS, social, web, video, and mobile.
  • 5+ years in product delivery, delivery management, product ownership, or technical project management for software products.
  • Availability to work USA EST or CST working hours
  • Hands-on delivery or configuration experience on at least one major contact center platform: Genesys, NICE, Cisco, Avaya, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio Flex.
  • Working knowledge of how contact center components fit together: ACD and routing, IVR and self-service, CTI and agent desktop, dialer and outbound, call recording, screen recording, quality management, workforce management, and reporting.
  • Experience with contact center integrations: CRM and ticketing, screen pop, APIs and webhooks, SIP and carrier connectivity, and reporting feeds.
  • Experience planning and executing production releases into live 24x7 customer-facing environments, including go-live, rollback, and go / no go decisions.
  • Working knowledge of QA practice: test strategy, defect triage and prioritization, release criteria, and UAT.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory environment contact centers operate in, including PCI-DSS, TCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and call recording consent.
  • Prior experience reviewing and analyzing contact center solutions, and recommending design improvements and roadmap direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to leadership and translating between business and technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment under pressure: able to weigh incomplete information and make a defensible call rather than escalate every decision.
  • Strong analytical skills and the discipline to track dependencies, defects, and commitments without losing sight of the release goal.
  • Takes accountability for delivery outcomes and product quality.
  • Effective in a fast-paced hybrid Agile environment with shifting priorities.
  • Builds durable working relationships across engineering, QA, operations, and client teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Delivery experience in a BPO or outsourced contact center environment, with multi-client and multi-site deployments.
  • Experience delivering AI and automation into a contact center: virtual agents, conversational IVR, agent assist, speech and text analytics, or intelligent routing.
  • Experience delivering CCaaS capabilities in a multi-tenant, cloud-native environment.
  • Prior time inside contact center operations, such as a supervisor or workforce role, alongside technology delivery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CSPO, CSM, SAFe, or PMP, or a platform-specific contact center certification.

About Sutherland:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

jobs.description:
Job Description

Lead Substation Electrical Engineer

AECOM Energy | Remote (U.S.)

Help Power the Future

AECOM is seeking a Lead Substation Electrical Engineer to join our growing Energy practice in a remote role based anywhere in the United States. This position offers the opportunity to lead the design and delivery of critical transmission, distribution, renewable energy, and grid modernization projects while working alongside some of the industry's top engineering professionals.

As a technical leader within AECOM's Power Delivery team, you will play a key role in helping utilities and energy clients navigate an evolving energy landscape by delivering innovative, reliable, and resilient substation solutions.

Whether supporting grid expansion, renewable energy integration, or infrastructure modernization, you'll have the flexibility of a remote work environment while contributing to impactful projects across North America.

The Opportunity

As a Lead Substation Electrical Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the planning, design, and delivery of utility-scale substation projects. Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and project managers, you will support projects from concept development through construction while ensuring technical excellence, quality, and client satisfaction.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and building strong client relationships while contributing to the continued growth of AECOM's Energy business.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the engineering and design of transmission and distribution substation projects for utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight for substation physical design, protection and control integration, grounding systems, equipment layouts, and power delivery infrastructure.

  • Support the development and review of one-line diagrams, protection schemes, equipment specifications, construction packages, and design documentation.

  • Apply engineering expertise throughout project phases including planning, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement, and construction support.

  • Support engineering studies and analyses related to grounding, equipment sizing, fault current evaluations, and substation design considerations.

  • Stay current with evolving technologies, industry standards, and utility practices related to substations, grid modernization, and power delivery systems.

Project Delivery

  • Lead engineering tasks and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality work on schedule and within budget.

  • Support project planning, resource coordination, technical reviews, and project execution activities.

  • Provide technical oversight for substation upgrades, expansions, brownfield modifications, and greenfield projects.

  • Collaborate with project managers to identify and mitigate risks while maintaining project objectives and client expectations.

  • Support construction activities through technical consultation, design clarifications, and resolution of field issues.

Client Engagement & Business Development

  • Build strong relationships with utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients.

  • Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, presentations, and project reviews.

  • Support proposal development, scope definition, cost estimates, and pursuit efforts.

  • Identify opportunities to expand services and strengthen long-term client partnerships.

  • Collaborate with regional and national teams to support strategic growth initiatives.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Mentor engineers and designers while supporting technical development and knowledge sharing.

  • Collaborate with civil, structural, transmission, protection and control, and program management teams.

  • Contribute to engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across the Energy practice.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, safety, and collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline and 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting transmission and distribution substation projects.

  • Strong understanding of electrical engineering principles, utility infrastructure, and power delivery systems.

  • Experience leading engineering tasks, reviewing technical deliverables, and coordinating project teams.

  • Knowledge of industry standards and codes such as IEEE, NESC, and NEC.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and client relationship skills.

  • Experience with industry-standard engineering and design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, ETAP, Aspen, CAPE, or similar tools.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a remote environment.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for project, client, and team needs.

  • Advanced degree in Engineering or a related technical field and 10 years of relevant experience.

  • Experience supporting utility, renewable energy, grid modernization, or energy transition projects.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical leadership initiatives.

  • Familiarity with substation physical design, protection and control systems, SCADA integration, or related power system applications.

THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 30,2026

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
