jobs.title: Sales Representative (SaaS)
jobs.excerpt: Why TrueML? TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers.
jobs.description:
Why TrueML?

TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.

The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

We are looking for a highly motivated Sales Representative to partner directly with our Enterprise Sales Executive. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing high-value, complex enterprise deals and driving faster deal progression. This is a unique opportunity to learn the ropes of enterprise-level tech sales from the inside out while contributing meaningfully to our revenue growth and customer success.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive Deal Momentum: Partner closely with the Enterprise Sales Executive across all phases of the sales cycle—from discovery to close—to help accelerate deals and boost close rates.

  • Own Meeting Execution: Prepare tailored agendas, create materials for prospect calls, attend high-stakes meetings, and take charge of all follow-up actions to keep opportunities moving forward.

  • Conduct Account Research: Dive deep into market and account research to identify potential customers and gather key insights that personalize our outreach.

  • Optimize Sales Materials: Customize pitch decks, case studies, and ROI calculators for specific verticals or clients to maximize our impact and conversion rates.

  • Manage Pipeline Intelligence: Monitor active opportunities, maintain accurate CRM entries for clean forecasting, and provide timely alerts on critical actions needed to close deals.

  • Act as a Cross-Functional Liaison: Coordinate smoothly with Marketing, Product, Legal, and Solutions teams to quickly deliver proposals, pricing, security reviews, and contracts.

  • Analyze the Competition: Gather and maintain up-to-date intel on competitor offerings to help the team tailor messaging and confidently overcome objections.

  • Streamline Workflows: Continuously look for opportunities to automate repeatable tasks and improve internal processes to reduce sales cycle friction

Who You Are (Qualifications):

  • Experienced Tracker: You bring 3-4 years of experience in sales, business development, or a client-facing role (ideally within SaaS or B2B).

  • Growth-Minded Team Player: You possess a proactive attitude and a genuine desire to learn and grow your career within enterprise tech sales.

  • Master Organizer: You have strong organizational skills and thrive when managing multiple priorities at once.

  • Strong Communicator: You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, allowing you to connect professionally with internal teams and external clients.

  • Tech-Savvy: You are comfortable using CRM tools (like Salesforce or HubSpot), Microsoft Office, and standard sales engagement platforms.

  • Curious & Interested: You bring an interest in financial technology or collections, which will give you a head start in understanding our space.

What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)

  • Flexible vacation

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance

  • Traditional/Roth retirement savings options

  • Company-paid disability and life insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA

  • Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off

  • On-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family

  • PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide

Remote Work, Travel Expectations & Physical Requirements:

This role supports a global, cross-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects.

This position primarily involves computer-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required.

Personally Identifying Information

We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy.

Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.

What You'll Do:

  • Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
  • Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
  • Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.

  • Travel Ready:Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

What You Bring:

  • Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
  • Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)

  • Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
  • Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
  • Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
  • Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
  • Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
  • Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: About VGSVGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce.
jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

VGS is looking for an experienced payments nerd who is passionate about understanding the inner workings of payment stacks and who, in a single day, can earn a prospect CTO's trust, map a complex payment flow with an existing customer payments leader, and work directly with VGS product and implementation engineers to design secure, scalable integrations.

We are seeking a Solutions Architect with a solid software engineering background who excels at aligning technical strategy with business goals. You will collaborate closely with prospective and existing clients to understand their needs and translate technology into tangible business value, partnering with payment companies and enterprise merchants on complex challenges in global payment infrastructure, processor connectivity, credential portability, tokenization, and sensitive payment data.

You will work closely with Sales and Account Management throughout the deal lifecycle, and with Product and Engineering to shape both our roadmap and go-to-market strategy based on what you learn in the field.

What You'll Do

Discovery & Solution Architecture

  • Conduct technical discovery with customers, Sales, and Account Management to clarify business goals, requirements, risks, and product gaps.

  • Map payment flows across merchants, PSPs, processors, acquirers, card networks, wallets, and third parties.

  • Architect solutions using VGS capabilities including vaulting, card management, network and Agentic Tokens, Account Updater, 3DS, wallet payments, account validation, and data security.

  • Guide customers on payment security best practices, PCI scope reduction, credential portability, multi-processor setups, resiliency, and scaling.

  • Identify technical and commercial risks early, including scope, dependencies, and ownership issues.

Deal Support & Delivery

  • Lead technical strategy for qualified opportunities, from discovery through architecture approval and implementation handoff.

  • Create and deliver architecture diagrams, proposals, demos, and proofs of concept.

  • Lead responses for RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, and architecture assessments.

  • Collaborate with customer engineers on APIs, webhooks, auth, data models, error handling, and integrations.

  • Produce detailed handoffs covering solution architecture, assumptions, responsibilities, testing, success metrics, and out-of-scope items.

  • Provide technical oversight through launch to ensure implementations match approved architectures.

Product Influence & Enablement

  • Translate customer and market feedback into actionable input for the VGS product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

  • Develop reusable reference architectures, demos, integration patterns, and enablement assets.

  • Serve as a payments and technology subject matter expert in workshops, executive briefings, and industry events.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience across solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical consulting, payment implementation, software engineering, or a similar technical customer-facing role.

  • Experience with large-scale card or credential migrations.

  • Experience with multi-PSP, payment orchestration, processor-routing, or payment portability strategies.

  • Background at a merchant, PSP, processor, acquirer, issuer, card network, or payment infrastructure company.

  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, data security, privacy, and compliance architecture.

  • Proficiency with web services and APIs, and full-stack development, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact.

  • Strong communication skills — comfortable explaining complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, creating clear technical solution diagrams, and structuring/presenting sales and executive-level decks.

  • Comfortable writing production-grade code examples and reference implementations in one or more of VGS's primary deployment languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Ruby.

  • Strong collaboration, interpersonal, negotiation, and prioritization skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Industry certifications such as PCI QSA, CPP (Certified Payments Professional), CISSP, or AWS Solutions Architect.

  • Direct experience with card network programs (Visa, Mastercard) such as network tokenization or account updater service

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer - 3D Web Service (copy)
jobs.excerpt: Satellite and drone imagery access is on the rise, and traditional image processing methods are struggling to keep up.
jobs.description:
Satellite and drone imagery access is on the rise, and traditional image processing methods are struggling to keep up. We've never had more data, turning those pixels into trusted, measurable understanding still takes months of AI work. HUNTR™ reduces this to hours.
We do not sell models. We provide the infrastructure that lets governments and enterprises build, validate, deploy and operate visual models they own. From pixel inputs to operational 2D and 3D outputs, under full sovereign control. Once deployed, every new sensor observation improves the customer's understanding of reality. Wherever the mission takes place, HUNTR™ runs there - from SaaS and private cloud to on-premise, classified networks and edge hardware in the field
We kicked off in 2020 and have secured $35 million in Series A funding from a lineup of top US and European investors, among which Microsoft M12, Point72 Ventures, Maxar, In-Q-Tel, SAFRAN, and ISAI/Capgemini.
The HUNTR™ workflow produces 3D outputs alongside 2D detections. Customers who need full simulation fidelity consume those through game engines. Others need to open the result in a browser, navigate it and make decision. We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build a 3D viewer inside the HUNTR™ application.

Your Mission

  • Build the 3D viewer inside the HUNTR application that renders pipeline outputs as 3D Tiles in the browser, on the hardware analysts actually have.
  • Integrate the viewer into the end-to-end workflow. When a job finishes, the 3D result appears next to the imagery and detections that produced it, in the same interface, without a download step.
  • Design the interaction model for operational use: navigation, inspection, orientation between the 3D view and the underlying 2D data.
  • Work with the teams producing the tilesets on what the pipeline emits, so the browser consumes it directly and rendering constraints are fixed upstream rather than patched in the client.
  • Keep it performant on ordinary laptops. Tile size, texture compression, request patterns and load time are measured, not guessed.
  • Ship one viewer across SaaS, single-tenant cloud, on-premise and edge deployments.

Your Profile

  • You have strong practical experience with Vue.js and building complex, stateful single-page applications.
  • You have rendered 3D geospatial content in the browser with Cesium or an equivalent library, and you have worked with 3D Tiles or a comparable tiled 3D format
  • You have solid software engineering fundamentals: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, component and integration testing, CI/CD, performance profiling.
  • You are familiar with geospatial concepts: coordinate reference systems, raster vs. vector data, tiled data structures, GeoJSON.
  • You consume REST APIs and manage asynchronous state against long-running backend jobs
  • You have a strong sense for UX in technical products. You translate a complex workflow into a clear interface without stripping out its power.
  • You are outcome-oriented and take pride in shipping interfaces that users want to work in.

Tech Stack

  • Node.js, Vue.js, TypeScript
  • Cesium, 3D Tiles
  • OpenLayers
  • Cypress
  • REST APIs
  • Docker, Kubernetes

Why join us

  • Own the surface where 3D reaches the customer: every 3D result the pipeline produces ends in your viewer.
  • Real constraints: analysts on ordinary hardware, on-premise and edge deployments, and a result that has to be usable the moment the job finishes.
  • Diverse deployment challenges: ship a single application that runs in the cloud, on classified networks, or on a laptop in the field.
  • Strong technical culture: work alongside 3D graphics engineers, ML engineers and GIS specialists solving novel problems.
  • Competitive compensation with flexible working arrangements and personalized benefits including learning opportunities, mental wellbeing programs, and healthcare.
The minimum salary is 56.000,--€ gross per year. The effective salary depends on qualification and experience and may be significantly higher!

BayNova is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Database Administrator to join our team in support of a mission-critical federal government client in a remote / work from home role.

The position will support the organization’s migration from SAP ASE to PostgreSQL, requiring strong expertise in PostgreSQL administration along with working knowledge of legacy SAP ASE / Sybase environments. Responsibilities include database monitoring, maintenance, replication, scripting, backup/recovery strategies, capacity planning, security, and performance tuning.

This role requires an excellent leader and team player who is central to daily project operations, maintenance, and oversight activities in a dynamic 24x7 customer‑facing environment.

Responsiblities

  • Provide technical expertise in administering and maintaining production and non‑production PostgreSQL environments running on Linux.
  • Lead efforts in database physical design, query optimization, indexing strategies, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Implement PostgreSQL replication, backup and recovery strategies, monitoring, and disaster‑recovery capabilities.
  • Support schema conversions, data migrations, performance validation, and cutover activities as part of the ASE‑to‑Postgres migration.
  • Evaluate PostgreSQL configuration parameters; recommend improvements and best practices for stability and performance.
  • Maintain capacity planning, security controls, patching/upgrade strategy, and proactive database health assessments
  • Provide working expertise for the existing ASE environment during the migration lifecycle.
  • Troubleshoot ASE performance issues, analyze error logs, validate configuration parameters, support replication server processes, and assist with patching/upgrade activities as needed.
  • Document ASE environment characteristics to support migration planning and knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in decommissioning and transitioning ASE instances following successful migration milestones.
  • Oversee daily ticket queue triage and assign work to other DBAs, providing mentorship and technical leadership to a small team.
  • Coordinate activities with customer project management and contract project managers.
  • Participate in complex customer/project meetings, needs assessments, technical design reviews, and solution feasibility discussions.
  • Provide database architectural guidance and evangelize modern concepts and best practices across the team.

Required Skills

  • Expertise in core database architecture: objects, file structures, tables, views, procedures, functions, triggers, sequences, indexes, constraints.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with PostgreSQL administration, including installation, configuration, performance tuning, backup/recovery, replication, security, and monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience with the SAP ASE technology stack (ASE, Replication Server, etc.), including performance tuning, patching, replication, and upgrade planning.
  • Experience with database architecture design concepts and the ability to clearly communicate these concepts to the team.

  • Strong SQL skills (SQL, PL/pgSQL, T‑SQL) and proficiency with one or more shell scripting languages (Bash, Korn, etc.).

  • Strong understanding of Linux OS features and how they affect both PostgreSQL and ASE.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL in enterprise environments (preferred).
  • 4‑year degree in an IT‑related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of scripting experience (preferred)

About Virtru:

While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control.

We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it.

Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best-in-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up.

Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise.

Nextiva is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and modernize our CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling. You’ll focus on one of the most important parts of the engineering experience: getting code from commit to production quickly, reliably, and safely.

Additional experience that will help you succeed

AI literacy

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

jobs.description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

  • Familiarity with DevOps technologies, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Version Control Systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience in technical customer-facing roles, ideally supporting a cloud / cloud-security product.

Technical expertise and strong customer-facing skills will be essential in addressing the needs of our customers.   • Continuously stay abreast and enabled on new Wiz features and functionality.
  • Drive Adoption, Business Value Realization, and Customer Satisfaction – Ensure your book of customers are delighted and seeing value from their Wiz purchase.
  • Help customers develop success plans with measurable goals throughout the Wiz lifecycle that align with their organizational security and compliance objectives.
  • Act proactively by leading the customer on a journey to full adoption and value, and promoting excellence in addressing Cloud, Code, and Runtime security risk.
  • Use your expert knowledge of the Wiz platform and features to accelerate your customers’ success and attainment of value.
  • Assist customers in project managing Wiz adoption and operationalization goals across business units and stakeholders.

UserGems' Account Development Reps are the front line of our outbound engine.

We organize around a few teams, each responsible for a distinct part of the product:

  • AI: owns our agentic co-editor, Underlord, and the external API that allows it to scale. Help improve Underlord's harness to enhance its powers, polish its UX and editor integration, and add more capability to our API to unleash Underlord on the world.

Regardless of your team you’ll have the opportunity to design thoughtful full-stack systems that work reliably and deliver value to new and existing users.

What You’ll Own

  • Own meaningful product surfaces end to end. Take problems from definition through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and maintenance. Improve core Editor workflows, shape the self-serve journey from signup through renewal, or help make Underlord more sentient.
  • Shape the product, not just the implementation. Partner with Product and Design to propose better interactions, expose constraints, choose the right metrics, and find simpler paths to user outcomes.
  • Build ambitious full-stack systems with care. Create responsive, reliable experiences. Stretch from TypeScript and React to NodeJS and Temporal to first and third party integrations to get the job done.
  • Improve how the team learns and ships. Form hypotheses, instrument your work, release incrementally, and read results honestly. Strengthen the tooling, standards, tests, observability, and release practices that help the team move quickly without compromising quality.

About ProShip
ProShip, Inc. is a market-leading provider of enterprise multi-carrier parcel shipping software, trusted by 30% of the National Retail Federation's Top 100 Shippers, including Kohl's, Ulta Beauty, QVC, Petco, and TJX. Founded in 2001 by two U.S. Navy veterans, ProShip built its platform on a simple belief: shipping is complicated, but it shouldn't have to be.

Today, ProShip's versionless, carrier-agnostic platform performs carrier rating, business-rule execution, and label printing in milliseconds — giving the highest-volume shippers in retail, e-commerce, manufacturing, healthcare, and third-party logistics the speed, intelligence, and reliability they need to turn shipping into a competitive advantage. As part of Vela Software Group (a division of Constellation Software), ProShip combines the agility and focus of an independent software company with the stability of a global technology portfolio.

Position Summary
ProShip is seeking a results-driven Director of Sales to lead new business growth for our enterprise shipping software platform. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying leadership role responsible for building and scaling a high-performing sales team, running complex enterprise sales cycles, and shaping go-to-market strategy across ProShip's core verticals — retail, e-commerce, 3PL/logistics, manufacturing, and healthcare. You will partner closely with executive leadership, marketing, product, and customer success to translate ProShip's technical differentiation into revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.description:
About Us:
Heyo is a dynamic and innovative full service agency that specializes in creating cutting-edge design and development. We're on a mission to revolutionize user experiences through intuitive and responsive web interfaces. Join our talented team of engineers, designers, and product managers to help us build the future of web.

Position Overview:
We're looking for a Product Manager to be the primary interface between our clients and the rest of the team. You'll own the product side of each engagement, from the first conversation about what a client needs through delivery of the finished feature. Most of our work starts at 0 and gets to 1, so you'll spend a lot of time turning fuzzy goals into concrete, buildable specs.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work day to day with a Project Manager who owns timelines and delivery logistics, so you can stay focused on the what and the why. An Engineering Manager will back you up on technical feasibility and architecture decisions, and you'll build alongside our engineers and designers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact between clients and our design and engineering teams

  • Lead client conversations: gather requirements, align on goals, demo work in progress, and manage expectations when priorities compete

  • Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specs that engineers can build from without guesswork

  • Prioritize the backlog and guide trade-off decisions, partnering with your Project Manager on timelines and dependencies

  • Work closely with our engineers and designers to take features from 0 to 1

  • Spot product and technical risks early and work through them with the Engineering Manager and the team

  • Define and track product metrics so we can show clients what's working and recommend what to do next

Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years in product management or a related role

  • You've taken a product, or a major feature, from 0 to 1

  • Comfortable leading client conversations and translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience managing client expectations and juggling competing priorities

  • You use data to make decisions and can define the metrics that matter for a product

  • User focused, with enough technical fluency to weigh engineering trade-offs

  • Experience in agile environments with distributed teams

  • You make strong use of AI tooling in your day-to-day work

  • Proficiency with Linear (what we use) or Jira

  • Agency or consultancy experience is a plus, but not required

Heyo offers a variety of benefits, including:

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Flexible schedule (make up your time for important personal, life, family events). We take work / life balance seriously!

  • 4 day client work weeks. We spend Friday's working on internal needs and personal betterment.

  • You'll get in trouble if we catch you working nights and weekends. For reals.

  • 1 week paid holiday rest at the end of the year. Over 3 weeks of company holidays throughout the year.

  • Health insurance coverage.

  • 401k Plan & matching.

  • Paid parental, adoption/caregiver leave.

  • Education & conference budget.

Everyone is welcome.
Heyo is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.Heyo is a tight knit team of individuals that love the work we do and more importantly, love the people we get to do it with. If a company who loves doing great work and focuses on people over profits sounds like the type of culture you're looking for, apply now!

Social Media and ReviewMining & Sentiment Analysis

Cost of Poor Experience Modeling

  • Collaborate with Finance and Product teams to estimate cost of remediation and potential ROI of improvement initiatives.

Strategic Forecasting

  • Model the impact on POS performance and subscription renewal based on brand perception and app/retail review ratings

  • Identify, document and present project ideas to improve customer experience on these channels

Investment Planning

  • Recommend targeted investments (e.g., product fixes, packaging changes, service enhancements) to drive positive comments/reviews.

Reporting & Communication

  • Create and present a social media dashboard to communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.

  • Build additional dashboards and executive-level presentations to communicate insights and recommendations.

  • Track progress of initiatives and their effect on sentiment, reviewscoresand customer satisfaction metrics – not just activity, but results.

  • Strong understanding of eCommerce, retail, and customer feedback ecosystems.

  • Strong project management skills: planning, prioritization, status reporting, and on-time delivery

  • Strong writing skills and excellent communication skills, with the ability to build clear, compelling narratives and storytelling that influences cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with NLP techniques for sentiment and text analysis.

jobs.title: Field Sales Engineer – Germany
jobs.excerpt: The role, at a glance: Biamp, a leading manufacturer of professional electronics for use in the installed audio and video communications market, is currently recruiting a new Field Sales Engineer who will work with customers mostly based in Germany.
jobs.description:
The role, at a glance:
Biamp, a leading manufacturer of professional electronics for use in the installed audio and video communications market, is currently recruiting a new Field Sales Engineer who will work with customers mostly based in Germany. This position is a primary source for pre-sales technical and design support for all Biamp’s products.
The mission of this technical sales position is to assist the channel sales team in achieving the company’s sales targets by educating end users, consultants, AV integrators and distributors on design and performance attributes of Biamp’s products and technology, in a pre-sale capacity. The goal is to ensure the client specifies the right Biamp system for their project and is certain of achieving the performance they expect. The Field Sales Engineer also provides training and coaching to the design and installation teams for the distributor or AV integrator, with the aim of completing projects more effectively and profitably. This position partners closely with Biamp account managers and members of the business development team, as well as with the technical support team, whilst maintaining a close relationship with the customer.

How you'll contibute:

  • The Field Sales Engineer will take a leadership role through the technology evaluation stage of the sales process with major projects and key clients, remaining available to assist during the development of system design.

  • Manage all elements of the technical communication between Biamp and end users, consultants, AV and control integrators and distributors up to the point where the product is ordered. This includes writing (or participating in writing) proposals, drafting design drawings, providing quotations and creating any technical documentation or guidance required during the pre-sale stage.

  • After being introduced into a project by the Sales or Account Manager, a Field Sales Engineer’s responsibility is to develop relationships with decision-makers and technical staff, becoming their technical resource and reference.

  • Provide demonstrations and training of the technological aspects of Biamp’s products and solutions in the field to system integrators, consultants, end-users and distributors on all aspects of Biamp’s equipment, its functions and its uses.

  • Drive the sales process through all phases requiring technical or design decisions. Fully explain to clients how a Biamp solution solves their issues. Help increase Biamp market share by providing world-class technical expertise on every project.

  • Participate in regional trade shows as necessary, meeting customers at the booth and delivering equipment demos or providing technical expertise.

  • Maintain an ethos of constant self-improvement on sales techniques and technical skills.

  • Work in conjunction with Biamp sales managers as the key technical advisor and product advocate.

  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.

  • This position will be located in Germany or a neighboring country.

You'll also support with:

  • Maintaining and upgrading the experience center in our facility.

  • Providing input and guidance for the creation of operations manuals for new products.

  • Creating and proofreading content for Biamp’s online knowledgebase.

  • Reporting client feedback on technical matters to Biamp leadership. Identifying and reporting any areas that could be improved for increased customer satisfaction.

  • Other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

A successful candidate should have:

  • Comprehensive general technical audio, video and control knowledge.

  • Experience with programming and installing AV and control systems.

  • AV networking design experience with CCNA, CCNP, CCDP, ENS, CompTIA or other relevant IT industry qualifications is a big plus.

  • Good computer literacy skills, including working knowledge of the MS Office suite, Visio & CAD programs and EASE Focus / Address.

  • Experience interfacing with distributors, system integrators, consultants, and end-users in the professional audio-visual and control industry.

  • Strong technical presentation skills, and the ability to address a wide range of business and technical people, from company presidents to non-technical staff.

  • Ability to build long-term relationships with customers.

  • Ability to work as part of a team.

  • Experience with international travel.

  • Excellent written and verbal English & Germany skills. The ability to speak and write fluently in another European language (Dutch or French) is a big plus.

  • Relevant degree or professional qualifications are desirable.

The position requires the ability to travel often and at short notice in Germany as
well as occasional trips throughout Europe and Biamp’s headquarters in
Beaverton, Oregon. This position includes the payment of all travel and office
costs, including office equipment. The Field Sales Engineer reports to the Field
Sales Engineering Manager, Europe & Africa.

Work Environment:

  • Work from home with up to 75% of travel.

Who is Biamp?

We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space.

As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences.

About our company:

At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

We are looking for a candidate who applies CRO principles not just for incremental gains, but to prototype entirely new ways for parents to discover, experience, and purchase our services.

You will maximise upsell opportunities and ensure customers are matched with the optimal products to not only positively affect ARPU, but also boost LTV.

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience with a heavy focus on Growth, Activation, and CRO. You should have innate commercial intuition with a proven track record of successful product design.

  • You possess elite skills in performance tracking and product analytics. You don't guess; you are able to dig into, manipulate, and present data to prove your prototypes work.

  • Experience in managing international consumer products; you know how to adapt and reinvent funnels for diverse global markets.

  • Manage the Agile process with our engineering team, ensuring that prototypes are delivered and scaled with technical excellence.

  • You thrive in a 100% remote, distributed team environment and are a master of tools like JIRA and Slack.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work (core hours GMT+3).

  • Bonuses and stock options – we grow together.

Sr Director, Product Management - Capital One Shopping - Growth (Remote-Eligible)

About Capital One Shopping

Capital One Shopping is an industry-leading consumer technology business that is changing the way people buy and save online. The team operates with extreme focus to accelerate growth of the Shopping business, find best-in-market savings for shoppers, and create unique value for our merchant partners.

Technology and a lean/rapid test-and-learn methodology are applied to nearly all of our business challenges. The team has a flat organizational structure that emphasizes clear ownership, small teams, and leverage through technology.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Director to join our team to improve and integrate new product and revenue opportunities with our merchant partners, and drive cross-functional execution within Shopping.This Product Director will have a demonstrated interest and aptitude for AI. While formal on-the-job experience with AI is a plus, we highly value candidates who have proactively incorporated AI into their personal projects, explored AI-driven development environments (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), or built automations using AI agents. In this role, you will be a key driver of business growth - owning all aspects of the team, technology, and tooling that onboards and activates merchant relationships across Shopping’s suite of product experiences:

  • Work directly with engineering in an individual contributor and cross-functional leadership capacity to design and build optimized consumer incentive and reward experiences

  • Manage the day-to-day operations and engineering execution of directly owned and supporting teams to iteratively launch and test new experiences

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, exhibiting data and market backed judgment from ideation through to launch

  • Own the business case, prioritization, and monitoring for the product experiences under your purview, building a suite of operational reports and models using SQL, Excel, and financial modeling to drive optimal investment decisions

The ideal candidate is a high-leverage, data-driven product leader who combines startup grit with the technical depth and product intuition to build products that deliver world-class results.

  • Competitive and Ambitious Mindset: You are a self-driven performer who aims to be among the best in the world at what you do. You independently and continuously seek to grow and improve and want to be around others who are similarly driven. You observe and study other best-in-class companies and people and have a well-formed opinion about what makes them great.

You observe and take note of areas of opportunity every time you personally install a new app or digital service. You have a strong preference to rapidly AB test experiences and observe real results vs. debate what the “perfect design” is.

You are likely building with AI in your spare time and prefer working as “one team” with engineering in a lean, fluid environment rather than through rigid planning processes. Engineering teams are used to hearing you ask “Can you walk me through how this would work?” as you evaluate whether our technical approaches are as simple and elegant as possible.

You will operate in an AI-first way, using AI tools to scale your impact, deliver deeper insights, and enable organisers to run more efficient, self-sufficient operations.

This is a high-ownership, high-intensity role — you’ll be expected to be able to troubleshoot, assess impact and importance in order to operate with urgency, and to build deep relationships and show up when it matters most (including onsite at events).

Own Commercial Performance & Retention

Drive Product Adoption & Value

Who We Are

Let's Do This is the online company that gets everyone together offline.

We exist to inspire people across the world to come together and experience moments that make them feel alive. We’re focused on mass participation sports events (such as Marathons, Triathlons, 10Ks, 5Ks, swim races), where we’re proud to be the global leader.

We’re at a super exciting and rapid stage of our development. We now take over 2.5 million bookings every year, driving growth for our industry from large-scale races like the UK’s London Marathon Events and the Great North Run to hero races like BOLDERBoulder, Peachtree Road Race, Honolulu Marathon, and iconic races like Leadvile 100 and the Diplo Run Club Series.

We’ve grown exponentially in the UK since our launch in 2017 and are now in the process of expanding within the US market with the same energy our brand represents. jobs.title: 2025-2026 AI/ML Research Fellow
jobs.excerpt: 10 places are open for the 2026 term, with a duration of 6 or 12 months at the applicant's option.
jobs.description:
10 places are open for the 2026 term, with a duration of 6 or 12 months at the applicant's option.

The intent of the fellowship is to focus on high risk research: ambitious projects that may not produce results, but will have lasting impact if they work.

We believe that publication in AI/ML has become overly biased towards short-term and iterative results, despite major gaps in our understanding of how to build optimal models.

Our focus is on frontier research: order-of-magnitude improvements, rather than disposable papers barely better than baseline.

The goal of these fellowships is to give awardees uninterrupted time to focus on harder open problems, with adequate compute, talented peers, and weekly 1:1 mentorship from senior researchers but without chasing specific metrics.

You will be expected to spend about 80% of your time on your own research, and up to 20% of your time either assisting other fellows or participating in wider research programs at IMI. We focus largely on applied research and its applications to online security problems, but often publish and support frontier research aligned with our broader interests. Serving hundreds of millions of people gives us a unique perspective as to what works at scale.

Eligibility: previous fellows and research staff have come from disparate backgrounds, including early career researchers previously at MSR, FAIR, Mila, MPI, etc. and self taught senior engineers transitioning into research.

We do not discriminate on the basis of pedigree or age. If you have done interesting work, that is enough. Conversely, if you don't already have publications that show you can do good self-directed research then this is not the right opportunity.

Location: you may reside anywhere in the world, excluding sanctioned jurisdictions. This will be a remote fellowship. We do not sponsor visas.

Deliverables: we do not have hard targets, and focus on quality. Fellows generally get 1-2 papers with code done in a year, targeting NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc. At the end of your fellowship, if the threshold for refereed publication is unmet we will expect a final report, which may be published as a blog post.

Full details are available at:

(imachines dot com slash imi-ai-ml-fellowships-2025-2026-high-risk-research)

Applying: send a brief bio / CV link via this page. Include 1) the topic you are interested in working on, 2) a few lines on any relevant prior work you've done, 3) your github / scholar / x links, 4) your desired start date, duration, and other obligations (if any) during that period, and 5) a brief analysis of one of the projects outlined on the page linked above.

Each project we have listed intentionally includes some gaps or glosses. List the ones you see, and how you'd solve them. Alternatively, if you dislike the projects outlined under a particular topic, briefly write up your own idea and why it is more promising, along with your estimate of time and compute required.

Deadline: Admitting fellows in two cohorts. Deadlines for consideration: April 1 and September 1 2026. 3 week decision period. Rolling thereafter.

Compensation: competitive location-adjusted stipend, conference and travel support for conferences with accepted papers.

After the fellowship: past fellows have stayed on in full-time roles at IMI or co-founded AI unicorns. This is a selective process, so we claim little credit for their success. However, we will support your next steps.

Selection criteria: novelty and importance, clarity of approach, feasibility given time/compute, alignment with topics. Panel review and one interview.

Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.

Selection is based on merit. We promote equality of opportunity, and welcome applications from anyone with talent, skills and potential. IMI is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, orientation, race, religion or belief.

Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

Colabora con equipos multifuncionales (Planificación de Producto, Ingeniería de Sistemas, HMI, Software, Hardware y Validación) para descomponer necesidades de clientes y stakeholders en requisitos funcionales y no funcionales a nivel de plataforma.

Analiza y valida requisitos para asegurar que sean completos, consistentes, factibles, no ambiguos y alineados con los objetivos del programa.

Gestiona la trazabilidad bidireccional desde las necesidades del cliente hasta los requisitos de sistema, subsistema, software, hardware y validación.

Facilita revisiones cruzadas para resolver conflictos, brechas, suposiciones y dependencias de interfaz con stakeholders globales.

Utiliza herramientas como IBM DOORS Next Gen para autorizar, trazabilidad, revisión y reporte de requisitos.

Incorpora estándares de seguridad (ISO 26262), ciberseguridad, regulatorios e industriales en los requisitos del producto.

Trabaja con equipos de validación para definir criterios de aceptación, métodos de verificación y confirmar la cobertura de requisitos.

Importancia:

Su trabajo es esencial para asegurar que los productos automotrices (como sistemas eléctricos, de propulsión o autónomos) cumplan con los requisitos del cliente, los estándares de calidad y los plazos corporativos, minimizando riesgos técnicos, de tiempo y costos.

Conocimiento en Ingeniería de Sistemas Automotrices:

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Head of Manufacturing Informatics to lead and grow our Manufacturing Informatics business across sales, business development, solutioning, delivery, and operations.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Head of Manufacturing Informatics to lead and grow our Manufacturing Informatics business across sales, business development, solutioning, delivery, and operations.

The role will be responsible for developing the market strategy, building executive-level relationships with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences manufacturing organizations, identifying and converting new business opportunities, and ensuring successful execution of Manufacturing Informatics programs.

The leader will own the complete business lifecycle—from market development and pipeline creation through solution development, contracting, delivery, customer success, and account expansion.

The ideal candidate will combine strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and manufacturing informatics with demonstrated experience in commercial leadership, consulting, solution sales, program delivery, and team management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Strategy & Growth

  • Define and execute the Manufacturing Informatics business strategy aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Develop a differentiated market proposition across MES, EBR, Manufacturing Intelligence, Digital Manufacturing, LIMS/ELN integration, OT/IT integration, and Industry 4.0.
  • Identify target markets, accounts, partnerships, and emerging opportunities within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
  • Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline and revenue forecast.
  • Establish annual bookings, revenue, margin, and growth targets for the business.
  • Develop go-to-market strategies for new services, solutions, and accelerators.
  • Identify opportunities for geographic expansion and new customer segments.
  • Build strategic partnerships with technology vendors, system integrators, and manufacturing technology providers.

2. Sales & Business Development

  • Own the Manufacturing Informatics sales lifecycle, from lead generation through contract closure.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders including CIO, CDO, COO, VP Manufacturing, VP Digital, QA, IT, Engineering, and Operations leaders.
  • Lead customer discovery sessions and understand manufacturing transformation priorities.
  • Develop account strategies and identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities.
  • Lead RFP/RFI responses, proposals, presentations, solution workshops, and commercial negotiations.
  • Partner with sales teams to qualify opportunities and establish winning strategies.
  • Develop compelling value propositions and business cases demonstrating measurable customer outcomes.
  • Build relationships with strategic accounts and establish long-term managed-service and transformation engagements.
  • Represent the organization at industry conferences, customer forums, and executive meetings.

3. Manufacturing Informatics Solution Leadership

Provide thought leadership and oversight across:

  • MES strategy and implementation
  • Electronic Batch Records (EBR)
  • MES selection and vendor evaluation
  • Manufacturing process assessment and digital transformation
  • Manufacturing requirements and business process design
  • Recipe and master data management
  • Manufacturing intelligence and analytics
  • LIMS/ELN/MES integration
  • ERP–MES–LIMS integration
  • OT/IT integration
  • Serialization and track & trace
  • Digital manufacturing and Industry 4.0
  • Manufacturing data platforms
  • Cloud and hybrid manufacturing architectures
  • AI/ML applications in manufacturing

The leader should be capable of connecting business manufacturing needs, technology strategy, regulatory requirements, and implementation execution.

4. People & Organization Leadership

  • Help Build and lead a high-performing Manufacturing Informatics organization.
  • Develop organizational structure, competency models, career paths, and succession plans.
  • Recruit and retain experienced MES, EBR, manufacturing technology, solution architecture, and consulting professionals.
  • Develop future leaders and technical SMEs.
  • Establish a culture focused on customer value, innovation, accountability, quality, and commercial performance.
  • Balance utilization, employee development, and business growth.
  • Promote collaboration across Sales, Delivery, Technology, Quality, and other business functions.

5. Innovation & Digital Transformation

  • Define the organization's Manufacturing Informatics innovation roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, analytics, digital twins, cloud technologies, and intelligent manufacturing.
  • Develop reusable accelerators, frameworks, and intellectual property.
  • Explore AI-enabled manufacturing use cases such as:
    • Batch record review
    • Manufacturing deviation analysis
    • Manufacturing knowledge assistants
    • Electronic batch record intelligence
    • Process analytics
    • Predictive maintenance
    • Manufacturing data contextualization
    • Automated documentation
    • Manufacturing investigation support
  • Ensure emerging technologies are evaluated for business value, cybersecurity, GxP compliance, data integrity, and operational risk.

6. Financial & Business Management

  • Own or contribute to the Manufacturing Informatics P&L.
  • Establish and manage revenue, bookings, margin, utilization, and profitability targets.
  • Develop annual operating plans and budgets.
  • Monitor sales pipeline, backlog, revenue forecast, and resource demand.
  • Drive improvements in gross margin and delivery efficiency.
  • Evaluate investments in people, technology, partnerships, and accelerators based on ROI.
  • Provide regular business performance updates to executive leadership.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured through a balanced set of commercial, operational, and customer metrics, including:

Growth

  • Revenue growth
  • New bookings
  • Sales pipeline and pipeline coverage
  • New logo acquisition
  • Existing account expansion
  • Average deal size

Profitability

  • Gross margin
  • EBITDA / contribution margin
  • Revenue realization
  • Delivery productivity
  • Resource utilization

Customer

  • Customer satisfaction / NPS
  • Renewal rate
  • Account penetration
  • Executive relationships
  • Referenceable customers

Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in Manufacturing Informatics, MES, Digital Manufacturing, Life Sciences IT, Manufacturing IT, or related consulting/services environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated manufacturing organizations.
  • Significant experience in MES/EBR and manufacturing digital transformation.
  • Proven track record in business development and consultative selling.
  • Experience managing large and complex manufacturing technology programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage senior customer relationships.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and global delivery models.
  • Experience with financial management, forecasting, utilization, margins, and P&L/business-unit management is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with RFPs, proposals, solution architecture, commercial negotiations, and contract management.
  • Strong understanding of GxP, CSV/CSA, data integrity, cybersecurity, and regulated manufacturing environments.

Preferred Technical Knowledge

Strong understanding of one or more of the following platforms and ecosystems:

  • Siemens Opcenter
  • Rockwell FactoryTalk / PharmaSuite
  • Körber Werum PAS-X
  • Emerson Syncade
  • MasterControl
  • SAP Digital Manufacturing
  • SAP ERP
  • Oracle Manufacturing

Benefits

CURIOSITY DRIVEN, SCIENCE FOCUSED, EMPLOYEE BUILT. Our culture is unlike any other, one where we debate, challenge ourselves, and interact with all alike. We are a curious bunch, characterized by our passion to learn and spirit of teamwork. Zifo is a global R&D solutions provider focused on the industries of Pharma, Biotech, Manufacturing QC, Medical Devices, specialty chemicals and other research-based organizations. Our team’s knowledge of science and expertise in technology help Zifo better serve our customers around the globe, including 18 of the Top 20 Biopharma companies.

We look for Science – Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Microbiology etc. We possess scientific and technical knowledge and bear professional and personal goals. While we have a “no doors” policy to promote free access within, we do have a tough door to walk in. We search with a two-point agenda – technical competency and cultural adaptability.

We offer a competitive compensation package including accrued vacation, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company matching, life insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

If you share these sentiments and are prepared for the atypical, then Zifo is your calling!

Zifo is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


Role Overview

We're looking for an experienced Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of the payments platform and experiences that help drive the accelerated growth we’ve experienced across our Grading and Marketplace business lines, including our Liquidity offerings and Digital Repacking product (Power Packs).

Money movement sits underneath nearly everything Collectors does. Every grading submission, vault transaction, marketplace sale, consignment payout, among other transactional experiences relies on a payment stack that has to be fast, resilient, cost-effective and compliant across a growing number of business models and expanding globally. This role will own that stack outright: how funds come in, how funds go out, how they are routed and how customers see and control their money in our products.

You will work with stakeholders across our Marketplace and Grading business lines, Finance and Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk, as well as other Product and Tech partner teams, with regular exposure to the executive team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the payments strategy and roadmap. Set a multi-year direction for the payment platform that serves today's revenue lines and anticipates the ones we haven't launched yet. Sequence platform investment against near-term business commitments and defend those tradeoffs with executives.

  • Build a wallet that customers can use across our products and platforms. Own balance and activity views, top-up, withdrawal, and split-pay, turning stored value from a settlement mechanism into a reason customers choose us.

  • Take payments international. Deliver the payment, currency, and local method capabilities, partnering with Tax and Legal on registration, reporting obligations including DAC7, and market-by-market compliance.

  • Run money-in and money-out end to end. Acquiring, alternative payment methods, payouts, settlement, funding patterns, and reconciliation, including the ledger and reporting foundation Finance depends on for accurate, timely close.

  • Drive orchestration and cost optimization. Own multi-PSP routing, least-cost routing, failover and redundancy, retry and decline strategy, and network-level economics. Treat authorization rate and cost per transaction as products you are accountable for, not metrics you report on.

  • Partner internally with Risk and Fraud teams to reduce payment fraud and dispute loss, transaction screening, chargeback and dispute workflows, and the approval-rate-versus-loss tradeoff.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years in product management, with deep payments or consumer fintech experience. You have owned production payment systems at meaningful scale, not adjacent surfaces. Senior IC experience at a high-growth marketplace, fintech, or platform company is preferable.

  • Fluent in the payments stack. Card networks and interchange, gateway and PSP integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, or comparable), tokenization, 3DS and SCA, alternative and local payment methods, payouts, and dispute lifecycles. You know where the money and the failure modes actually live.

  • Experienced in cross-border payments. You have launched payments into new countries and navigated currency, local methods, and regulatory and tax reporting requirements with Legal and Compliance partners.

  • Experience with a marketplace, where pricing, promotions, and payment mechanics all pull on the same supply-and-demand levers.

  • Rigorous and decisive under ambiguity. You use data and experimentation where they apply, make high-conviction calls where they don't, and take full accountability for the outcome.

  • A clear communicator who builds alignment without authority. You compress complexity for executives and hold the line on detail with the teams building it.

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Anesthesia is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

  • Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).
  • Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.
  • Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.
  • Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.
  • Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.
  • Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.
  • Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required
  • Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.
  • Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), coding software, and claim processing systems.
  • Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and escalate for provider education.
  • Familiarity with NCCI edits, LCD/NCD guidelines, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ensuring accurate coding and optimal reimbursement.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, working with providers, revenue cycle teams, and compliance staff.

Licenses and Certifications

  • CCS-Certified Coding Specialist (CCS-P) required or
  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC or equivalent coding certification required or
  • RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician required or
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator required

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Real Estate Development Manager
Company: Lifestyle Development Services, LLC.
Department: Development
Reports To: AVP, Development,

The Team You Will Join:

At LC, we look at each development with a sense of purpose. As such, Lifestyle Communities’ (LC) Development team leads the nation in planning communities that bring people together and enrich neighborhoods. You’ll join a dynamic team dedicated to handling all aspects of development from start to finish to ensure that our vision is never lost in the final product.

Who You Are:

As the Development Manager, you will oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of residential/multi-family and mixed-use projects within the company’s portfolio. You will work alongside the development team to support the development process, from project conceptualization to project completion, while adhering to budgets, timelines, schedules, and quality standards. You will work closely with internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and government agencies to deliver successful residential/multi-family development projects.

The Difference You Will Make:

  • Oversight for contracting and performing due diligence tasks with respect to zoning, title, environmental risk and other potential obstacles to development.
  • Coordinate with consultants and municipalities, negotiating and coordinating with architects and engineers, and reporting on project progress to principals.
  • Work collaboratively with internal departments such as legal, development, construction, Home and Hospitality, finance, and external consultants throughout the development process, taking the lead and/or assisting in a supportive or collaborative role where necessary to identify and/or mitigate key project risks.
  • Identify, propose, and support the implementation of creative or alternative project development approaches that reduce exposure to project risks and improve development schedules.
  • Manage the entitlement process for projects from start to finish by supporting zoning, permitting, regulatory compliance, design, due diligence, legal efforts, and community development actions to ensure successful completion and gain entitlements and infrastructure services for projects.
  • Monitor project progress, identify potential risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure projects are delivered within budget, schedule, and quality parameters.
  • Work with internal business partners to create business case justification.
  • Manage deal timeliness, property standards and budget goals alongside internal partners.
  • Learn and project manage deals in new real estate markets and determine local and regional zoning and licensing requirements.
  • Follow and adhere to project objectives and scope, engage project resources, develop, and manage the execution of the project plan, monitor progress, and keep department leaders informed throughout the duration of the process.
  • Guide and assist projects at each stage of the process (conceptual, discovery, execution).
  • Ensure all projects follow a standardized process for reporting, filing, and project scheduling as it relates to the development process.
  • Assists with project schedules for the development team and interfaces with public sector clients, local jurisdictions, owners, architects, engineers, design consultants, and other stake holders.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and sustainable practices within the development design and planning functions. Implement best practices to drive efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Keep up to date on changes in zoning regulations, land use policies, and environmental requirements to ensure project compliance.
  • Complete other projects as directed and assigned by senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A strong background in real estate development, including market analysis, site selection, financial analysis, and project management.
  • A “swiss army knife” type of mentality that thrives in a broad array of situations and has the energy and aptitude to grow and evolve along with our company.
  • Understanding of real estate concepts and principles.
  • Exceptional ability to gather, analyze and present project details in a thorough and concise manner.
  • Strong knowledge of real estate development principles, including market analysis, financial analysis, due diligence, entitlement processes, and project management.
  • Proficient problem solver with results driven mindset.
  • Teamwork approach - ability to work effectively with other Lifestyle companies (especially Development, Construction, Home and Hospitality business units)
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft office and Excel necessary.
  • A highly organized, self-directed, and self-motivated mindset.
  • Professional certifications or affiliations in real estate development, project management, or related areas are a plus.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Direct Reports and Reporting Relationship
  • None, however, the ability to achieve results by working with others within the organization, regardless of the reporting relationship, is a critical success factor.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree real estate, urban planning, architecture, business administration, or a related field or a combination of education and/or experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of professional, hands-on real estate experience preferably with a focus on multifamily, retail, and/or mixed-use with the demonstrated ability to oversee the entire lifecycle of project from concept through completion.

BRG123

Lifestyle Communities (LC) is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
