jobs.excerpt: Sommaire du posteLe ou la rédacteur(trice) technique bilingue est responsable de la rédaction, de la traduction, de la révision et de la mise à jour de la documentation liée au logiciel ERP, en français et en anglais.
jobs.description:
Sommaire du poste

Le ou la rédacteur(trice) technique bilingue est responsable de la rédaction, de la traduction, de la révision et de la mise à jour de la documentation liée au logiciel ERP, en français et en anglais. La personne participe à la production de guides utilisateurs, procédures, notes de mise à jour, de certains contenus de formation et libellés applicatifs, tout en veillant à la qualité linguistique, à la cohérence terminologique et à l’exactitude fonctionnelle des contenus.

Elle collabore étroitement avec l’équipe de développement, d’assurance qualité et d’implantation afin d’assurer la livraison d’une documentation claire, structurée et à jour.

Responsabilités principales

  • Rédiger, réviser, traduire, mettre à jour et structurer la documentation en français et en anglais.

  • Adapter la documentation existante, les procédures, les guides utilisateurs et les notes de mise à jour.

  • Traduire et réviser les libellés, les messages système et certains contenus de formation.

  • Assurer la cohérence terminologique au sein de l’application et de la documentation.

  • Collaborer avec les analystes, développeurs, équipe AQ et équipe d’implantation afin de valider l’exactitude du contenu des documents produits.

  • Effectuer des vérifications dans l’application pour s’assurer de la qualité, de la clarté et de la conformité des textes affichés à l’écran.

  • Identifier, documenter et signaler les anomalies de traduction, de libellés ou de documentation.

  • Effectuer les révisions linguistiques et intégrer les corrections reçues.

  • Préparer, organiser et publier les documents dans les répertoires ou plateformes internes appropriés.

  • Maintenir à jour les fichiers de suivi, les glossaires, les bases terminologiques et les documents d’avancement.

  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques, gabarits, outils et processus de rédaction et de traduction.

  • Fournir un soutien transversal en révision, traduction et validation linguistique à différentes équipes ou lignes de produits de l’organisation, selon les priorités d’affaires.

  • Apprendre à naviguer dans l’ERP et à en comprendre les principales fonctionnalités afin de produire une documentation claire, exacte et adaptée aux utilisateurs.

Poste à 100% Télétravail,

Tâches spécifiques pouvant être confiées

Produire, traduire et mettre à jour :

o guides utilisateurs;

o procédures internes;

o documentation de formation;

o notes de mise à jour;

o aide en ligne;

Effectuer le suivi de l’avancement des travaux de rédaction et de traduction.

Modifier la mise à jour d’images, de captures d’écran et de visuels liés à la documentation.

Participer aux échanges de validation avant publication.

Profil recherché

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit.

  • Capacité à vulgariser de l’information technique et fonctionnelle.

  • Très bonne aptitude à rédiger de façon claire, structurée et rigoureuse.

  • Souci du détail, de la qualité linguistique et de la cohérence.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, d’organisation et de gestion des priorités.

  • Autonomie, sens de l’initiative et esprit de collaboration.

  • Capacité à travailler avec plusieurs intervenants et à gérer plusieurs livrables simultanément.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement en développement continu, avec une approche pragmatique orientée vers les priorités et l’amélioration progressive.

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement un environnement applicatif complexe et à en comprendre les processus afin de produire une documentation pertinente.

Exigences

  • Formation en rédaction, traduction, communication, langues, documentation technique ou domaine connexe.

  • Expérience en rédaction technique, traduction et gestion documentaire en environnement logiciel, dans un contexte bilingue français anglais.

  • Bonne connaissance de la suite Microsoft Office, particulièrement Word et Excel.

  • Expérience avec des outils de traduction ou de gestion terminologique, un atout.

  • Expérience de travail avec un ERP ou des applications d’affaires, un atout.

Atouts

  • Connaissance d’outils comme Trados Studio, Antidote, SharePoint, Teams, Visio ou autres outils documentaires.

  • Familiarité avec les processus de développement logiciel, d’assurance qualité et de publication documentaire.

*Seul les candidats retenus seront contactés.

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et les candidatures des membres des groupes visés à savoir les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les personnes autochtones et les minorités visibles sont encouragées à soumettre leur candidature. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L'équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris n'a pas recours aux messages texte pour entrer en communication avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler sur des postes publiés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe de recrutement de talents pour un entretien, dès lors que les critères requis sont satisfaits.

Your expertise and passion

jobs.excerpt: At Swoop, our mission is simple: Improving patient outcomes.
jobs.description:
At Swoop, our mission is simple: Improving patient outcomes. As a market leader in AI-driven, data-powered, and privacy-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.

Our integrated, privacy-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026. We are driven by a patient-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.

About the role

Swoop’s legal team is in search of a candidate to fill the role of Associate General Counsel, Lead Privacy and Product Counsel for Swoop. The role will be tasked with navigating the complex legal and regulatory landscape associated with the company’s innovative and evolving business. The individual will exhibit initiative, adaptability, analytical acumen, and steadfast commitment to excellence in client service.

The role requires a comprehensive understanding of U.S. state and federal privacy laws and compliance activities, coupled with expertise in advertising technology, complex data and software transactions, and the media buying industry. The position, reporting to the General Counsel & Chief Privacy Officer, is designed for a legal professional poised to embrace new challenges and contribute meaningfully to our organization’s growth and success.

What you'll do

  • Support and advise on commercial legal matters with a focus on ad tech integration, third-party data licensing and sales, technology products and service offerings, digital media, and privacy matters.
  • Draft and negotiate complex client and vendor commercial agreements (e.g., master services agreements, statements of work, NDAs, insertion orders, rebate agreements, service and consulting agreements, data and software licensing, etc.).
  • Independently conduct and conclude negotiations with data and technology providers, as well as key players in the advertising and ad tech ecosystem, including large platforms, publishers, and ad tech providers.
  • Proactively manage legal requests as the first point of contact for Swoop-wide legal matters, and coordinate with lead counsel for Swoop’s affiliates to ensure cohesive approach and implementation of legal and business goals.
  • Implement legal and privacy workflow processes, create legal and compliance templates, and provide support and training to the sales and product teams you support, as well as other key stakeholders.
  • Advise teams across the company on privacy, data use and licensing, and compliance matters, while mitigating legal risks in the commercial context and working closely with cross-functional teams across the business.
  • Liaise with internal teams and senior leaders to provide strategic legal guidance and support. Facilitate communication across departments to ensure alignment with legal requirements and business objectives, fostering a collaborative environment that promotes informed decision-making and risk mitigation.
  • Handle other project-based work within the legal department on an as-needed basis.

Qualifications

  • A JD from an accredited law school and a license to practice law in at least one state — preferably the State of California, the State of New York, or the Commonwealth of Massachusetts
  • 6+ years’ relevant work experience in a law firm or in-house setting — in-house experience at an advertising/marketing/PR agency, digital media agency, or technology company a plus
  • Experience with U.S. state and federal privacy laws and compliance, SaaS product licensing, third-party data licensing, and product sales agreements
  • Conversational acumen across broad business functions including marketing, finance, and analytics/data science preferred
  • Experience with HIPAA/HITECH preferred
  • Experience with intellectual property matters, including licensing matters
  • Experience with global data and privacy matters a plus

jobs.title: General Liability Claims Adjuster
jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

Come join an amazing and collaborative team! We are seeking a highly organized and customer-focused General Liability Adjuster to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for speaking to customers on the phone, educating and helping the customer work through their claim to the best possible outcome. Your role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim. General Liability claims consist of Premise, Habitational, Risk Transfer, Construction, and more. You will be an expert in these areas and have experience with complex injuries. This role is 100% remote!

Who you are

  • You are motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate adjuster who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creativity is in you! You can find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the insured’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.
  • Are you curious? You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.
  • Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)
  • And did we mention, you have a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is!
  • You are collaborative and a team player.
  • You have a strong understanding of premise, Habitational, Risk Transfer, and other general liability including policy interpretation.

What you'll do

  • You will handle all aspects of General Liability claims not limited to but including Slip and Falls, Habitational, Risk Transfer, Construction, and more. Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, filing claims, and resolving customer requests.
  • Gather necessary information from customers to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and appropriate course of action.
  • Manage an inventory of claims, analyze coverage and identify any potential coverage issues.
  • Establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim.
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Communicate with involved parties and negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority.
  • Provide input for continuous development of claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements.
  • Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers, client counsel and investigative services to resolve the claim while closely with the client.
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of personal lines claims, court decisions impacting the claims function, current guidelines in claims function, and policy changes and modifications.

Qualifications

  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience ideally with;
    • General Liability (Premise, Habitational, Auto, Garagekeepers, BOP’s, Dwelling)
    • Construction Liability.
    • Employers Liability.
    • Liquor Liability/Dram Shop.
    • Complex claims involving litigation.
    • Policy interpretation. Drafting Reservation of Rights letters, coverage declinations.
    • Third-party bodily injury.
    • Third-party litigated bodily injury/property damage.
  • Active insurance adjuster's license by way of a designated home state; home state license required if home state license is available
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state required testing
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate complex data and make sound decisions based on established guidelines, policies, and procedures.
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo.
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues within and outside your department.
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs.
  • Bachelor's degree. JD, Professional insurance designations preferred.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

jobs.description:
GF Family Planning Survey Initiative — Manuscript Fellowship
Surgo Health is building the Behavioral Intelligence layer for healthcare — revealing why people behave as they do, predicting what they will do next, and helping organizations make the decisions that change outcomes.
A Public Benefit Corporation grounded in two decades of global health experience, Surgo generates foundational behavioral data that reveals the unseen why and builds the AI products that powers decision-grade insights at population scale — equipping healthcare organizations, funders, and public agencies to act on what actually shapes health outcomes: people's beliefs, motivations, and barriers.
From predicting who will enroll and remain in a clinical trial, to understanding what drives treatment decisions, to designing more effective health programs, Surgo brings the missing human layer into decisions traditionally made with clinical data alone.

Backed by 40+ peer-reviewed publications and trusted by partners including the Gates Foundation, J&J, Takeda, Pivotal Ventures, and the Clinton Health Access Initiative, Surgo is building a future where healthcare organizations don't just understand human behavior, but anticipate it — making healthcare more personal, precise, and effective for everyone.

Role Summary


We are inviting applications for a Research Fellow to join Surgo Health’s Gates Foundation (GF)-funded Family Planning initiative, a multi-country study spanning Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, and Lagos states), and Pakistan (Sindh).
This fellowship is centered on manuscript production. Fellows will collaborate closely with Surgo's research team to advance a priority research question – building on analysis and framing already underway – through to a submission-ready manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal.

What you’ll achieve:

What You’ll Achieve

  • Develop and lead a manuscript around an agreed priority research question, building on existing analyses and data and conducting additional analyses as needed
  • Produce a submission-ready, publication-quality manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal
  • Translate complex survey and causal-modeling findings into insights relevant to global health policy and program design
  • Contribute to Surgo Health’s growing portfolio of family planning research and thought leadership in low- and middle-income country (LMIC) contexts

Research Focus Areas

Priority Papers


You will lead on completing the analysis that has already been started. With this, you will write the manuscript, with guidance and support from the research leads throughout.
  1. Couples-linked segmentation in Northern Nigeria (Kano and Kaduna): How do women's and their partners' own attitudes toward family planning align or diverge, and what does this mean for programs designed to shift partner-related norms? This work links directly to an active program partnership focused on norm-shifting interventions in the region.
  2. Rethinking how we measure FP intention (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Pakistan/Sindh): Standard measures of contraceptive intention – a binary yes/no, or a 12-month time horizon – may obscure meaningful variation in fertility desire, intent strength, near-term planning, and confidence. This paper aims to describe how we have developed and tested a more multidimensional approach to measuring intent across three countries.
  3. Patterns of change in FP attitudes and behaviors over time in FP journeys (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria [Kano and Kaduna], Pakistan [Sindh]): Using panel data collected roughly a year to two after baseline, this paper aims to characterize which women's contraceptive trajectories are "sticky", and tests which baseline predictors of conversion, intent development, and discontinuation generalize across countries versus which are context-specific.

Additional Areas of Interest

If none of the priority papers above are the right fit, the following list is intended to spark ideas rather than define the boundaries. If you have an interesting idea that isn't included here, please feel free to propose it.
  • Determinants of contraceptive intention, uptake, and method choice in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, Lagos), and Pakistan (Sindh)
  • Causal inference approaches to family planning behavior (e.g., Bayesian networks, causal forests, propensity score matching, doubly robust/DoubleML methods, G-computation)
  • Segmentation-informed analysis using belief- and behavior-based segments to explain heterogeneous contraceptive outcomes
  • Comparative, cross-country analysis of family planning drivers and structural barriers
  • Subgroup and geographic vulnerability (e.g., state-level variation, rural/urban differences, adolescent and youth subpopulations)
  • Contraceptive discontinuation and continuation dynamics
  • Comparative methodology, including analysis that contextualizes findings alongside established survey instruments (e.g., DHS, PMA)

Data Available to Fellows


Fellows will work with de-identified data from Surgo's Gates Foundation-funded multi-country Family Planning study: a cross-sectional baseline survey plus a longitudinal follow-up conducted at a later point in time, across Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria, and Pakistan (Sindh).
Baseline: Women's FP Survey — Representative baseline surveys of women of reproductive age (15–49), covering fertility intentions, contraceptive use and method choice, household decision-making, perceptions and norms, health system access, and information exposure. Data was collected in 2024 to early 2025 depending on the geography. Sample sizes range from roughly 7,000 women in Senegal to around 10,000 in Côte d'Ivoire and Pakistan (Sindh), with Nigeria in between. In Nigeria, the baseline covers three states — Lagos, Kano, and Kaduna.

Baseline subset: Male Partner Interviews — In a smaller subset of baseline households, the woman's male partner also completed a companion interview, capturing his perspective on decision-making, approval, and household dynamics — enabling dyadic/couple-level analysis. Partner interviews were conducted with roughly one in ten baseline households in most countries, somewhat higher in Nigeria.

Follow-up: Longitudinal Women's Survey — A subset of baseline women who consented to re-contact were re-interviewed roughly one to two years after baseline to track changes in intentions, behavior, and access over time. This enables analysis of intention-to-behavior gaps, method continuation/discontinuation, and segment transitions. Follow-up samples range from under 2,000 women in Senegal to several thousand in Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano and Kaduna), and Pakistan (Sindh), split between women who were contraceptive users and non-users at baseline.

Fellows will receive final sample sizes, codebooks, and documentation upon onboarding.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and lead a research paper within agreed priority areas, either building on existing analyses and insights from the GF-funded multi-country family planning studies or developing a new research question using the available data, with additional analyses as needed.
  • Synthesize and translate existing findings and/or generate new analyses to deepen understanding of the mechanisms, risk factors, and protective factors shaping family planning behaviors and outcomes.
  • If applicable, utilize rigorous quantitative and/or causal inference methods appropriate to the research question
  • Draft and revise a manuscript for submission to a peer-reviewed journal, incorporating feedback from Surgo’s research team
  • Collaborate with Surgo’s research scientists for methodological guidance and framing

Expected Outputs

  • One submission-ready manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal (primary deliverable)
  • Clean, documented analysis code and supporting analytic materials if appropriate

Program Structure & Support


Selected Fellows will receive:
  • Access to de-identified, multi-country family planning survey data under a data use agreement
  • Codebooks and methodological documentation
  • Regular check-ins with Surgo’s research team for methodological guidance and feedback on drafts
  • Methodological and analytic support
  • Guidance on funder framing and positioning
  • Co-authorship and publication support
  • Opportunity to present progress to the broader research team
Fellows will retain academic independence while benefiting from Surgo’s translational and methodological support.
Fellows are additionally supported through a structured cadence of meetings throughout the fellowship. Regular check-ins are designed to keep work on track and give fellows direct access to Surgo researchers and leadership:

Weekly check-ins with Surgo project lead(s): Fellows will meet twice per week with their respective Surgo project lead(s). These sessions are intended to support analytic progress, troubleshoot methodological questions, and provide feedback on developing outputs. Fellows are invited to join the Surgo FP analytics team meetings. This gives fellows visibility into the broader team context and an opportunity to share work in progress with colleagues across the initiative.
Leadership exposure (optional): Fellows will have two scheduled opportunities to present findings to Hannah Kemp, Chief Strategy Officer, Client Engagement and Mokshada Jain, Vice President of Global Health. These sessions are built into the fellowship calendar and are a chance to share developing work with senior leadership. Fellows who want additional exposure can also request up to two optional meetings with Vincent Huang, Senior Director of Data Science & AI, to discuss their analytic approach and findings. These sessions are available but entirely at the fellow's discretion.

Timeline

  • Project Duration: maximum 17 weeks (~4 months)
  • Earliest start date: Oct 15, 2026
Expected main deliverables include:
  • (Week 1-2): Confirmed scope of work (Week 1–2): For papers requiring new analysis, this is an analytic plan. For papers building primarily on existing analysis or an established framing (e.g., the intent measurement paper), this is instead a confirmed research question, agreed division of remaining work between the Fellow and lead(s), and a manuscript outline.
  • (Week 6 or earlier): Preliminary results or draft findings (midpoint review)
  • (Week 12 or earlier): Draft initial manuscript for internal reviews delivered
  • (Week 16-17 or earlier): Final submission-ready manuscript delivered
Authorship
Fellows are credited as co-first-author or first author depending on their contribution. All publications and external communications will follow the agreed authorship and review process. Surgo Health retains the right to review and approve all outputs prior to external submission or distribution.
Stipend
Stipend amount: $6000
Payment is milestone-based. The stipend is distributed in four equal installments, with 25% ($1,500) awarded upon the successful completion of each milestone.
Milestone | Conditions for payment

For papers building primarily on existing analysis or an established framing, this is instead a confirmed research question, agreed division of remaining work between the Fellow and lead(s), and a manuscript outline.Signed data use agreement on fileSatisfactory onboarding requirements (cybersecurity training, etc)

Milestone 2 | Preliminary results or draft findings shared at midpoint review meetingSurgo team confirms satisfactory progress

About you:

About You

  • PhD candidate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career researcher in a relevant field (e.g., public health, demography, economics, biostatistics, epidemiology, data science)
  • Strong experience in quantitative analysis, survey data, and/or causal inference methods
  • Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous, publication-quality research
  • Experienced in family planning, reproductive health in LMIC contexts is strongly preferred
  • Experience in behavioral science and program implementation context is a plus
  • Comfort working with large-scale, multi-country survey datasets
Location: Remote friendly
Travel: None required

How to Apply


Path A — Join a Priority Paper. Apply to collaborate on one of the three papers listed under Priority Papers Open for Collaboration. In place of a general statement of interest, submit a short written response (up to 1,000 words) addressing all three of the following:
  1. Understanding: In your own words, what is the core analytic challenge this paper is trying to solve, and why does it matter? (2–3 sentences)
  2. Approach: How would you approach the methodological question below for your chosen paper? Walk through your reasoning, including tradeoffs you'd weigh.
  • Couples-linked segmentation in Northern Nigeria: How would you approach measuring alignment or divergence in paired partner responses on family planning attitudes? What would guide your definition of "alignment," and how would you handle the non-independence between partners' responses?
  • Rethinking how we measure FP intention: How would you validate that a multidimensional measure of contraceptive intention (fertility desire, intent strength, near-term planning, confidence) actually captures distinct dimensions, rather than one underlying construct measured multiple ways?
  • Longitudinal typologies of FP journeys: How would you define and empirically identify "sticky" versus "fluid" contraceptive trajectories from panel data, and how would you convince yourself the resulting typology reflects real behavioral patterns rather than measurement noise?
  1. Framing & Evidence Needed: Based on what's described above, what angle or framing would you propose for this manuscript? What evidence or additional analysis would need to emerge from the data to support that framing — and what would change your mind if it didn't?
Path B — Propose Your Own Idea. Apply with your own research question, grounded in the Additional Areas of Interest listed above (or a closely related idea). Include a short concept note (up to 1,000 words) outlining your proposed question, analytic approach, and how it would draw on the available data.

All applicants should submit:
  • CV or resume
  • Path A: the written response described above (up to 1,000 words), indicating which priority paper you're applying to. This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application
  • Path B: the concept note described above (up to 1,000 words). This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application
  • One prior peer-reviewed publication (strongly preferred), as first author or a major contributing author. If that is unavailable, submit a scientific writing sample. This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application
  • Contact information for two references

Benefits

What You’ll Love About Surgo

  • Fantastic, fun and collaborative colleagues; opportunity to solve tough challenges in healthcare and global health
  • Ability to be entrepreneurial, with tremendous opportunities for growth
  • Public Benefit Corporation with an impact and equity mission

Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for passion and core competencies.

We look for problem solvers and lateral thinkers.
We love it if you have done different things with your time.
If you think you are ideal for this position, write to us even if your experience doesn’t match all the requirements listed above.

Equal Opportunity and Diversity Policy

Surgo believes a diverse, inclusive staff makes a stronger team and more impactful organization, and we are committed to building and developing this team and environment. Qualified people of all races, ethnicities, cultures, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientation, gender identities and expressions, languages, social class, marital status, religions, veteran status, and disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

The Operations Manager – Medium Voltage is a newly created position and the first hire for Ameresco's Medium Voltage Operations & Maintenance Department. This role is responsible for building the department from the ground up, including hiring and developing crews, establishing operating procedures, and managing day-to-day execution across the company's national Solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) portfolio. The Operations Manager – Medium Voltage will lead the phased internalization of medium voltage preventative and corrective maintenance work currently performed by third-party contractors, with a goal of internalizing 95–100% of this scope over five years. This individual will also serve as Ameresco's internal subject matter expert for all things medium voltage, including oversight of third-party MV subcontractors performing work not yet internalized. This position reports directly to the Senior Director of Operations and holds accountability for department.

This is a Remote position, but preferably the candidate will live in the Northeast to provide adequate coverage of Ameresco's Medium Voltage projects.

Responsibilities:

Department Buildout & Strategy

  • Lead the phased hiring plan from the initial three-person crew through the full 21-person department over five years.

  • Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Method of Procedures (MOPs), Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), and quality management systems for all medium voltage work types.

  • Manage the phased transition of medium voltage work from third-party contractors to internal crews, ensuring no degradation in client service levels.

  • Develop and manage relationships with preferred third-party MV contractors retained for surge capacity and specialty work.

Subcontractor Management & Technical Oversight

  • Serve as Ameresco's internal subject matter expert for all things medium voltage, providing technical guidance to Operations, Asset Management, and field teams.

  • Manage and evaluate the performance of third-party MV subcontractors performing work not yet internalized, including scope, quality, and responsiveness.

  • Remotely review and assess subcontractor-reported issues, testing reports, and deliverables (e.g., DGA results, relay test reports, infrared scans, cable test results) to validate findings and identify discrepancies.

  • Make professional recommendations on next steps based on subcontractor findings, including repair versus replace decisions, escalation of critical issues, and prioritization of corrective action.

  • Serve as the technical point of escalation for complex or ambiguous MV issues identified by internal crews or subcontractors.

Operations Management

  • Oversee scheduling, dispatch, and execution of all medium voltage preventative maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) service requests nationwide.

  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, and site-specific safety and regulatory requirements across all crews and regions.

  • Manage crew travel logistics and regional coverage optimization as the department expands from the Eastern and Mid-Atlantic region to nationwide coverage.

  • Own all department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) (see Measures of Success).

  • Maintain accurate, timely records of all work orders, inspections, findings, and recommendations within Ameresco's CMMS platform, AssetPlanner.

Inventory Management

  • Perform initial onboarding and quarterly review of all operating MV equipment across Ameresco-owned and client-owned projects to identify critical MV spare parts required to support system operation.

  • Source, procure, and stock components which are common across the fleet

  • Update IMS

  • Safety & Compliance

  • Establish and enforce a zero-tolerance safety culture across all crews, targeting zero recordable incidents.

  • Conduct quarterly safety reviews and unannounced field PPE and lockout/tagout (LOTO) compliance audits.

  • Ensure all technicians maintain current certifications, PPE compliance, and training requirements.

Training & Development

  • Design and manage the department's training roadmap in partnership with AVO Training Institute, SEL University, and OEM training providers.

  • Oversee the structured apprenticeship program, including required on-the-job training hours for advancement.

  • Conduct annual skills matrix assessments and competency evaluations across all technician tiers.

  • Develop succession plans and mentor Lead Technicians and other high-potential team members to build a leadership pipeline within the department.

Financial Management

  • Own the department's annual operating budget.

  • Track and report third-party cost avoidance and net savings against the department's financial plan.

  • Manage fleet, tooling, and consumable budgets, including vehicle procurement and replacement planning.

  • Additional Duties

  • Participate in or oversee an on-call rotation to support 24/7 emergency corrective maintenance response, including availability on weekends and holidays as needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Director of Operations.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $111,000-$161,500 per year (presented in good faith). In addition to base pay, employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, and may be eligible for performance incentives, bonuses, commissions, or equity, depending on the role.

Actual pay will depend on factors such as internal equity, skills, experience, education, certifications, and location. This range supports our commitment to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. Compensation may vary by work location, including remote arrangements.

We disclose salary ranges and benefits in all required external and internal postings and will provide further details upon request at any stage of the hiring process. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

This Specialist team reports into a Sales Director and consists of Specialist sellers aligned by segment and product. Specialist AEs are charged with accelerating the growth of new products and are incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to the segment and geography they support.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to solve a real, expensive problem: Cargo theft and shipment blind spots cost U.S. businesses an estimated $35B a year. You want your pipeline to translate directly into safer, more visible supply chains for the customers you work with.
  • You've sold in complex Enterprise environments before: You're comfortable running a full-cycle sales motion with a VP of Supply Chain, Operations, or Loss Prevention, and you know how to build a business case that holds up through Procurement, Legal, and InfoSec review.
  • You're energized by “Version 1.0”: The Tracking Label is a newly launched product category for Samsara. You want to be someone who helps write the enterprise playbook, not just run one that already exists.
  • You think in systems, not SKUs: You can connect a single tracking label to a customer's shipment network and loss-prevention strategy — and you know how to turn a single pilot into a repeatable, expanding deployment.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers run the physical economy — logistics, manufacturing, retail distribution. They've earned trust the hard way, and they expect partners who understand their operational reality, not just their tech stack.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by top performers and pushed to go further than you have before.
  • You are a team player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader Enterprise Core account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Run full-cycle Tracking Label sales motions — from single-lane pilot to multi-site rollout — across a broad portfolio of Samsara's US Enterprise Private accounts
  • Partner with Enterprise Core Account Executives and Account Development Representatives to identify and prioritize accounts with high-value or high-theft-risk cargo
  • Build the business case — ROI, loss-prevention impact, supply chain visibility gains — that earns buy-in from Supply Chain, Operations, Security, and other key stakeholders
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder procurement processes (Legal, Security/InfoSec, Procurement) to close deals across a high volume of accounts
  • Drive pilot strategy and success metrics that convert early adoption into repeatable, expanding deployments
  • Partner with Product and GTM leadership to feed field insight back into the roadmap
  • Build and refine the frameworks, playbooks, and enablement assets that scale Tracking Label success across the Enterprise Core specialist team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of complex, full-cycle Enterprise or SaaS sales experience
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement, including $250K+ ARR transactions
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate multi-stakeholder deals involving Legal, Procurement, and InfoSec
  • Comfort selling a newly launched product or category where the playbook is still being written
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence director- and VP-level stakeholders
  • Ability to travel to customer sites as needed

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience selling supply chain visibility, asset/freight tracking, IoT, telematics, or cargo security solutions
  • Experience operating in a specialist/overlay model, co-selling alongside Enterprise AEs
  • Domain knowledge of logistics, 3PL, freight, manufacturing, or retail distribution operations
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC and/or Command of the Message sales frameworks
  • A track record of ramping quickly on new products and turning early wins into a repeatable motion

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

jobs.description:
Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.

Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Own

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
  • Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
  • Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs

SQL & Data Management

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
  • Extract and combine data from multiple sources
  • Work with relational databases and structured datasets
  • Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar BI platforms
  • Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
  • Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards

Data Pipelines & Integrations

  • Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
  • Help connect business systems and reporting environments
  • Support reliable movement of data between platforms
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
  • Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows

Reporting Automation

  • Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
  • Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
  • Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Monitor and improve data accuracy
  • Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
  • Validate reporting outputs against source data
  • Improve processes that support reliable reporting
  • Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
  • Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
  • Strong hands-on SQL skills
  • Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar tools
  • Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Professional working English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems
  • Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
  • Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
  • Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
  • Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting

Tools & Technologies

SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
  • Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
  • Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
  • Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
  • Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
  • Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.

Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.

In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and reliability of reporting
  • Quality and usability of dashboards
  • Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
  • SQL query and reporting efficiency
  • Reduction in manual reporting processes
  • Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
  • Improvement in overall data quality
  • Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Data / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.

NationsBenefits is recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in America and a Healthcare Fintech provider of supplemental benefits, flex cards, and member engagement solutions. We partner with managed care organizations to provide innovative healthcare solutions that drive growth, improve outcomes, reduce costs, and bring value to their members.

Our goal is to transform the healthcare industry for the better! We provide career advancement opportunities from within the organization across multiple locations in the US, South America, and India.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to drive operational execution, delivery discipline, and organizational effectiveness across our Data & Analytics organization.

This role will establish and manage the operating framework that enables our analytics, data engineering, and platform teams to execute consistently against business priorities. The ideal candidate combines strong program management capabilities with exceptional organizational judgment, communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to bring structure, accountability, and clarity to complex, fast-moving environments.

Working directly with the Vice President of Data & Analytics, this individual will own program coordination, delivery governance, operational reporting, tactical communications, and organizational processes. The role is both strategic and highly hands-on, translating leadership priorities into coordinated execution while ensuring commitments, risks, dependencies, and decisions remain visible and actively managed.

Key Responsibilities:

Program & Portfolio Management

  • Establish and maintain an integrated portfolio of Data & Analytics initiatives, projects, milestones, and organizational commitments.
  • Coordinate delivery across analytics, data engineering, platform engineering, product, and other business functions.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, resource considerations, and delivery milestones.
  • Identify delivery risks, competing priorities, and organizational bottlenecks; drive resolution or timely escalation.
  • Ensure organizational priorities translate into actionable work with clear ownership, expectations, and measurable outcomes.

Execution Management & Operational Discipline

  • Establish and manage the organization's operating cadence, including project reviews, action tracking, progress reporting, and follow-through.
  • Proactively monitor commitments, identify execution gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with accountable leaders.
  • Maintain clear visibility into project health, deliverables, blockers, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

Program Communications, Reporting & Leadership Support

Demand Management & Delivery Coordination

Organizational Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and continuously improve operating processes, tools, standards, and management routines across Data & Analytics.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce administrative overhead, eliminate redundant processes, and improve organizational efficiency.
  • Establish meaningful operational metrics to measure delivery performance, predictability, and execution effectiveness.
  • Partner with functional leaders to strengthen cross-team coordination, accountability, and organizational readiness.
  • Support organizational planning, quarterly priorities, strategic initiatives, and operational transformation efforts.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, technical project management, business operations, or related roles, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success establishing and managing program operations in fast-moving, technically complex organizations.
  • Experience working with data, analytics, software engineering, technology platforms, or related technical functions.
  • Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to independently manage competing priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including operational reporting, executive presentation development, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes, challenge assumptions, and drive accountability without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong working knowledge of project and portfolio management tools, methodologies, and operational performance measures.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous leadership objectives into structured plans, deliverables, and execution routines.
  • Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to synthesize complex operational information into actionable insights, recommendations, and leadership decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Japan)

Job Location: Virtual Japan

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide


As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in protecting patient safety, ensuring high-quality clinical data, and supporting successful study delivery across Japan. You’ll take ownership of site qualification, initiation, monitoring, management, and close-out activities, ensuring studies are conducted in line with GCP, applicable regulations, and study requirements.

You’ll bring your monitoring expertise to complex studies while partnering closely with investigative sites, Project Management, and global study teams. Depending on the study, you may also serve as a Lead CRA, coordinate and mentor other CRAs, contribute to monitoring plans and study tools, and help teams achieve key study milestones.

This is an opportunity to combine independent site management with broader study-level impact, using your experience to strengthen site performance, data quality, compliance, and patient safety throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.


Where You'll Work


This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across Japan. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in Japan.


What You'll Do


  • Lead site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, management, and close-out visits in accordance with study requirements, GCP, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
  • Oversee site performance through source document verification, CRF and EDC review, data query resolution, protocol adherence, informed consent review, and ongoing assessment of patient safety.
  • Partner with investigative sites to maintain essential documentation, regulatory and ethics submissions, Investigator Site Files, Trial Master File documentation, and investigational product accountability.
  • Serve as a Lead CRA on global studies when assigned, coordinating CRAs, reviewing site visit reports, and working with Project Management to support study deliverables and milestones.
  • Mentor less experienced CRAs and site staff through training, guidance, accompanied visits, and practical support.
  • Develop clinical monitoring plans, study-specific tools, templates, and training materials as requested to support effective study delivery.
  • Collaborate with study teams and investigators, contributing to team meetings, investigator meetings, bid defenses, and the development of protocols and CRFs.
  • Maintain effective communication with sites, documenting monitoring findings and supporting timely, accurate data and safety-event reporting.

What You'll Bring


  • Education and CRA experience: an MD or pharmacy-related advanced degree with at least 3 years of CRA experience; a four-year degree in a medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or related science with at least 5 years of CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training, preferably in nursing or life sciences, with at least 7 years of CRA experience.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.
  • Strong understanding of clinical research principles, GCP, ICH Guidelines, applicable FDA and/or EU regulations and directives, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Experience across two to three therapeutic areas, with the depth of knowledge required to function as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, planning, organizational, time-management, initiative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead and motivate others where applicable.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and EDC systems.
  • At least intermediate proficiency in spoken and written English, plus proficiency in the local language.

Introduction

Are you passionate about leveraging data to solve complex, real-world problems?
Our client is looking for a skilled Data Scientist to lead the development of advanced machine learning models and geospatial analytics that power smarter transport and logistics solutions.

If you have experience with spatial data, radar analytics, and predictive modeling and thrive in an innovative startup environment where autonomy, creativity, and technical depth are valued this role is your opportunity to make a tangible impact.

You'll join a collaborative team bridging the UK and South Africa, turning rich sensor and geospatial datasets into intelligence that drives meaningful operational improvements for top-tier clients and major government agencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop machine learning models to analyze geospatial and radar data for transport and logistics applications.

  • Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that optimize vehicle and people movement across public and private sectors.

  • Collaborate with UK-based leadership and South African technical teams to design and implement innovative data-driven solutions.

  • Continuously improve data collection, processing, and predictive modeling methods to enhance performance and accuracy.

  • Manage the full data science lifecycle from problem definition and model development to deployment and performance monitoring.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, iterating quickly and refining solutions based on client feedback.

  • Contribute to building and scaling the data science function, with potential to lead and mentor future team members.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelors, Honours, Masters, or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • 3 - 5 years of professional experience in data science, including end-to-end project delivery.

  • Proven expertise in machine learning (e.g., linear regression, XGBoost) and predictive modeling.

  • Proficient in Python and SQL, with experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with geospatial data, GIS, or radar analytics is highly advantageous.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with technical depth and minimal client-facing focus.

  • Comfortable working in an agile startup setting with fast iteration cycles and evolving priorities.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to translate complex technical insights effectively.

Core Skills & Experience

  • Machine learning & data science: Building and validating classification/regression models; applying precision/recall, confusion matrices, and error analysis to drive improvements.

  • Python expertise: Strong experience with ML, data processing, and visualisation libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, matplotlib, plotly, etc.).

  • Sensor data handling: Comfortable working with spatial time-series data (radar point clouds, GPS, UWB, accelerometer, etc.).

  • Visualisation & dashboards: Translating outputs into actionable insights via plots, overlays, and interactive dashboards.
    Cloud data engineering: Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for data ingestion, storage, and analytics (e.g., IoT Hub, S3, Pub/Sub, CosmosDB/BigQuery).

  • Collaboration & documentation: Effective cross-disciplinary communication; producing reproducible code, pipelines, and well-documented results.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Radar data: Exposure to radar sensors and features (RCS, Doppler, track stability) a strong advantage.

  • Data fusion: Combining multiple sensor data streams (radar, video, GPS, UWB) into coherent datasets.

  • Contextual data integration: Enriching sensor data with external sources such as weather, points of interest, events, and demographic data.

  • Geospatial data: Experience with maps, coordinate systems, overlays, and spatial/temporal data joins.

  • Cloud-native pipelines: Deploying ML/data pipelines using serverless functions, containers, and workflow tools (e.g., Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, GCP Dataflow).

  • Scalable storage & analytics: Handling large datasets using distributed processing and query engines (e.g., SQL, Spark, Databricks).

Ready to Make an Impact?

If youre ready to transform geospatial and radar data into meaningful insights that drive smarter, more efficient transport and logistics solutions, our client wants to hear from you.

Join an ambitious, globally connected team where your machine learning expertise will directly shape real-world outcomes and accelerate innovation in the data science space.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.excerpt: Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO) About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.
