Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a QA Tester / Test Engineer who will support Department of War (DoW) customers applications modernization and cloud migration program by performing comprehensive testing across Agile development cycles, DevSecOps pipelines, incremental deployments, and security compliance processes. This role ensures all software modules, database changes, integrations, and releases meet functional, security, performance, and compliance standards required by the customer and the DoW.

This position is 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

User Story & Sprint-Level Testing

  • Develop and execute unit tests, regression tests, security tests, and acceptance tests for all user stories.
  • Managing RITM (Requirements Traceability Matrix) and writing required manual/automated test cases
  • Maintain documented testing tasks for each closed and deployed user story.
  • Validate user story functionality aligns with functional and technical requirements (including Zero Trust, RMF, audit logging).

Automated Testing & DevSecOps Pipeline Support

  • Build, run, and maintain automated tests within GitLab pipelines using customer approved tools including Selenium, JUnit, utPLSQL, Fortify SCA, Fortify WebInspect, LoadRunner.
  • Ensure automated testing gates (SAST/DAST/QA checks) are enforced prior to code promotion.

Integration & Incremental Deployment Testing

  • Support integration testing to ensure new modules work seamlessly with legacy DRAS components during Strangler Pattern migration.
  • Validate data flows, orchestration behavior, and module interactions during incremental deployments.

Release Testing

  • Perform release-level testing for combined deployments staged for production.
  • Ensure release testing follows the established Release Test Strategy and IMS timelines.

Security & Compliance Testing

  • Perform security testing, static/dynamic scans, Zero Trust validation, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Support Security Control Assessments (SCA/ED‑SCA), FISMA/FedRAMP testing requirements, and Zero Trust validation.

Database & Data Migration Testing

  • Validate data mapping accuracy between legacy DRAS systems and the consolidated DRAS‑M database. [
  • Test ETL data migration processes for correctness, completeness, and timing as tables and schemas evolve.

Performance Testing

  • Execute performance and load tests using LoadRunner and ensure system scalability.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Produce test plans, cases, scripts, logs, defect reports, and test metrics (e.g., defect density, escaped defects, velocity).
  • Provide testing evidence for ATO packages (SSP, BIA, SCA results, etc.)

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 years experience with a BS/BA degree or 3 years with a MS/MA degree.
  • US Citizenship.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Selenium, JUnit, and utPLSQL.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Knowledge of secure coding and security testing tools (Fortify, ACAS, WebInspect).
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (LoadRunner).
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, data migrations, and database-driven applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong background in Agile testing practices.
  • Working understanding of DevSecOps pipelines and automation.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity frameworks including RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800‑53, FISMA, FedRAMP.
  • Experience supporting testing for federal systems subject to RMF/ATO.
  • Knowledge of mainframe-to-cloud migration, refactoring validation, or Strangler Pattern transition testing.
  • Experience working on financial or entitlement systems within DoD or federal agencies.

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

Overview

BerryDunn is seeking an OCM Senior Consultant to join our Medicaid Practice Group that will have an initial focus supporting our client in Puerto Rico as a Medicaid Enterprise System (MES) Organizational Change Management (OCM) Subject Matter Expert (SME). As part of our consulting team focused on State Medicaid Agency (SMA) clients, you will leverage your OCM expertise, along with project management and Medicaid knowledge to help Medicaid agencies improve the health and lives of individuals. You will also be the success partner for Medicaid agencies in building healthier communities and stronger futures.

BerryDunn is seeking an individual with experience in OCM, preferably in state government, health IT, and the Health and Human Services (HHS) industry. This individual will support, and at times lead, the identification, development, and implementation of OCM activities in support of the Medicaid Enterprise and it’s supporting people and processes. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated State HHS IT OCM, project management and Prosci® background with experience in Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) modules implementations.

This position can be remotely-based or in one of our offices in Portland, Maine, Charleston, West Virginia, San Juan, Puerto Rico, or Phoenix, Arizona. You will report to senior leaders in the MPG and will help clients nationally with your initial focus being on our client in Puerto Rico.

Travel Expectations: Approximately 25% of travel to client sites is anticipated in the future to support projects.

You Will

Provide OCM services to SMA clients as they transform their organization to align with MES strategy. As a trusted advisor, you will provide leadership and guidance for clients and internal project teams in the following areas:

  • Support the project lead in managing the work of the BerryDunn project team related to OCM activities

  • Build strong relationships with project stakeholders, including client contacts, project team members, vendor contacts, etc

  • Help mentor and develop project team members

You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree (a bachelor’s degree can be replaced with an additional four (4) years related experience)

  • Three (3) years of demonstrated experience in an OCM lead or SME role supporting a SMA or a large healthcare provider management organization of a similar size

  • Proficiency in all Microsoft (MS) applications

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $115,000 - $135,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Leadership & Team Development

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The work draws on what you already know: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks right.

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, GNC, orbital mechanics, systems engineering — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major aerospace organization, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one aerospace subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this role, you will take technical ownership of electrical engineering and power system projects from initial scoping through final design and issued-for-construction (IFC) deliverables. You will independently execute medium- and low-voltage power system design, protection and control (P&C) engineering, and power system studies while ensuring that work meets Qualus standards, applicable codes, client requirements, project budgets, and schedules.

Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate field conditions and client needs into practical, constructible engineering solutions. You will work directly with project managers, designers, engineers, field personnel, and clients while also supporting business development through site walks, scope development, and technical proposal input.

Responsibilities

  • Perform power system studies, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, arc-flash, load-flow, grounding, and related analyses.
  • Lead and independently execute medium- and low-voltage electrical design for brownfield and greenfield projects, including outdoor substations, unit substations, power transformers, protection and control systems, power monitoring systems, and breaker and relay replacements.
  • Develop technical specifications for medium- and low-voltage electrical equipment.
  • Direct and coordinate with CAD/design staff in the development and revision of electrical drawings, including one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, schematics, and related design documentation.
  • Review and interpret field data to support engineering analysis, design development, and project execution.
  • Develop and review protective relay setpoints, settings, and associated documentation.
  • Analyze power monitoring data and develop technically sound recommendations for clients.
  • Perform engineering reviews to ensure deliverables are accurate, coordinated, constructible, and compliant with applicable codes, standards, specifications, and client requirements.
  • Serve as a technical representative of Qualus, often alongside sales and business development, during customer meetings, site walks, project kickoffs, and other client-facing activities.
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, designers, field personnel, and other Qualus teams to establish project requirements and execute work efficiently.
  • Assess project-specific engineering resource needs and communicate staffing, schedule, scope, or technical concerns to the project manager.
  • Participate in project kickoff and coordination meetings to align the project team on scope, specifications, budget, schedule, deliverables, and safety requirements.
  • Identify changes in scope or project conditions and provide timely technical input needed to support change management.
  • Coordinate with equipment manufacturers and suppliers to identify materials and equipment that meet project technical requirements.
  • Maintain required safety and technical training and comply with Qualus, client, and industry safety requirements.
  • Complete required project documentation, including timekeeping, change documentation, technical reports, and other deliverable-related records, accurately and on time.
  • Travel to customer facilities and project sites as required, up to approximately 30%.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • 5+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience involving primary power distribution, protection and control, electrical equipment, and/or industrial power systems.
  • Demonstrated experience developing protective relay setpoints and settings files.
  • Working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards, including NEC/NFPA 70, ANSI C57, ANSI C37, and NESC.
  • Experience applying electrical engineering codes and standards to substation and industrial power distribution designs.
  • 2+ years of AutoCAD experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with power system modeling and analysis software such as ETAP, SKM PowerTools, and/or EasyPower.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate technical findings and recommendations to clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage engineering assignments while maintaining accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Vlogger (Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging expert Vloggers to contribute to a cutting-edge customer project focused on capturing high-quality, naturalistic video data using 360° and action cameras. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will record themselves performing everyday activities across indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments using compatible equipment, providing crucial video resources for advanced AI research.

Scope of Work

  1. Capture a diverse set of continuous video clips (minimum 60 seconds each) of everyday activities in a range of environments, including indoor, outdoor, and in-vehicle settings.
  2. Consistently utilize compatible 360° or wide-angle cameras (e.g., Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX series) with at least 170° FOV and 720p resolution, ensuring stable, third-person perspective according to project standards.
  3. Implement appropriate mounting solutions, such as backpack or vehicle mounts, to maintain a clear third-person view where your entire body and surroundings are visible throughout each activity.
  4. Follow provided guidelines and instructions for camera placement, activity selection, and safety to ensure data consistency and collection integrity.
  5. Document, organize, and submit video files in accordance with project specifications, ensuring all deliverables meet technical and quality requirements.
  6. Communicate proactively and clearly in both written and verbal form regarding progress, questions, and any technical challenges.
  7. Adapt to occasional updates in collection tasks, environments, or technical requirements as defined by project needs.

Compatible camera examples include:

  1. Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6
  2. DJI Osmo 360
  3. GoPro MAX, MAX2
  4. Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

  1. Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.
  2. Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.

Third-Person Camera Setup

  1. Mounted above and behind you
  2. Angled slightly downward
  3. Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
  4. Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment. Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Expected Recording Tasks may include:

  1. Natural everyday activities
  2. Indoor and outdoor activities
  3. Walking and moving through different environments
  4. Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
  5. Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.

Recording Requirements

  1. Capture a variety of activities and environments
  2. Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long
  3. Record at a minimum resolution of 720p
  4. Follow the required camera position for each assigned task
  5. Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible
  6. Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

  • Define the reference architecture for agentic AI on the case management platform, including agent patterns, tool and API integration, agent identity and access, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and where guardrails and controls sit

Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for senior React Native engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers

  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from [75+] countries

Who we’re looking for

Requirements for React Native & React Developer’s position:

  • 5+ years of software development experience

  • 3+ years of experience with React and 5+ years of experience with React Native
    OR
    5+ years of experience with React and 3+ years of experience with React Native

Requirements for React Native & Node Developer’s position:

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • 2+ years of experience with Node and 4+ years of experience with React Native
    OR
    4+ years of experience with Node and 2+ years of experience with React Native

Requirements for React Native & Node & React Developer’s position:

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • 3+ years of experience with Node

  • 4+ years of experience with React Native and 2+ years of experience with React
    OR
    2+ years of experience with React Native and 3+ years of experience with React

Requirements for React Native & Ruby Developer’s position:

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • 2+ years of experience with React and 4+ years of experience with Ruby
    OR
    4+ years of experience with React and 2+ years of experience with Ruby

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production

  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)

  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls

  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision

  • You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile

  2. Verify your role

  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the Lemon.io community.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & An gular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

jobs.description:
LVH is the premier home chartering service for the world’s elite, bringing together a collective of trusted homeowners and guests who share a passion for refinement, elegance, and elevated human experiences. LVH offers the finest curated experiences, unparalleled in-home full services, exclusive home management, and advisory services combined with the latest technology trends.

Under general supervision, the Client Relations Coordinator will provide direct support and liaison to the Client Relations Management to perform related work as required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Manage all initial communication with clients across multiple channels (email, calls, chat, etc.)
  • Build and maintain comprehensive client profiles within the CRM system
  • Qualify inbound leads through initial assessment of client background, preferences, and requirements
  • Assign high-value and suitable leads to Client Relations Directors
  • Support the team throughout all stages of the deal-closing process
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and proper tracking of data within the CRM system
  • Monitor and trace lead sources to support marketing insights and future initiatives
  • Prepare documents and conduct research as needed to support client requirements
  • Prepare PAC (Pricing and Availability Check) templates based on client requirements
  • Reach out to property owners and managers to confirm availability, pricing, and terms
  • Assist in creating proposals based on provided instructions
  • Submit proposals for review and approval by the Team Lead and/or Director
  • Perform other related tasks as assigned by the Client Relations Director – Operations

SKILL AND KNOWLEDGE QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of focus experience with hotel, travel, concierge & executive support
  • Experience with luxury or high-net-worth clients is preferred but not required
  • Bachelor's degree is a minimum educational requirement
  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills
  • Strong experience with CRM, Google Suite, and other organizational tools
  • Multi-tasking capabilities and working effectively under deadlines
  • Knowledge of customer service principles and best practices
  • Focuses and works together with team members in accomplishing work objectives.
  • Actively appreciates the diverse capabilities, insights, and ideas of others and working effectively
  • Sets high standards of performance for self-assuming responsibility and accountability

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive gross monthly salary
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Minimum of 20 days of paid annual leave
  • Paid public holidays in accordance with the Serbian holiday calendar
  • Paid sick leave in accordance with applicable Serbian labor laws
  • Work equipment stipend
  • Private health insurance
  • Flexible work schedule, subject to business needs and management approval

jobs.title: Chief Client Officer (CCO)
jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewThe Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments. The role focuses on driving long-term client value, satisfaction, retention, and growth by ensuring exceptional service delivery and deep, trusted client relationships. The CCO acts as the executive voice of the client within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive client strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and strategic accounts.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for high-value client issues and engagements.

Client Growth & Retention

  • Drive client retention, loyalty, and expansion across portfolios.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client base.
  • Develop strategies to increase client lifetime value (CLV).

Client Experience & Success

  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality client experience across all touchpoints.
  • Oversee client onboarding, engagement, and success management processes.
  • Implement frameworks to measure and improve client satisfaction (NPS, CSAT).

Account Management & Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee key account management teams and client delivery functions.
  • Ensure client expectations are met through effective service delivery.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, operations, product, marketing, and support teams.
  • Ensure client feedback is integrated into product development and service improvements.
  • Align internal teams around client needs and priorities.

Client Insights & Analytics

  • Analyze client behavior, feedback, and performance data.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve client engagement and satisfaction.
  • Provide actionable insights to executive leadership.

Business Development Support

  • Support sales teams in acquiring high-value clients and strategic accounts.
  • Participate in client pitches, presentations, and negotiations.
  • Strengthen executive-level client relationships during pre- and post-sales cycles.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs for client success, retention, and growth.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to CEO and executive leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor client success, account management, and service teams.
  • Build a client-centric culture across the organization.
  • Drive continuous training and professional development initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in client management, account management, customer success, or senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of managing enterprise or high-value client relationships.
  • Strong experience in service delivery, relationship management, or client success leadership.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking.
  • Customer-centric leadership mindset.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills.
  • Executive presence and stakeholder management.

Performance Metrics

  • Client retention and churn rate.
  • Client satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Revenue growth from existing clients.
  • Success of key account management initiatives.
  • SLA adherence and service quality performance.

If you want, I can also create:

  • LinkedIn Boolean search for Chief Client Officers
  • Yes/No prerequisite screening questions
  • MCQ knockout questions
  • Short LinkedIn job post version
  • Industry-specific versions (banking, SaaS, consulting, fintech)

Chief Strategy Officer

Here's a refined Job Description (JD) for a Chief Strategy Officer (CSO):

Chief Strategy Officer (CSO)

Location: [City, Country]
Reports To: CEO / Chief Executive Officer / Board of Directors

Position Overview

The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The role focuses on identifying growth opportunities, driving transformation initiatives, improving competitive positioning, and ensuring alignment of all business units with corporate objectives. The CSO acts as a key advisor to the CEO and leadership team on strategic direction and enterprise-wide priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Strategy Development

  • Develop and execute the organization's short-, medium-, and long-term strategic plans.
  • Define strategic priorities aligned with business growth and market positioning.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on market trends, competition, and internal performance.

Growth & Expansion Strategy

  • Identify new markets, business opportunities, and revenue streams.
  • Lead initiatives for geographic expansion, diversification, and innovation.
  • Support scalable and sustainable business growth strategies.

Business Transformation & Execution

  • Drive enterprise-wide transformation initiatives (digital, operational, organizational).
  • Translate strategic plans into actionable business roadmaps.
  • Ensure execution alignment across all departments and business units.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and macroeconomic factors.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve competitive advantage.
  • Identify risks and opportunities impacting business performance.

Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

  • Lead or support M&A strategy, due diligence, and integration planning.
  • Evaluate strategic partnerships, alliances, and joint ventures.
  • Assess investment opportunities aligned with long-term strategy.

Performance Monitoring & KPIs

  • Define key strategic KPIs and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Monitor execution of strategic initiatives across the organization.
  • Provide regular updates and insights to CEO and Board.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with finance, operations, HR, marketing, product, and technology teams.
  • Ensure alignment of departmental strategies with enterprise goals.
  • Drive organization-wide coordination of strategic initiatives.

Innovation & Future Planning

  • Identify emerging trends, technologies, and business models.
  • Drive innovation initiatives and future-focused strategic planning.
  • Support digital transformation and modernization efforts.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Engage with investors, partners, and external stakeholders on strategic matters.
  • Act as a key advisor to the CEO on critical business decisions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, corporate development, or executive leadership roles.
  • Proven track record in leading strategic initiatives and business transformation.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and organizational strategy.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent analytical and business acumen.
  • Leadership and executive influence skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation capabilities.
  • Ability to drive change and manage complex transformations.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of strategic growth objectives.
  • Success of transformation and execution initiatives.
  • Market share and competitive positioning improvement.
  • M&A and partnership value creation.
  • Alignment and execution efficiency across business units.

jobs.companyName: Vivantify Technology Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.
jobs.description:
Location: Pan India

Experience: 7–11 Years
Openings: 1
Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Specialist - Package Implementation with significant experience in insurance technology platforms, particularly Insurity Bridge. The role will lead the design, development, implementation, and support of Insurity Bridge solutions for insurance clients while providing technical leadership and ensuring successful project delivery.

Job Description

The position involves leading end-to-end implementation and enhancement of Insurity Bridge applications, from requirements gathering and solution design through development, integration, deployment, and production support. The specialist will work closely with business analysts, product owners, developers, QA teams, and client stakeholders.

The role requires strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, and delivery oversight. The candidate will guide distributed development teams, ensure development standards are followed, manage delivery risks and dependencies, and support releases, defect resolution, and performance improvements.

The role also contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, including the adoption of automation and AI-assisted delivery practices where applicable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement of Insurity Bridge applications.
  • Collaborate with business and client stakeholders to gather and refine requirements.
  • Design scalable and maintainable technical solutions within the Insurity platform.
  • Guide development teams on configuration, customization, integration, and deployment activities.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Manage project risks, dependencies, stakeholder communication, and delivery activities.
  • Coordinate with QA teams for comprehensive testing and defect closure.
  • Mentor developers and provide technical leadership across distributed project teams.

Required Skills

  • Insurity Bridge platform experience.
  • Insurance domain knowledge, particularly Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance processes.
  • Knowledge of C#/.NET, SQL Server, Web Services/APIs, and application integrations.
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
  • Strong stakeholder management and professional communication skills.
  • Experience leading distributed teams and managing client interactions.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Experience leading large-scale insurance transformation programs.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with automation and AI-assisted delivery practices.

Mandatory Skills

  • Insurity Bridge

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have 9 years of IT experience with significant exposure to insurance technology platforms and strong hands-on experience with Insurity Bridge. The candidate should demonstrate technical leadership, insurance domain knowledge, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to lead distributed teams through successful project delivery.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients

The CCO acts as the executive voice of the client within the organization.

Client Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and strategic accounts.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for high-value client issues and engagements.

Client Growth & Retention

  • Drive client retention, loyalty, and expansion across portfolios.

  • Develop strategies to increase client lifetime value (CLV).

Client Experience & Success

Account Management & Delivery Oversight

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Client Insights & Analytics

Business Development Support

Governance & Reporting

Leadership & Team Development

jobs.excerpt: Overview The Enterprise Solution Architect (ESA) is the senior technical leader responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise architecture for a large-scale healthcare supply chain and logistics portfolio.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Enterprise Solution Architect (ESA) is the senior technical leader responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise architecture for a large-scale healthcare supply chain and logistics portfolio.

The ESA leads the sustainment and modernization of legacy business applications, inventory systems, procurement systems, financial management integrations, enterprise data capabilities, and shared digital services. This role establishes the architecture for a centralized integration platform that enables secure, scalable, governed, and near-real-time information exchange across supply chain, logistics, clinical, financial, asset-management, and external partner systems.

The ESA serves as the core technical leader responsible for planning, designing, and governing next-generation autonomous, goal-driven AI systems that support supply-chain modernization, operational decision-making, workflow optimization, enterprise data exchange, and intelligent automation.

This position balances continuity of mission-critical operations with deliberate, phased modernization. The ESA ensures that architecture decisions improve interoperability, data quality, cybersecurity, resiliency, maintainability, delivery velocity, and readiness for future digital capabilities.

This is a critical technical leadership role responsible for enabling a secure, integrated, resilient, and modern healthcare supply-chain ecosystem. The Enterprise Solution Architect protects current operational capabilities while establishing the architecture, governance, integration foundation, data discipline, modernization pathway, and intelligent automation capabilities required for future enterprise transformation.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture Leadership:

  • Establish, maintain, and govern the target-state enterprise architecture for the healthcare supply chain and logistics portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain current-state, future-state, and transition architecture models spanning business, application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, cloud, and operational-support domains.
  • Define enterprise architecture principles, standards, technical guardrails, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and Architecture Decision Records.
  • Lead architecture governance forums, solution-design reviews, technical intake processes, architecture review boards, and executive-level architecture briefings.
  • Ensure architectural decisions align with organizational strategy, technology roadmaps, cybersecurity requirements, business priorities, delivery plans, and operational outcomes.
  • Maintain the enterprise architectural runway, ensuring that near-term product and platform investments advance longer-term modernization objectives.
  • Translate strategic priorities into architecture roadmaps, technical enablers, epics, features, stories, non-functional requirements, and measurable implementation outcomes.
  • Develop architecture artifacts using formal frameworks and methods, including DoDAF, UAF, TOGAF, and comparable enterprise architecture approaches.

Centralized Integration Platform and Near-Real-Time Data Exchange

  • Architect a secure, scalable, governed centralized integration platform supporting near-real-time, API, event-driven, messaging, batch, and legacy exchanges.
  • Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data contracts, interface standards, observability, security, and service-level objectives.
  • Enable reliable interoperability among supply chain, inventory, procurement, logistics, financial, clinical, asset-management, and external systems while reducing point-to-point integrations.

Legacy Application Sustainment, Modernization, and Intelligent Automation

  • Lead phased modernization of legacy applications, interfaces, data pipelines, and infrastructure while maintaining continuity of mission-critical operations.
  • Define modernization strategies including API enablement, refactoring, re-platforming, cloud migration, service decomposition, consolidation, replacement, and retirement.
  • Architect and govern AI-enabled capabilities, including agentic workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and human-in-the-loop decision support, with appropriate security, governance, traceability, and human oversight.

Enterprise Data Architecture and Governance

  • Define enterprise data and master-data architecture supporting authoritative, trusted, interoperable, and reusable supply-chain information.
  • Establish data governance, ownership, quality, metadata, lineage, lifecycle, access, authoritative-source, and master-data standards.
  • Enable consistent and secure information sharing across enterprise and external data sources.

Cloud, DevSecOps, Security and Resilliency

  • Define secure hybrid and cloud-native architecture patterns supporting scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, observability, and cost optimization.
  • Establish automated DevSecOps practices for CI/CD, testing, security scanning, infrastructure automation, configuration management, monitoring, and continuous compliance.
  • Apply Zero Trust, identity and access management, encryption, secrets/certificate management, API security, vulnerability management, and applicable cybersecurity and privacy requirements

Agile Delivery and Cross-Product Coordination

  • Partner with product, engineering, security, data, operations, and business teams to translate architecture into prioritized epics, enablers, features, non-functional requirements, and release plans.
  • Manage cross-product dependencies and balance feature delivery with modernization, cybersecurity, technical-debt reduction, resiliency, and operational sustainment.
  • Define architecture performance measures covering interoperability, data quality, reliability, delivery, technical debt, and modernization progress

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, application architecture, integration architecture, data architecture, cloud architecture, or comparable technical leadership roles.

Domain Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale healthcare, supply-chain, logistics, procurement, inventory, financial management, clinical, or other mission-critical operational environments.

Architecture Expertise:

  • Experience developing enterprise and solution architectures, reference architectures, current- and future-state models, transition architectures, technical roadmaps, architecture decision records, integration blueprints, and modernization strategies. Ability to apply formal architecture frameworks and modeling approaches, including DoDAF, UAF, TOGAF, and/or equivalent methods.

Integration Expertise:

  • Demonstrated expertise designing API-led, event-driven, message-based, and batch integrations. Must be able to define reusable enterprise integration patterns; API and data contracts; canonical models; service orchestration; interface-versioning strategies; error handling; auditability; and operational monitoring. Experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, Enterprise Service Bus and Enterprise Application Integration patterns, ETL/ELT, publish-subscribe, XML, EDI, HL7, and FHIR is required.

Data Architecture:

  • Experience with enterprise data modeling, master data management, data governance, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, authoritative-source management, data lakes, lakehouses, data migration, and modern data-engineering practices. Experience defining enterprise master-data models for items, vendors, contracts, classification references, and related supply-chain domains is strongly preferred.

Technical Platforms and Technologies

  • Demonstrated architecture-level experience with containerized, cloud-native platforms, including Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift; cloud platforms and services in AWS and Azure; and hybrid IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments. Experience with Red Hat technologies, InterSystems integration technologies, Databricks, API-management and integration platforms, enterprise messaging, and data-platform services is required or strongly preferred.

Application and Legacy Technology Expertise:

  • Experience modernizing and sustaining legacy enterprise applications, including applications with complex custom-code, database, file-based, or mainframe-era dependencies. Familiarity with Java, Spring Boot, .NET, Python, React, Angular, Node.js, and MUMPS-based applications is preferred. Candidates should understand API enablement, service decomposition, code refactoring, re-platforming, re-hosting, data migration, and phased legacy-system retirement.

Artificial Intelligence and Automation:

  • Experience designing, governing, or integrating AI-enabled systems, including machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, natural-language interfaces, workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop decision support. Must understand model governance, prompt governance, agent permissions, tool controls, data protection, testing, evaluation, traceability, monitoring, exception management, and responsible AI principles.

DevSecOps and Delivery Automation:

  • Experience establishing and governing DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, source-control workflows, automated testing, code-quality controls, deployment automation, configuration management, release engineering, and rollback strategies. Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, SonarQube, and comparable CI/CD and quality-management tools is required or strongly preferred.

Cloud Engineering and Observability:

  • Experience designing or governing cloud environments that include virtual private cloud networking, subnets, firewalls, load balancers, security groups, identity and access management roles, container orchestration, monitoring, and resiliency controls. Familiarity with CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, and other application-performance-monitoring tools is preferred.

Security and Compliance:

  • Experience incorporating Zero Trust, identity federation, access control, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging, boundary protection, secrets management, certificate lifecycle management, vulnerability management, secure coding, and API security into enterprise solution designs. Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Risk Management Framework, assessment and authorization processes, and federal cybersecurity requirements is strongly preferred.

Identity, Secrets, and Certificate Management:

  • Experience designing or governing identity and access-management integrations, identity federation, service-account management, credential rotation, secrets management, and certificate lifecycle automation. Familiarity with Entra ID, external secrets-management services, PIV/CAC-oriented access controls, and certificate-management platforms is preferred.

Modernization Expertise:

  • Proven ability to modernize legacy applications, interfaces, and data pipelines while maintaining continuity of operations, data integrity, cybersecurity compliance, service availability, and user productivity. Must be able to evaluate and recommend refactoring, re-platforming, re-hosting, re-architecting, encapsulation, cloud migration, data migration, consolidation, replacement, or retirement approaches.

Agile Delivery:

  • Demonstrated success working in a scaled Agile environment and translating architecture into prioritized enablers, epics, features, stories, and release plans. Experience with SAFe, Agile product management, backlog refinement, dependency management, planning increments, architecture synchronization, and technical governance is strongly preferred.

Communication:

  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to executive leaders, business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, operations teams, and external partners. Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, technical standards, roadmaps, decision records, and executive-level briefings is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant professional certifications, such as:
    • TOGAF
    • SAFe Architect
    • SAFe Agile Product Manager
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
    • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect
    • Red Hat Certified Specialist or Architect in OpenShift or cloud-native applications
    • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
    • Databricks Certified Data Engineer
    • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
    • Equivalent architecture, cloud, security, data, or Agile certifications
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7 and FHIR.
  • Experience integrating inventory, procurement, financial management, enterprise resource planning, clinical, logistics, warehouse-management, or asset-management systems.
  • Experience with API management, enterprise integration, service orchestration, or middleware platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, data engineering, master data management, and modern ETL/ELT tooling.
  • Experience designing or governing enterprise item, vendor, contract, classification, reference-data, or master-data-management solutions.
  • Experience integrating external government, regulatory, manufacturer, supplier, vendor-validation, or product-identification data sources.
  • Experience in a federal, public-sector, healthcare, or other highly regulated environment.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, health informatics, data management, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust and a VA PIV credential.

Location:

  • Remote, USA.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $210,000 to $250,000.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

  • kilpailukykyisen palkan riippuen kokemuksestasi 65-81K

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • joustavat työajat ja lokaation, etänäkin hommat hoituu

  • työnantajan joka tukee erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa

  • kykyä suunnitella suurempia kokonaisuuksia kuten relaatiotietokantoja tai integraatioarkkitehtuureja.

  • kokemusta järjestelmäintegraatioista ja ainakin yhdestä integraatioalustasta.

  • kokemusta relaatiotietokantojen työstämisestä SQL:llä.

  • .NET/C#-ohjelmointitaustaa.

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

🧐 Frendszone

Erikoisuutenamme on oma, suomalainen integraatioalustamme Frends iPaaS, jota käytämme useimmissa projekteissamme. Frends on hybridi, low-code alusta, joka pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä. Palvelemme monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla, joten projektit vaihtelevat sekä sisällöltään, kestoltaan että toimialaltaan.

➡️ Lue, millaista Frendsillä on tehdä kehitystyötäblogistamme ja katso myös lyhyt demo-video. Voit myös tutustua Frendsiin lisää tuotteemme dokumentaatio-sivuilta.

Töissämme pääset tutustumaan myös Azuren eri teknologioihin kuten Machine Learning ja Data Factory. Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset oppimaan.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Arkeemme pääset sukeltamaan täältä.

FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Tutustu myös blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

  • Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.

Requirements

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Highlights

Build next-generation AI agents using C#, Azure, MCP and Azure OpenAI. Join AnywhereNow's Agent Factory team to create enterprise AI solutions that move from concept to production.

You’ll be the one making and documenting critical technical decisions, ensuring smooth deployments and stable APIs, and stepping in when needed to debug complex production issues, all with the goal of turning a good backend into a high-output, well-organised machine.

This is a fully remote B2B contract opportunity with a base salary that goes up to $120,000 USD per year

Your Tasks Will Include:

  • Lead and mentor a team of mid/senior backend engineers (4–5), including 1:1s, feedback, and performance management
  • Translate product and business goals into clear technical roadmaps, sprint plans, and backend priorities
  • Own the backend architecture and technical vision for mobile-first, consumer-facing apps used by tens of thousands of daily active users
  • Drive and oversee implementation of new features for our mobile apps, working closely with iOS/Android, Product, Data, DevOps and Trust & Safety teams
  • Take key architectural decisions around scalability, performance, reliability, data flows, and infrastructure on AWS
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, improve API speed and reliability, and design effective caching and database strategies
  • Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, coding standards, code review practices, and deployment/CI pipelines
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation and design specs for backend systems and major initiatives
  • Handle prioritisation and trade-offs in a fast-moving environment with changing quarterly priorities
  • Be hands-on with coding and code reviews, especially for complex or high-impact areas, and step in during critical production incidents

To be a good fit for the Lead Backend Engineer role:

  • 8+ years of professional backend development experience in production environments and most recent experience in leading a backend teams
  • Proven experience owning backend architecture for a mobile-first, consumer-facing app
  • Strong hands-on expertise with any OOP language - Ruby, Java, PHP, Python, C# (must be willing to work with Ruby on Rails)
  • Experience building and scaling high-traffic systems (Over 10k+ daily active users) with a focus on performance and reliability
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, relational databases, caching, and performance optimization
  • Practical experience working in the cloud (preferably AWS) and collaborating closely with DevOps / infrastructure engineers
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders (e.g. CEO, Product)
  • Background in a startup or fast-moving product companies, comfortable with changing priorities and making pragmatic trade-offs
  • Strong product mindset, user-focused, impact-driven, and able to connect technical decisions to business outcomes
  • Comfortable taking ownership, making decisions, and leading in a fully remote, distributed team environment

Our Client Offers:

  • Fully Remote Role with flexible working hours (core collaboration typically in European daytime)
  • 30k USD bonuses (seasonal + EOY, dependant on individual and company performance)
  • Work on high-impact, high-scale mobile products (millions of downloads) in a profitable, growing startup
  • Strong engineering culture: open-minded, low-ego, direct communication, and high ownership
  • Access to company-provided AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor company accounts) to boost your productivity
  • 27 days of paid vacation (15 days of personal leave + 12 days of public holidays following your local country calendar)
  • Company paid team trips, 1–2 times per year to attractive locations (e.g. Thailand, Bali) including flights and accommodation
  • Opportunity to shape technical direction, processes, and standards for the entire backend function
