jobs.excerpt: About Us! At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life.
jobs.description:
About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are seeking a Lead Unity Developer to take technical ownership of the architecture, development, integration, and final delivery of complex Unity applications for immersive and interactive experiences.

In this role, you will bridge creative development, technical art, third-party software development, and physical AV systems integration.

You will be responsible for maintaining the Technical Design Document, defining the application's technical architecture, coordinating development tasks, and ensuring all software and hardware components integrate into a stable, optimized, and deployable application.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can balance creative ambition with practical implementation, proactively identify technical risks, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and make informed technical decisions throughout production.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Your Responsibilities

1. Technical Architecture & Documentation

  • Own, develop, and maintain the Unity Technical Design Document (TDD).
  • Define application architecture, software dependencies, integration requirements, and technical workflows.
  • Establish development standards and best practices for C#, Unity project organization, asset management, and source control.
  • Identify technical risks, performance constraints, and integration challenges early in development.
  • Document the final application architecture, configuration, and deployment requirements for ongoing maintenance and support.

2. Unity Application Development & Delivery

  • Lead the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of the final Unity application.
  • Implement and maintain core application systems using C# and Unity's component architecture.
  • Integrate independently developed features, assets, and visual systems into a unified application.
  • Troubleshoot performance, rendering, memory management, compatibility, and application stability issues.
  • Manage application builds, deployment configurations, and production releases.
  • Support system testing, debugging, and final deployment.

3. Development Planning & JIRA Support

  • Collaborate with the Producer and development team to translate technical requirements into actionable JIRA tasks.
  • Define technical dependencies, implementation priorities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide technical estimates and identify potential development blockers.
  • Review completed work to ensure consistency with the overall application architecture.
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, and integration requirements to project stakeholders.

4. AV Hardware Consultation & Integration

  • Collaborate with AV integrators and hardware vendors to ensure the Unity application operates correctly within the specified hardware environment.
  • Consult on GPU/CPU requirements, rendering performance, display configurations, and system architecture.
  • Support integration with external hardware, display systems, sensors, touch interfaces, and control systems.
  • Develop or integrate communication interfaces for external hardware and software using appropriate protocols.
  • Identify and resolve hardware/software compatibility and performance challenges.
  • Participate in system testing, commissioning, and deployment as needed.

5. Web Overlay & UI Integration

  • Coordinate with third-party web development vendors responsible for creating web-based UI components.
  • Define and support communication interfaces between Unity and web-based applications.
  • Integrate web-based UI components or overlays into Unity applications where required.
  • Ensure reliable bidirectional communication, input handling, rendering, and interaction between UI and application systems.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate with external developers on performance and compatibility.

6. Technical Art & Real-Time Visual Integration

  • Collaborate with Unity Technical Artists to integrate real-time graphics, shaders, materials, effects, animation, and visual systems.
  • Establish performance budgets and technical guidelines for externally developed visual content.
  • Evaluate and optimize visual assets to meet target frame rates, resolution requirements, and hardware constraints.
  • Troubleshoot rendering pipeline, shader, material, and asset integration issues.
  • Ensure independently developed visual systems function cohesively within the final application.

Requirements

Your Journey Includes

Must Have

  • Unity Engine: Advanced experience developing and delivering production applications using Unity.
  • C# Programming: Strong proficiency in C# development, debugging, object-oriented programming, and software architecture.
  • Unity Architecture: Experience designing modular, maintainable application systems using Unity's component-based architecture.
  • Graphics & Performance Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU/GPU performance, memory usage, draw calls, shaders, and real-time rendering.
  • Rendering Pipelines: Working knowledge of Unity's Universal Render Pipeline (URP), High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP), and associated rendering workflows.
  • Systems Integration: Experience integrating third-party SDKs, APIs, plugins, and external software systems.
  • Technical Leadership: Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, coordinate dependencies, and guide development efforts across multiple disciplines.
  • Source Control & Collaboration: Experience with Git, Unity Version Control, Perforce, or equivalent version control systems.
  • Production Delivery: Experience building, troubleshooting, packaging, and deploying production-ready Unity applications.

Nice to Have

  • JavaScript / TypeScript: Familiarity with modern web development and communication between native applications and browser-based interfaces.
  • React: Experience integrating React-based interfaces or web overlays with Unity.
  • AI-Assisted Programming: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency, debugging, and documentation.
  • Shader & Material Development: Experience with Shader Graph, HLSL, compute shaders, and custom rendering effects.
  • Immersive & Interactive Installations: Experience developing software for museums, exhibitions, themed entertainment, or location-based experiences.
  • Multi-Display Rendering: Experience with multi-monitor configurations, high-resolution output, camera synchronization, or distributed rendering systems.
  • AV & Show Control Systems: Familiarity with external control systems and communication protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, WebSockets, OSC, Art-Net, or DMX.
  • Interactive Hardware Integration: Experience with touchscreens, depth cameras, sensors, tracking systems, RFID, and other physical interaction devices.
  • Video & Media Playback: Experience integrating high-resolution video playback, hardware decoding, synchronized media, or third-party media plugins such as AVPro Video.
  • Networking & External Services: Experience with REST APIs, real-time communication, event-driven architectures, and application-to-application messaging.
  • Deployment & Reliability: Experience with unattended installations, application monitoring, automated startup, recovery workflows, and long-duration runtime stability..

Thank you for applying. We're committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it's not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

  4. Experience with multiplayer games, game physics, or UI/UX development.
  5. Professional experience in game development.

jobs.excerpt: Tule sukeltamaan integraatioiden ja APIen pariin ja pyörittämään maailmaa kanssamme 🌍• Teemme työtä, jolla on aito merkitys- ilman integraatioita maailma ei pyörisi.
jobs.description:
Tule sukeltamaan integraatioiden ja APIen pariin ja pyörittämään maailmaa kanssamme 🌍

  • Teemme työtä, jolla on aito merkitys- ilman integraatioita maailma ei pyörisi.

  • Töitä tehdään omissaFrends-tiimeissä- opit tuntemaan kollegasi, tiimihenki on vahva ja saat tekniset asiantuntijat ympärillesi.

  • Kehitystyö onnistuujoustavasti ja saat myös itse päättää, mistä päin Suomea työsi teet.

  • Meillä on oma, kehittyvä integraatioalusta Frends - tuotekehitystiimi on vieressä ja vastaa kun kysyt.

  • Olemme vakaa, järkevästi kasvava ja moderni integraatiotalo - pääset kehittymään turvallisessa ympäristössä.

  • Laajasta asiakaskunnastamme löydät kansallisesti ja kansainvälisesti tunnettuja yrityksiä eri toimialoilta, jotka johtavat mielenkiintoisiin ja mielekkäisiin projekteihin ja erilaisiin tekniikoihin(mm. Aalto Yliopisto, Lähitaksi, St1).

"Integraatiopuolella rajapinnat ja teknologiat kehittyvät ja muuttuvat jatkuvasti, eli meillä saa koko ajan tutkia ja oppia uutta. Täällä näkee myös hyvin mielenkiintoisesta näkökulmasta oman integraatioalustamme kehittymistä.” -Jura, Integration Developer.

➡️ Tutustu lisää blogeistamme Integraatiokehittäjän työhön ja kenelle työ sopii.

🏆 Tarjoamme

  • kilpailukykyisen palkan riippuen kokemuksestasi 55-69K

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • oman, kehittyvän integraatioalustan Frendsin, joka on saanut tunnustusta kansainvälisessä Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ -tutkimuksessa

  • joustavat työajat ja lokaation, etänäkin hommat hoituu

  • työnantajan joka tukee erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa

  • tukea antavan esihenkilön ja oman tiimin

  • turvallisen ja vakaan työpaikan

  • kattavat työsuhde-edut (mm. laaja työterveyshuolto ja sairaskuluvakuutus, koulutusmahdollisuuksia, sertejä, lounasetu, virikesetelit, kulttuuri- ja liikuntakerho, kuntosali, hieronta)

💻 Teknologiat

Erikoisuutenamme on oma integraatioalustamme Frends, jota käytämme useimmiten projekteissamme. Frends on täysin suomalainen low-code, hybridi-integraatioalusta. Tuotteen tuoreimmassa inkarnaatiossa käytetään moderneja teknologioita ja pilvipalveluita. Frends on pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä.

➡️ Lue, millaista Frendsillä on tehdä kehitystyötäblogistamme ja katso myös lyhyt demo-video. Voit myös tutustua Frendsiin lisää tuotteemme dokumentaatio-sivuilta.

Töissämme pääset tutustumaan myös Azuren eri teknologioihin kuten Machine Learning ja Data Factory. Taikasanoja työssä menestymiseen ovat REST, JSON, XML, XSLT ja SQL. Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset myös oppimaan.

🧐 Frendszone

Lyhyesti kuvattuna, olemme IT-konsulttitalo ja palvelemme hyvin monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Osa kehittäjistä on keskittynyt täysin kehitystyöhön, osa tekee tämän lisäksi esimerkiksi määrittelyä, kouluttamista tai myynnin tukea. Kuuntelemme tekijöitämme ja pyrimme muokkaamaan roolia ja urapolkua jokaiselle mieluisaksi.

➡️FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arjestamme voit myös lukea lisää täältä. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Tutustu blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

⭐ Miten edetään?

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

  • Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

  • Vanhat järjestelmät vanhenisivat ennen aikojaan, jos niiden päälle ei integraatiokeinoin pystyttäisi rakentamaan moderneja käyttöliittymiä.

  • Raha ei liikkuisi. Ihmiset jonottaisivat pankkikonttoreissa maksamassa laskuja ja nostamassa rahaa.

jobs.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer

(.NET / C# & React)

Remote | LATAM | Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD $23–26/hour (approximately $3,680–$4,160/month)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript to join an innovative engineering team building scalable, high-quality web applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both front-end and back-end development, takes ownership of their work, and enjoys solving complex technical challenges.

This is an AI-first engineering environment where AI-assisted and agentic development are integral to the software development process. You should have hands-on experience leveraging AI coding assistants and autonomous agents to accelerate development, improve efficiency, and deliver reliable solutions.

Beyond using AI tools, you must be able to critically evaluate, test, and take ownership of AI-generated code, ensuring it meets production standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript.

  • Build responsive front-end experiences and reliable back-end services.

  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Review, debug, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure quality, security, and maintainability.

  • Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams to design and deliver new features.

  • Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance.

  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies, development practices, and AI-powered engineering tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.

  • Strong proficiency in .NET (C#) and experience developing back-end applications.

  • Solid front-end development skills with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

  • Hands-on professional experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic development tools to build, debug, and improve software.

  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.

  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling.

  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.

  • Understanding of web application security best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

At Phreesia, we're transforming the healthcare experience through intelligent technology that helps patients connect with care more easily and helps providers operate more efficiently.  For over 20 years, we’ve built solutions that make healthcare simpler for patients and organizations from scheduling and registration to payments and patient management.

Through our AccessOne financing platform we help patients manage medical expenses through access to affordable payment plans with zero or low-interest rates that don’t harm their credit. Following Phreesia’s acquisition of AccessOne, we are investing in the next generation of our platform and engineering team. Title:

Senior IT Development Lead

We are KBR

When you become part of our KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through internal collaboration, and with our partners and customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the innovative solutions to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to Zero Harm and our Sustainability Platform.

In September 2025, we announced that we are spinning our Mission Technology Solutions business into a separate public company. This role would ultimately be part of that new company. Our Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions. From national security and readiness to advanced research, cyber, logistics, and life-cycle sustainment, our teams help customers solve complex challenges in some of the world’s most demanding environments. Whether supporting operations on the ground, at sea, in the air, or in space, our clients trust us to deliver mission-critical capabilities every day.

Working with us means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions.

As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution.

We are IT

We are strategic enablers of the business, delivering scalable, secure, and innovative technology solutions that drive operational excellence and support enterprise growth. We partner closely with functions across the organization to modernize systems, unlock data-driven insights, and enhance the digital employee experience. Our global footprint and commitment to transformation position us at the forefront of leveraging technology to create lasting business value.

About the Role

The Senior IT Development Lead is responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise software solutions that support business objectives and technology strategy. This role provides technical leadership across development teams, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with architectural standards and modern software engineering practices.

Operating at the intersection of application development, architecture, and delivery leadership, the Senior IT Development Lead drives the successful execution of technology initiatives while promoting Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in the Microsoft technology stack with proven leadership experience managing development teams and enterprise application delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead development teams in the design, development, implementation, and support of enterprise applications.
  • Serve as a technical leader responsible for application architecture, integration strategies, and adoption of development best practices.
  • Drive the development and maintenance of applications, including coding, testing, debugging, deployment, and production support activities.
  • Establish priorities, manage project timelines, and ensure successful delivery aligned with business objectives and IT strategy.
  • Guide the adoption of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver effective technology solutions.
  • Evaluate existing systems and recommend enhancements, modernization initiatives, and new technology solutions.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of supported applications.
  • Provide leadership and guidance in resolving complex technical challenges, production incidents, and system issues.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, technical specifications, solution designs, and development standards.
  • Lead Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, code reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate development efforts across global teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure successful project execution.
  • Mentor and support developers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and professional development opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required.
  • 8+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on the Microsoft technology stack.
  • Proven experience leading development teams and delivering enterprise-scale applications.
  • Experience working in Agile and Scrum-based software delivery environments.
  • Experience supporting production systems and resolving complex technical issues.

Application Development & Technical Expertise:

  • Strong experience with C#, .NET Framework, .NET 6/8+, and modern web application development.
  • Experience developing applications using ASP.NET (Web Forms and MVC) and RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
  • Knowledge of application architecture, system integration, and software development best practices.

Leadership & Core Competencies:

  • Ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical teams while managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to address complex technical challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and business audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across cross-functional and global teams.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage competing demands, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Blazor and modern UI frameworks.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation technologies such as ARM templates or Terraform.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and containerization technologies.
  • Exposure to DevSecOps practices and secure software development standards.

Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Before You Apply

  • CVs MUST be submitted in English

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer who thrives on building secure, scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.

You'll join an international engineering organisation responsible for the cloud platforms powering enterprise software used by customers worldwide.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes, you'll help ensure that critical applications remain secure, available and performant while making it easier for engineering teams to build, test and deploy software.

This is a hands-on role combining cloud engineering, site reliability, security and automation.

If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, eliminating repetitive tasks and improving how software is delivered, this could be an excellent opportunity.

What You'll Be Working On

Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes

  • Manage, maintain and optimise cloud infrastructure hosted on Microsoft Azure.
  • Operate and secure production Kubernetes environments, particularly Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Work across cloud networking, identity management, storage and Azure SQL.
  • Maintain reliable, scalable environments supporting enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Deliver platform upgrades, patches and hotfixes while minimising disruption to customers.

Site Reliability & Performance

Reliability isn't just about responding when something breaks. It's about engineering systems that are less likely to fail.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Defining and monitoring Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Implementing monitoring, alerting and observability solutions.
  • Investigating production incidents and identifying root causes.
  • Participating in on-call support and coordinating incident resolution.
  • Conducting post-incident reviews and implementing lasting improvements.
  • Testing backup, restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Turning recurring operational issues into automated solutions.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design, build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Integrate automated testing, quality checks and security controls into deployment workflows.
  • Improve software release processes to make deployments faster, safer and more predictable.
  • Establish standards for source control, development environments and release readiness.
  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
  • Reduce manual operational tasks through automation and infrastructure improvements.

Cloud Security

Security is an integral part of this role.

You'll help protect cloud infrastructure and customer environments by:

  • Identifying, prioritising and remediating vulnerabilities.
  • Managing security patches, certificates, secrets and access permissions.
  • Applying security best practices across Azure and Kubernetes.
  • Supporting secure configuration and maintenance of production environments.
  • Contributing to continuous improvements in infrastructure security.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with software engineers and technical teams across Europe, North America and Australia.
  • Help establish and improve engineering and operational standards.
  • Share knowledge and support other engineers in adopting DevOps best practices.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation, troubleshooting guides and runbooks.
  • Contribute to a culture of reliability, automation and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or cloud operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including networking, identity, storage and Azure SQL.
  • Proven experience deploying, managing and securing Kubernetes in production, ideally using AKS.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Azure DevOps YAML.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
  • Practical experience implementing monitoring, alerting and incident response processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability engineering principles.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, security patching and secrets management.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing production environments.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server and SQL Server.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with international teams across multiple time zones.

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

Observability & Monitoring

  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Loki
  • Tempo
  • OpenTelemetry

Security & Compliance

  • Microsoft Defender for Cloud
  • Azure Policy
  • ISO 27001
  • SOC 2

Deployment & Operations

  • GitOps and ArgoCD
  • Feature flag management
  • ITIL or other IT service management practices

Professional Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure: AZ-104, AZ-400 or AZ-500
  • Kubernetes: CKA or CKS

How You Work

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive engineering mindset.

You:

  • Think about reliability first. You design systems to prevent problems rather than simply reacting to them.
  • Automate whenever possible. You recognise repetitive tasks as opportunities for improvement.
  • Take ownership. You investigate problems thoroughly and follow them through to resolution.
  • Care about security. You understand that protecting infrastructure and customer data is everyone's responsibility.
  • Communicate clearly. You can explain complex technical issues to engineers and other stakeholders.
  • Keep learning. You stay informed about emerging cloud technologies, tools and engineering practices.
  • Work collaboratively. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping your team succeed.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Work on infrastructure that matters

Support cloud platforms powering enterprise applications used by customers around the world.

Solve meaningful engineering challenges

Work across reliability, security, automation and cloud infrastructure rather than focusing on a single narrow area.

Make a measurable impact

Your improvements will directly influence system availability, deployment efficiency, security and the developer experience.

Collaborate internationally

Work alongside experienced engineering professionals across multiple continents.

Build for the long term

Help create reliable, secure and maintainable infrastructure that supports the continued evolution of enterprise SaaS products.

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

If you're an experienced DevOps Engineer who enjoys working with Azure, Kubernetes and modern automation technologies, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now and help engineer the infrastructure behind tomorrow's enterprise software.

  • Create analytical and semantic models that support secure downstream reporting and customer-facing use cases.
  • Understand the application's roles, permissions, and visibility rules, and translate the required authorization context into appropriate analytical access patterns.
  • Design for historical preservation, change handling, retention, deletions, reconciliation, and future transactional data purging.
  • Implement the engineering controls required for production operation, including testing, data quality, monitoring, recovery, security, and deployment.
  • Assess the existing ingestion and analytical processes, retaining what works and improving or replacing what does not.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture decisions, operational runbooks, and implementation knowledge throughout the engagement.
  • Transfer knowledge to the internal Data & Analytics team so the platform can be operated and extended after the contract.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience transforming data from complex OLTP applications into analytical platforms, data warehouses, lakehouses, or OLAP solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience building data solutions in Azure, with practical experience or working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience designing layered or medallion data architectures, analytical models, semantic layers, and downstream consumption patterns.
  • Strong understanding of historical data offload and lifecycle management, including incremental change, deletions, retention, archival, reconciliation, and purge considerations.
  • Experience designing secure analytical solutions based on application roles, permissions, tenant boundaries, and access-control requirements.
  • Experience with both single-tenant and multi-tenant data environments.
  • Advanced SQL and strong hands-on Python skills for building maintainable, testable, production-ready data pipelines and transformations.
  • Experience with PySpark or comparable distributed data-processing frameworks.
  • Ability to work across architecture and implementation, independently solve complex problems, and translate decisions into working solutions.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across internal teams and external partners.
  • Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools for technical discovery, development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation, with appropriate review and validation of outputs.
  • Strong written and spoken English.

Engagement Expectations

Success requires hands-on delivery, proactive identification of technical risks, clear communication of decisions and trade-offs, and close collaboration with Data & Analytics, Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, and external delivery partners.

What Will You Do?

  • Partner with the Head of Engineering and cross-functional leaders to identify product and AI opportunities tied to revenue, customer success, efficiency, or long-term company value.

  • You have worked directly with customers through implementation, solutions engineering, technical consulting, product development, or a similar role.

What’s In It for You?

Full-Stack Engineer - Operations Engineering Team

Hybrid or Remote working in the UK or Germany.

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to build the systems that power iwoca’s German business.

You’ll join the Operations Engineering team, a cross-functional group that builds the proprietary tools (like our CRM) that our German operations staff use every day. You’ll own high-impact projects from the ground up, using your technical experience and curious mindset to improve how we serve small businesses while also helping to level up the wider engineering team.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Operations Engineering team is a cross-functional group consisting of three full-stack engineers and one product manager. The team works closely with the Operations, Operations Strategy and Analytics teams to deliver impactful changes across the wider Operations function. The team builds and maintains the internal systems – including tools for underwriting, notifications, and account management – that power iwoca’s German market. They support more than 70 colleagues across sales, credit, and collections who rely on these tools every day.

As the German business grows, the Operations Engineering team is moving beyond small improvements and into reworking how work is done. By reducing manual steps and improving how information flows through the company, the team directly influences how quickly other teams can act, how reliably iwoca can support its customers, and where we can most effectively spend human effort.

The role

You’ll work on the systems that internal teams rely on to serve customers. You’ll take an initial problem, engage with stakeholders, and develop solutions through to delivery and see the outcome in daily use. You’ll design and build full-stack services that support core operational workflows, including customer communication, underwriting, and collections.

  • Simplify workflows: You’ll decide when and what to automate, translating operational needs into reliable code that reduces manual effort.

  • Evolve the architecture: You’ll identify ways to modernise our systems, managing trade-offs to keep them dependable as they scale.

  • Advocate for quality: You’ll be a key part of the team, using code reviews and design sessions to advocate for better engineering practices and staff user experiences.

  • Expand your scope: You’ll join a growing team that supports individual ownership, offering you opportunities to lead projects end-to-end, developing your commercial judgement.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Proven track record designing and building backend systems using Python, with the ability to work across front-end codebases, particularly React or TypeScript, to deliver projects end to end.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow—whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL or similar, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Able to use lateral thinking to anticipate technical challenges and to improve existing systems that support complex workflows.

  • A track record of taking work from an initial problem through to delivery, including shaping solutions, making trade-offs, and iterating based on how systems are used.

  • Strong communication skills to be able to explain complex technical topics in simple terms and to articulate and influence decision making within the team.

Bonus:

  • Knowing how to scale systems: Familiarity with working on internal tools or platforms used by large operational teams.

  • Framework experience across Python and TypeScript such as Django, FastAPI and React.

  • Modern deployment experience: Working with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows.

  • A data-driven mindset: Using data or metrics to assess whether changes have had the intended effect.

The salary

We expect to pay from £75,000–£90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

Senior SDET

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you take pride in building and maintaining robust test automation frameworks? Are you passionate about improving deployment processes for high-impact products?

Boxes ticked? If so, read on.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, lucky to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you will be doing

The Senior SDET, Frameworks role will lead the evolution of Semble’s test automation capability and help make quality a shared engineering discipline. You will:

  • Lead the transformation towards a Quality Agent System, using AI agents and deterministic automation to continuously identify coverage gaps, generate and maintain tests, detect flaky tests, support exploratory testing, and surface reproducible defects.
  • Design safe, maintainable agent workflows with clear responsibilities, isolated execution, human review, and appropriate controls. Agents should assist engineers and SDETs, not replace human judgement or merge their own changes.
  • Establish the foundations required for this system, including a stable Playwright framework, reliable CI integration, ephemeral test environments, test data management, quality observability, and structured test knowledge.
  • Set up meaningful quality gates in CI and PR workflows, including coverage validation, framework conventions, high-risk code checks, and actionable failure reporting.
  • Rationalise our overcrowded E2E suite by identifying tests that belong at unit, API, or integration level, keeping E2E focused on critical user journeys.
  • Build and maintain a cross-layer coverage map and risk-based defect view, helping teams understand where quality gaps exist and where automation investment will have the greatest impact.
  • Expand test coverage and surface quality gaps earlier in the development lifecycle, including through test scenario generation, mutation testing, and AI-assisted exploratory testing.
  • Conduct proof-of-concepts for non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability testing.
  • Contribute to company-wide quality strategy, tooling decisions, quality metrics, and shift-left adoption alongside the wider SDET and Engineering teams.
  • Coach engineers and SDETs on effective test design, the testing pyramid, Playwright, and contributing to the shared framework.

What we are looking for

At a Senior level at Semble, we will expect you to be mostly autonomous in your scope and to own and solve complex tasks or lead projects independently. You will work with peers from different functions and have an impact across department. You may be in a mentoring role for more junior team members and should be able to influence effectively and lead by example throughout the company.

  • 5+ years of professional experience as SDET or Test Automation Engineer
  • A strong track record of designing, building, and evolving automation frameworks that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to adopt.

  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with statisticians, clinical teams, and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: Cos'è Blox Space? Blox Space lavora al centro dell'economia tech,in partnership con un network di oltre 70 realtà attive nel mondo dell'AI, del software, della cybersecurity e delle Freedom Technologies, impegnate nello sviluppo di infrastrutture, prodotti e servizi legati all'economia digitale, alla data protection e al futuro del denaro.
jobs.description:
Cos'è Blox Space?

Blox Space lavora al centro dell'economia tech,in partnership con un network di oltre 70 realtà attive nel mondo dell'AI, del software, della cybersecurity e delle Freedom Technologies, impegnate nello sviluppo di infrastrutture, prodotti e servizi legati all'economia digitale, alla data protection e al futuro del denaro.
﻿Aiutiamo a connettere i talenti con questo ecosistema, operando come Talent Bridge tra le ambizioni di crescita dei professionisti e le opportunità offerte dal nostro network.
﻿In questo momento stiamo supportando una delle nostre partner companies nella ricerca di un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer, e se pensi di essere il profilo giusto, ci piacerebbe conoscerti.

Il Ruolo

L'azienda è una startup di cybersecurity italiana che costruisce sistemi di sicurezza autonomi: individuano vulnerabilità sconosciute, prioritizzano il rischio reale e distribuiscono le correzioni senza intervento umano, con un focus sui binari compilati, perché è quello che gira davvero in produzione. È un team early, pre-seed, fondato da ricercatori di sicurezza e accademici di primo piano.
﻿Cerchiamo un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer che adatti, valuti e metta in produzione modelli linguistici open-weight, ma piegati a un unico scopo: trovare e capire vulnerabilità. Per questo cerchiamo una persona fortemente orientata alla cybersecurity, che non si limiti ad addestrare modelli ma capisca il dominio su cui lavorano. Non è un ruolo di prompt engineering: è l'intero ciclo di post-training, dal design dei dataset al fine tuning, dalla generazione di dati sintetici alla valutazione, fino al deploy in ambienti locali, privati o ristretti.
﻿Non cerchiamo il curriculum perfetto, cerchiamo la testa giusta. Cerchiamo chi sa trasformare un foundation model in un sistema affidabile e specifico per il compito, sa quando il fine tuning è la strada giusta e quando invece conviene prompting, retrieval, orchestrazione o tooling, e porta con sé una vera sensibilità per il mindset di chi attacca.
﻿Le responsabilità di un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer in questo contesto possono spaziare dal fine tuning e dall'adattamento di LLM open-weight per casi d'uso di sicurezza, interni o rivolti al cliente, al confronto tra approcci di post-training (SFT, tecniche parameter-efficient come LoRA e QLoRA, preference tuning come DPO dove serve, full fine tuning quando giustificato), dalla costruzione e pulizia di dataset di qualità e dalla generazione di dati sintetici alla definizione di metodi di valutazione che vanno oltre i benchmark generici, fino all'analisi di regressioni e failure mode e al lavoro con il team di engineering per servire i modelli in ambienti vincolati.

﻿﻿﻿

Le skill che fanno la differenza

  • Esperienza pratica vera nel fine tuning di LLM: in produzione, in ricerca applicata o in contesti sperimentali seri, con più tecniche di post-training alle spalle, idealmente SFT, LoRA e QLoRA.
  • Orientamento forte alla cybersecurity: capisci (o hai una gran voglia di capire a fondo) threat model, bug hunting e la logica di chi attacca. È il dominio su cui i modelli lavorano, e qui fa la differenza tra un buon fine tuning e uno inutile.
  • Dati prima di tutto: sai costruire, curare e mantenere dataset per training e valutazione, e sai generare, filtrare e validare dati sintetici per migliorare il comportamento del modello, non per gonfiare le metriche.
  • Stack solido: Python forte, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, tokenizzazione, preprocessing e training pipeline sono pane quotidiano.
  • Dimestichezza con i vincoli reali: limiti di GPU, trade-off memoria/performance, workflow quantization-aware e ottimizzazione del training.
  • Mentalità da debugging: sai capire perché un modello è migliorato, è regredito, ha fatto overfit o ha fallito, e la valutazione la imposti su quello che conta davvero a livello operativo, non sui punteggi generici.
  • Autonomia a cavallo tra ricerca, dati ed engineering: ti muovi da solo su tutti e tre i fronti.
  • Sono Very Nice to Have: un background in software security o vulnerability research, esperienza in CTF, deploy in ambienti air-gapped, on-premise o ristretti, inference optimization, quantization, model serving o runtime LLM locali, training distribuito o multi-GPU, eval harness, red-teaming o model safety testing.

Ti manca qualcosa rispetto a quello che hai letto? Candidati comunque: siamo a caccia di game-changer, non di checklist da spuntare!﻿

Work arrangements

Il ruolo ha come sede preferenziale l'hub di Blox Space a Torino, un ambiente cost-effective e ad alta densità di persone tecniche di valore, ma valutiamo candidature da tutta Italia, con modalità operative flessibili da concordare insieme al team.
﻿Per il ruolo è previsto un range retributivo di 40.000 – 60.000 € lordi annui, con la disponibilità a valutare anche proposte superiori per profili particolarmente senior o di valore eccezionale.
﻿Sono inoltre previsti un contributo di 1.000 € per il setup dell'home office, un piano AI premium a tua scelta e retreat aziendali in Italia.

Unisciti all'ecosistema con Blox Space!

Se vuoi rendere i modelli open-weight davvero affidabili e utili contro uno dei problemi più difficili della sicurezza, e farlo accanto a chi trova bug veri in sistemi veri, questa è l'opportunità che stavi aspettando: lavorare con una delle nostre partner companies significa entrare in un team innovativo e in forte crescita, al centro di un ecosistema dove circolano idee, competenze e progetti ad alta intensità. È un ambiente dove si costruisce, si testa, si discute e si migliora ogni giorno.

About the assignment

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer. You'll own fraud forensics for our identity and verification platform, which verifies users through phone-number and OTP verification. We are seeing a surge in sophisticated fraud attacks on that flow, including SMS pumping campaigns targeting specific regions, while tuning critical anti-fraud thresholds where every rule change trades blocked attackers against legitimate users lost at signup. You'll investigate attacks, triage patterns, and turn findings into rules and monitoring our backend engineers can skip so they stay focused on core platform work. You'll own this space end to end while we hire a permanent team member, and leave behind detection the team can run without you.

Responsibilities

  • Fraud forensics: investigate active and past attacks on OTP and verification flows; quantify volume, cost and user impact; produce clear incident write-ups.

  • Attack triage: identify patterns across country, carrier, number range, device and attestation signals; separate SMS pumping, bot traffic and account abuse from legitimate spikes.

  • Threshold tuning: analyse and backtest anti-fraud rules and thresholds; quantify false positives (legitimate users blocked) against fraud prevented; recommend changes with evidence.

  • Detection and monitoring: turn recurring forensics into scheduled queries, dashboards and alerts so attacks are caught in hours, not after the provider invoice.

  • Engineering hand-off: give backend engineers precise, ready-to-implement rule proposals so they stay focused on platform delivery.

  • Knowledge transfer: document playbooks and coach our analytics engineer so capability stays in the team.

Requirements

Mandatory

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data science or fraud analytics, with at least 2 years hands-on in fraud or abuse detection.

  • Expert SQL on BigQuery: large event tables, window functions, partition-aware and cost-efficient queries.

  • Strong Python (pandas, notebooks) for ad-hoc forensics and pattern mining.

  • Building scheduled pipelines in Airflow and dashboards in Looker (or equivalent BI).

  • Experience tuning rule- or threshold-based fraud controls, including backtesting and false-positive analysis.

  • Works independently from day one; communicates findings crisply to engineers and leadership.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience investigating telecom or SMS fraud (SMS pumping / artificially inflated traffic, IRSF) at scale.

  • Hands-on with CPaaS provider logs and billing data (Vonage, Twilio, Sinch, Infobip).

  • Identity and verification domain: OTP funnels, rate limiting, velocity rules, device attestation (Play Integrity, App Attest).

  • Experience with fraud in emerging markets (Africa, South Asia), where carrier and pricing patterns differ.

  • Event streams from Kafka; streaming anomaly detection (Dataflow/Flink).

  • Statistical anomaly detection or lightweight ML (BigQuery ML, isolation forests).

No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique.
